"...Hehe. Right. I'm the one who said we'd follow the normal process."
"Then please come with me. From this moment on, you're the patient, Ms. Nanjo."
"Didn't you say you wanted to experience this? The first step has already begun."
"Kaori, you really...! You're my assistant tonight, so don't laugh at me by the table."
"I'm only responsible for doing the operation properly."
Sakaguchi stood up and picked up his chart. Sayaka turned to look at him.
"Wait, Sakaguchi. Aren't you coming with me?"
"I still have patients to see. You can get ready first; I'll come to the OR tonight."
"...You're really just handing your girlfriend over to someone else like that?"
"What lead surgeon stays with a patient through the entire preoperative preparation, starting from changing into a gown?"
"Hey! Why are you calling me that too!"
Hiroko led Sayaka toward the ward. After a few steps, Sayaka looked back and waved to Sakaguchi. She was still smiling, but she wasn't quite as triumphant as before.
In front of the nurses' station, Moe Honjo came over with a preparation checklist.
"Nurse Sugimura! The empty room is ready, and I've prepared the supplies too! Dr. Nanjo, I'll do my best to help today!"
"...Moe, you're really full of energy today."
The three disappeared around the corner and down the corridor. Sakaguchi looked down at the surgical plan left on the desk and finally shook his head with a laugh.
"...She really is going through with it."

That evening, Sakaguchi changed into scrubs and pushed open the operating room door. Miyama stood to one side checking the chart, Moe was organizing the equipment, and Hiroko had just finished counting the prepared instruments.
A woman wearing a pale surgical cap lay on the operating table. Her hair was fully tucked away and her arms rested at her sides. Her face showed an exhaustion close to utter despair.
"What's with that expression? You were full of energy this afternoon."
"You have some nerve! Do you know what I've been through since four o'clock?!"

"Easy for you to say! First they made me change into a patient gown, then gave me an enema, shaved me, and cleaned me up completely, then wheeled me here. On the table, there was a catheter, positioning, securing, disinfection... I used to arrange all this for patients. Why did I never realize it would take so long?!"
"Dr. Nanjo, we followed the procedure! We didn't cut any corners!"
"...Moe, I didn't say you cut corners. It's because every one of you was so thorough that I'm exhausted!"
"Dr. Nanjo, it has certainly been a long day since your admission. But all the necessary preparation is complete, and we can begin shortly."
"Hiroko, that doesn't sound comforting at all..."

"Preparation in the ward, transport, and operating-room admission for open surgery all need enough time. You arrived in the OR early today, so the wait was long, but we can't skip checks just to save time."

"'The wait was long'?! I've been lying on this table for almost two hours! I can't just move around, and I have to watch you all walking back and forth... I could practically memorize what the surgical lights look like!"
"Dr. Nanjo, I'm sorry you've had such a hard time! But we've really prepared everything now!"
"...That's why I said your work efficiency is so high, I can't even stay mad at you."
"I thought you might back out at the last minute. But when you saw Sakaguchi, the first thing you did was complain about the preparation time."
"I didn't back out! It's just... I knew surgery wasn't simple, but I never imagined the part before the incision could be so exhausting too."
"Looking at you now, I thought you'd want me to forget every bold thing you said this afternoon."
"...Should we just call it off tonight?"
Sakaguchi said it lightly on purpose. Sayaka froze, then opened her tired eyes wide and glared at him.

"Call it off?! I've already been stripped, washed, and left here completely bare, tied down waiting for you to operate! If we cancel now, all that fuss this afternoon was for nothing! Do the operation properly—don't waste it!"
The operating room fell silent for a moment. Moe nearly laughed out loud, then quickly lowered her head to look at the preparation checklist.
"...Dr. Nanjo, please don't put it so dramatically at a time like this."
"Hmph, I'm the patient now. Don't patients have the right to complain a little?"
"Of course. We'll listen to whatever you want to complain about today. But first, let me finish this check."

Standing at the sterile instrument station, Hiroko continued verbally confirming the surgical site, procedure, and personnel, while Moe checked the record beside her. Sayaka answered obediently, but once Hiroko lowered her head to inspect the instruments, she quietly looked toward Sakaguchi again.
"Do I... still look pretty like this?"
"You still have time to ask that now?"
"Didn't you say last time that I looked especially pretty in a surgical cap without a mask? Now that I'm really your patient, I wanted to hear you say it again."
"Of course you're pretty. You just have more of a 'I should've known this would happen' look than last time."
"Hmph! Can't you just say the first part?"
She held back a laugh, then suddenly lowered her voice.
"...Hey, lean your ear a little closer. There's something I can't let them hear."
"What secret do you need to tell me at a time like this?"
Before formally scrubbing in, Sakaguchi leaned down. Sayaka moved close to his ear and spoke so quietly that only he could hear.

"Lying on the operating table this time feels completely different from last time. The surgical lights are shining on me, and I'm lying here all bare while Miyama and the others are fully covered and ready for action. They just used steel forceps to swab me up and down with povidone-iodine gauze. You can't imagine that strange, intense feeling until you lie here yourself. Hey, just between us: lying naked and unable to move while several of them fuss over me, my nipples feel chilly and have actually gone hard. As a doctor, I know this is all routine surgical preparation, but it's still so embarrassing and exciting. Oh, could you sneak a look down there for me? Is it really obvious?"
"It's glistening down there, and there's a small wet patch on the pad."
Sakaguchi looked away, trying hard to maintain his professional expression. Sayaka, however, clearly wasn't ready to end their whispered conversation.
"Exactly, I never could have imagined it. This is so much more exciting than last time! And you haven't even started cutting yet!!"

Wearing a sterile surgical gown and gloves, Hiroko was fitting a blade onto a scalpel at the sterile instrument table. Hearing the two of them speaking in low voices, she looked up at them. Sayaka immediately fell silent.
"I was checking the catheter and the prepared area. I've finished looking."
When Hiroko lowered her head to work on the instruments again, Sayaka secretly gave Sakaguchi a flirtatious look. Struggling to keep his composure, Sakaguchi glanced toward the scrub area.
"Dr. Sakaguchi, the disinfectant has dried. We can begin draping. Please go scrub in first."
Sakaguchi headed for the scrub area. Sayaka watched him go, biting her lip, though the corners of her mouth still held a trace of her earlier smile.
Before scrubbing in, Sakaguchi briefly glanced down without touching her disinfected skin.
Sayaka blushed and gave a little laugh, her eyes curving into crescents.

After scrubbing in, Sakaguchi returned to the operating table. The surgical lights were on, and sterile drapes covered Sayaka completely, leaving only the surgical site for the appendectomy exposed. Miyama stood opposite him, while Hiroko had arranged the instruments neatly within reach.
"Instrument count complete. Ready for the preoperative time-out."
"Patient Sayaka Nanjo, open appendectomy. First assistant Kaori Miyama, lead surgeon Takashi Sakaguchi."
"Confirmed. Sayaka, can you still hear me clearly?"
"I can hear you! You've said my name so many times, I couldn't pretend not to hear it now if I wanted to."
"Then I'll tell you one last time. We're really about to make the incision. You chose the special awake, no-anesthesia plan for this experience. It may feel much more intense than you imagine."
"Oh, you've said that so many times since this afternoon! I know, I know."
"Knowing it and actually feeling the first incision aren't the same thing."
"...You make it sound as if you've experienced it yourself. You haven't lain here and had someone operate on you either. I guess it's probably like cutting your finger while cooking."
"...Dr. Nanjo, I advise you not to use a cut finger to imagine abdominal surgery."
"Kaori, aren't you my first assistant? Why are you teaming up with him to scare me?"
"...All right. You two put on the same surgical gowns and suddenly you're on the same side."
Through his sterile gloves, Sakaguchi checked the incision site in Sayaka's lower-right abdomen again. Her gaze followed his movements, and her voice unconsciously grew quieter.
"The site is confirmed. By the way, your skin really is beautiful."
"...You! Why don't you compliment me more often? You wait until your girlfriend is lying here to say things like that?"
"I don't usually look this closely at you while you're being prepared for surgery."
"Hehe... You're a doctor, but somehow you've learned to say sweet things at a time like this."
As soon as Hiroko spoke, Sayaka stopped smiling. She watched Sakaguchi hold out his hand and Hiroko place the scalpel in it.
"It's nothing... Now that you're really standing here with the knife, I suddenly feel a little..."
"...Mm. Just a little. But I'm not giving up now."
"...G-Go ahead and operate! Don't make me keep staring at the knife in your hand. It gets scarier the longer I look!"
Sakaguchi glanced at Miyama one last time. She nodded slightly to show she was ready to assist.
Sakaguchi began the incision along the confirmed site. Sayaka still wore a faint, forced smile, but the next moment her eyes flew wide open.
"Ah—! W-Wait! This is nothing like cutting your finger!!"
"You made it sound so easy. Who knew... Wait, let me catch my breath. This is nothing... nothing like cutting your finger!"
"Don't hold your breath. We can hear you; you don't need to shout every sentence."
"Kaori... when it's your turn to lie here someday, then you can teach me how to keep my voice down!"
"Dr. Nanjo, tell us if anything changes. It's all right if you want to cry out, but please try to follow our instructions."
"I'm already cooperating! ...Sakaguchi, wait. Where exactly have you cut to now?"
"We're proceeding according to plan. Don't try to guess every step. Just listen to what I tell you."
"How can I not guess? I'm a doctor too. I can tell roughly what you're doing when I hear you change instruments... But knowing is one thing. Actually feeling the pain is something else..."

Sakaguchi and Miyama continued the tissue work required for the operation. Hiroko skillfully exchanged instruments. Sayaka tried to shift her gaze to the surgical lights, but couldn't help using everyone's conversation to guess how things were progressing.
"...Did you just ask Kaori to help retract? I heard you... Don't move so suddenly."
"I can't see anything, so all I can do is listen... If I couldn't even hear clearly, wouldn't I be at too much of a disadvantage?"
"If you really want to know, I'll tell you. Just don't scare yourself."
"...The more you say that, the more I feel something scary is about to happen."
The operation moved into the intra-abdominal phase. Miyama helped Sakaguchi adjust the operative field, and Hiroko steadily handed him the next instrument.
"...Mm! Wait, were you just pulling something inside? Why does it feel completely different from before?"
"We're working with the tissue around the appendix now. Does the traction feel pronounced?"
"Very...! Just then, it felt like something had grabbed my whole belly... It's nothing like cutting the skin. How can you ask me that so calmly...!"
"At the moment, I am operating on someone else."
"On the operating table, you're my patient first."
Sayaka opened her mouth, but for a moment couldn't think of anything to say. After a while, she sulkily turned her head to the other side.
"...All right, Dr. Sakaguchi. Then please... take good care of this poor female patient!"
"I can see the area clearly now. We can continue."
"W-Wait! Did you just... pull out my intestines?! Why does it feel like everything inside my belly is being tugged upward...!"
"We didn't take out a whole string of intestines like you're imagining. We're only working in the area that needs it. Don't make up a horror story for yourself."
"But I'm lying down here and can't see anything... You can all see perfectly clearly. At this rate, you'll know my own belly better than I do..."
"Dr. Nanjo, you often tell patients at the table, 'We can see everything clearly; there's no need to worry.'"
"Hiroko! ...Of all times, now your memory is so good...!"

The deeper work continued. Sayaka's cries gradually grew less frequent, but not because the pain had gone away. She could only focus on regulating her breathing, one breath at a time; whenever the pulling sensation suddenly intensified, she stopped mid-sentence, barely managing to ask about their progress once she recovered.
"...You must have found the appendix by now, right? Don't tell me it's still playing hide-and-seek in there. Please..."
"We've found it. We're working on it now."
"Really? Then hurry... When I used to explain this step to patients, I never imagined I'd be so happy to hear 'we found it'..."
"Sakaguchi, the position looks good. Continue as planned."

Sakaguchi and Miyama confirmed the local conditions, completed the separation and removal of the appendix, and made a final inspection of the surgical site. Hiroko put away the removed tissue and continued assisting with the procedure.
"Ah... thank goodness. Wait... does that mean we can finish now?"
"Not yet. We still need to close the incision."

The appendix had been removed, and Sakaguchi began carefully closing the incision. Miyama assisted steadily, while Hiroko passed instruments in rhythm. Sayaka had thought the worst was over, but the continuing pain of suturing made her squeeze her eyes shut again and again. Even when she wanted to speak, she had to regulate her breathing first.
"Still... still not done? Haven't you taken the appendix out..."
"Removing it is one thing. Properly closing the incision is another."
"But... removing the appendix didn't seem to take this long... Why does sewing it up take so much time..."
"Dr. Nanjo, of course we have to clean up properly after the procedure."
"Hiroko... could you say something to cheer me up..."
"Dr. Nanjo, we're almost done! The previous part went very smoothly!"
"Moe... all I want to hear now is 'you can get off the table.' Ask Sakaguchi for me... how much longer?"
"Huh?! But I'm circulating. I can't tell the lead surgeon to suture faster!"
"Don't rush. Taking care with the incision now will save trouble later."
"I know, I know... Those words made so much sense when I was standing beside the table. But now... every sentence makes me want to cry..."
"Dr. Nanjo has a lot of new opinions about our work today."
"Next time you tell a patient 'almost done,' I'll definitely add on their behalf... 'there's still a lot of suturing left'..."
"Then I won't bring you into the OR next time."
"You wouldn't dare! ...Mm, don't make me laugh... Even laughing hurts now..."

She finally lacked the strength to keep asking questions and could only blink slowly at the surgical lights. The incision was still being finished step by step; Miyama helped Sakaguchi with the final check, Hiroko completed the instrument count, and Moe filled out the records. Hearing those familiar sounds of work, Sayaka knew the end was near, but she still had to endure this last difficult stretch.
"Incision closure complete. No additional steps are needed."
Sayaka stared at the surgical lights for a full two seconds before she seemed to understand. She let out a long breath, though the corners of her eyes were still damp from the tension.
"...Ah... thank goodness. You finally decided to let me off this table..."
"You've worked hard today, Dr. Nanjo. We'll arrange for you to rest in the ward."
"Hiroko, this is the first time in my life that 'back to the ward' has sounded so wonderful."
Sakaguchi stepped back slightly to let the nurses finish the postoperative care. Sayaka turned toward him, her voice subdued with exhaustion.
"You really did finish the operation on me."
"You were the one who came to me with the consent form."
"I know... I just wanted to say, you did a good job. Though I'll probably hear Hiroko passing you instruments in my dreams tonight."
"Will you still be able to yell at me tomorrow?"
"We'll see tomorrow... Right now, I need to get some sleep."
Sayaka closed her eyes, then immediately opened them again as if she'd suddenly remembered something.
"...Also, don't tell anyone else at the hospital how loudly I yelled on the table just now."
"I have no interest in publicizing a colleague's reactions during surgery."
"Don't worry. We remember what happened tonight, but we won't turn it into a joke over tea."
Moe and Hiroko began preparing for transport. Sakaguchi took one last look at Sayaka. She was too tired to argue with him again and only waved the fingers of one hand that she could still move.
The operating room door closed softly behind the transport bed. The surgical lights went out one by one, and the strange, long night finally came to an end.
The next morning, Sakaguchi walked down the corridor carrying a medical chart. A familiar voice called out to him from behind.
"Sakaguchi! Wait, I was just looking for you."

Sakaguchi turned around. Sayaka wore a neat white coat, her long hair draped over her shoulders, and carried a freshly organized chart. She looked bright and cheerful, as though yesterday had been an ordinary day on call.
"Of course. I have patients to see today. Did you think I'd stay home hugging a pillow for three days because of yesterday's operation?"
"I just wanted to make sure the woman who yelled loud enough for the whole OR to hear yesterday really is the same energetic doctor I'm looking at today."
"...Ah! Why are you still bringing that up!"
The tips of Sayaka's ears turned red. She looked around to make sure nobody familiar was nearby, then glared at Sakaguchi indignantly.
"You promised not to tease me about that. Besides, who wouldn't cry out a little the first time lying on an operating table?"
"...Takashi Sakaguchi, you are really asking for a beating right now."
"All right, I won't tease you anymore. How are you feeling?"
She was about to keep arguing, but at that question she actually thought for a moment.

"Honestly, during the preparation yesterday I was already wondering if I'd been too impulsive. Later, when you actually stood beside me holding the knife, I almost forgot all the things I'd bragged to you about."
"That's why I told you you were taking this too lightly."
"Yes, yes. But... I won't forget the feeling. I used to know how to do everything. Now I remember what it felt like lying on the table, looking at the surgical lights and listening to you all talk."
"I said don't decide so quickly for me. You weren't the one lying there. Yesterday was exhausting, but I never said I absolutely wouldn't want to try again."
"Hehe, who knows? This time I understand much more clearly what I'm agreeing to."
She leaned a little closer and suddenly gave Sakaguchi a smile that made him feel uneasy.
"Oh, I do have a new idea. Next time you operate on me, how about not draping me?"

"Hehe, I just want to see. If you have to operate on your girlfriend with nothing covering her, can you stay as calm as you were yesterday? Maybe you'll blush and your hand holding the scalpel will start shaking!"
"That's enough! I'm operating on you, not taking a test of my self-control!"
"Oh, don't be so serious. Weren't you the one worried last time that I'd throw you off and affect your work?"
"Of course! And I remember exactly how you complimented me yesterday too."
Just then, light footsteps sounded from the other end of the corridor. Hiroko Sugimura was walking toward them with a medical chart in her arms.
They both fell silent at almost the same time. Sayaka quickly covered her smile with one hand, while Sakaguchi turned his face away and tried to look as if they had only been discussing work.
"...What's going on? You two look cheerful."
"N-Nothing! We were just talking about how smoothly yesterday's operation went!"
"That's good. Dr. Nanjo, you look well today. I'm relieved."
"Mm! Thanks for all your hard work yesterday, Hiroko. Next time—ah, no, I mean, I look forward to working with you again!"
Hiroko tilted her head slightly, then smiled and nodded before continuing toward the ward with the chart in her arms.
After Hiroko had gone, Sayaka and Sakaguchi looked at each other and finally laughed together.
"That's because you kept teasing me! Haha... Oh, yesterday I was so scared on the table, and today I'm saying things like this to you."
"Thank you for really completing the operation on me yesterday. Next time, let me choose the procedure carefully first, okay?"
"All right! See you after work, Dr. Sakaguchi."

Sayaka smiled and turned away, returning to the busy hospital. The hem of her white coat swayed as she walked. Watching her go, Sakaguchi remembered the 'Ms. Nanjo' on the operating table yesterday, flushed and complaining nonstop, and could only shake his head helplessly.

Sayaka's voice drifted from the other side of the corridor as she spoke with a patient. She had fully returned to her post, and last night's outrageous, unforgettable secret remained between the two of them.

A few days later, after returning from the treatment area that morning, Sakaguchi received a summons to the director's office. The notice listed five names: Sakaguchi, Sayaka Nanjo, Kaori Miyama, Hiroko Sugimura, and Moe Honjo.
"...All five of us together? What kind of meeting is the director calling?"
When Sakaguchi reached the corner of the corridor, he found the other four already waiting. Sayaka, who usually loved to crack a joke first, was only staring at the notice this time.
"Sakaguchi... Did the director tell you why we're being called in?"
Miyama folded the notice and put it back in her white coat pocket. Hiroko sighed softly. Only Moe finally seemed unable to hold back.
"N-Nurse Sugimura... Aren't all five of us on the surgical team from that night?"
"Don't scare yourself yet. Let's go in and hear what the director has to say."
"Hearing that from you doesn't sound at all like you're not worried yourself."
Sayaka looked at Miyama, then at Hiroko. She opened her mouth, but in the end said nothing.
The five walked to the director's office. Sakaguchi raised his hand and knocked. From inside, Asuka answered cheerfully.
Asuka sat behind her desk, a surgical record spread open across it. She looked up, saw all five enter together, and warmly waved them over.
"Oh, everyone's here! Come stand over here. There's something I'd like to ask you about today."
Sakaguchi stood at the front, with Sayaka beside him. Miyama, Hiroko, and Moe stood behind them. No one rushed to speak.
"That open appendectomy a few days ago... The patient was Dr. Nanjo, right?"
None of the five said a word. Moe quietly moved half a step closer to Hiroko, while Miyama stared expressionlessly at the surgical record on the desk.
"I read the record from beginning to end. I called you all here today because I want to talk about that properly."
The office fell silent again. Sakaguchi could even hear the wall clock ticking.
Sayaka finally took one step forward.

"I've always wanted to experience being a patient for myself, and I also wanted to give Sakaguchi some practice. I brought the consent form myself and signed it myself! Sakaguchi didn't ask me to have surgery, and Kaori or Hiroko didn't force me into it either."
She spoke quickly, as if someone might admit fault before her if she slowed down.
"So if the hospital thinks this was inappropriate, blame me first. I asked the others to help. Please don't make everyone else get scolded because of my idea alone."
After she finished, Sayaka lowered her head. Sakaguchi, who had been standing straight, reached out and placed a hand on her shoulder.
"Sayaka, don't try to say everything on your own. I made the decision to actually operate. I'm the lead surgeon."
"I was the first assistant. We confirmed the procedure, patient identity, and preoperative arrangements. The operation itself went according to plan, with no technical problems."
"The consent form, preoperative preparation, instrument counts, and nursing records are all there. The process... was mostly handled like a normal operation."
"I-I followed the preparation checklist item by item too! I didn't miss anything! If something was wrong, I can bring you all the records!"
All four spoke at once, then suddenly stopped together. Asuka simply looked at them and blinked.
"Director, I know what you're thinking. Dr. Nanjo was healthy and had no medical reason to have her appendix removed. And yet we really did arrange an open operation for her."
"...And we never reported it to the hospital or asked for approval beforehand."
Sakaguchi fell silent. Miyama slowly turned her gaze toward the window. Moe stood even straighter, as if waiting for the final decision.
"...But why are all of you so nervous?"
"...Director. We performed a formal operation on a female colleague who had absolutely no need for surgery, without authorization."
"Then you called all five of us here together..."
"Because I wanted to ask whether we could do this better next time!"
This time, all five of them froze.
"After reading the surgical record, the first thing I thought of was actually something else."
"How come Hoshimi never thought of such a good surgical training opportunity before?"
Sakaguchi opened his mouth, but couldn't manage a reply.
"Director... Is that the main point you wanted to make?"

"Of course! Dr. Sakaguchi had a chance to practice a complete routine operation; Dr. Nanjo experienced things from the patient's perspective that she had previously only known how to explain; and the three of you carried out the team coordination carefully."
"And the operation went beautifully. Dr. Nanjo came back to work full of energy the next day. I even saw her chatting with patients in the corridor!"
"Of course. I also wanted to ask you: how did it feel to lie on the operating table yourself?"
Sayaka's face slowly reddened. A few days ago she had loudly declared that surgery was no big deal. Now, asked directly by the director, she found herself at a loss for words.
"It was... really special. The preparation was much more complicated than I imagined, and the operation itself was no walk in the park... but it was definitely an experience I'd never had before."
"...Wait. Director, do you mean you're not going to discipline us?"

"I didn't say there was nothing to improve about how you arranged things this time. Scheduling the operating room and team without reporting it to the hospital first obviously can't become the normal procedure."
Asuka closed the surgical record. Her tone was still gentle, but had grown more serious.
"But I also don't want to treat a successful, good idea as something everyone should simply be blamed for. If Hoshimi can do this so well, why not formalize it?"
"Director, do you mean that staff could apply to become training patients in the future?"

"Mm! I want us to try it as a formal program. The participating staff would decide on the plan in advance, the hospital would approve the procedure and team, and then a qualified doctor would lead the operation. We can't do it like this time, where management only finds out halfway through."
"...At the very least, it needs to be approved before the operation is scheduled."
"Exactly. Kaori, you put it very clearly!"
Miyama had clearly not expected her summary to earn praise, and paused slightly.
"Director, does that mean we're really not here to be disciplined today?"
"Hehe, of course not. Moe, why are you even more nervous today than you were while preparing for the operation?"
"B-Because Dr. Nanjo kept saying how excited she was, so I prepared everything very seriously too... The more I thought about it afterward, the more I realized it seemed like a pretty big deal..."
"Dr. Sakaguchi, I have made my decision official: starting today, the hospital approves you to conduct Staff-as-Patient surgical training."
"Of course. But this is an official hospital program, not an arrangement the five of you can improvise one evening and secretly put someone on an operating table for."
"So every operation like this has to go through internal review and scheduling first?"
"That's right. We need to know in advance who will participate, what procedure is planned, and how the team will be arranged. Preparation can begin only after the formal approval is complete."
"A plan approved by the hospital is not the same as the operation we arranged on our own last time."
"...Wait a second. Director, does that mean I didn't just cause trouble that day—I helped the hospital get this started?"
"Hehe, you could put it that way. But that was a very bold first arrangement, so come ask me before you do it next time."
"Yes! Next time I'll submit an application first!"
Asuka picked up a pen and wrote a few words on a memo sheet beside her. As she wrote, she started smiling to herself.

"If more medical staff take part in the future, perhaps we can develop this into a formal teaching-surgery program. Young doctors need experience, and it's worth helping everyone understand the patient's side, too."
"Director, you really are thinking far ahead."
"Of course! Hoshimi Hospital should give patients excellent care and help young doctors become better surgeons. Why can't we do both?"
"...I feel like your philosophy as director is bolder than our surgical notes."
The atmosphere in the office finally relaxed completely. Asuka finished organizing the surgical record and was about to dismiss everyone when she suddenly turned back to one of its pages.
"Oh, right, Dr. Nanjo! One more question. That appendectomy... you really didn't use anesthesia at all?"
"My, didn't that save a lot of trouble? Preparing, using, and managing the anesthetic must have been much simpler, right?"
"D-Director! Don't make that face! Please don't come up with another crazy idea!"
"That's exactly why I'm even more worried!"
"...I think I know what Kaori's worried about."
"Hehe, I'm just curious. Sayaka, without anesthesia, what did that first incision actually feel like?"
"...Director, you really want to ask that? I told Sakaguchi at the time it should feel about like cutting your finger while cooking..."
"Afterward... when the first incision was actually made, I realized it was nothing like that. My mind went completely blank. I was too overwhelmed even to notice how loudly I was screaming..."
"Wow! I see! And what about the traction? After you found the appendix? What did the suturing feel like?"
"...Director, do you really want me to describe the whole thing from beginning to end?!"
"Mm-hm! It was such an unusual experience; of course I want to hear all about it!"

Asuka turned out to be far more interested in Sayaka's unanesthetized operation than anyone could have expected. From the first incision to the traction during surgery and the long suturing, she asked about almost every stage. Blushing, Sayaka had to recount the entire patient experience of that night for a full hour.
By the time Asuka finally closed the record, satisfied, the five of them realized they had spent far longer in the director's office than expected.

"Hehe, today was very informative. All right, now this meeting is really over! If you have an idea in the future, come talk to me first instead of explaining after you've already done it. Thank you, everyone!"
The director's office door closed softly behind the five of them. They had walked several paces down the corridor before anyone spoke.
"...We really don't have to write an apology report?"
"...The director made that very clear just now."
"I was already preparing to go back and put together an explanatory report. I really didn't expect this..."
"I thought at the very least the director would give us a severe reprimand this time."
"Oh, come on! You were all so solemn just now, I thought my entire career was about to go down with yours!"
"When you were the first to step forward and take the blame, I nearly jumped out of my skin too."
"Well, that's because... it was my idea in the first place. I couldn't let everyone get scolded because of me."
"Dr. Nanjo, thank you for all your hard work this time. If we arrange another one, remember to apply to the director first."
"I know! ...Hm? Hiroko, did you just say 'another one,' too?"
"But with the formal approval, could I help prepare an operation like that in the future, too?"
"Only after you've taken care of your regular nursing duties."
At last, the group couldn't help laughing. Hiroko checked the time and reminded everyone to return to their posts. Miyama and Moe headed toward the work area first.
Only Sakaguchi and Sayaka remained in the corridor. Sayaka suddenly slowed her pace and glanced sideways at him.
"Hey, Sakaguchi. Now even the director has approved it. You can officially ask your colleagues to be training patients now."
"Don't make it sound like I'm planning to invite them one by one. Just dealing with you has already given me enough trouble."
"Hehe, you were the one who ran into me first. But... if you really need practice, I'm still happy to help."
"Can't you give me a moment to process the fact that the director actually approved this?"
"Sure. I'll give you until this afternoon to process it. Patients are waiting for you tonight, Dr. Sakaguchi."
Sayaka winked at him and set off again. A patient called to her from the end of the corridor. Her professional manner returned at once as she went over to ask what was wrong.
...What kind of hospital did I end up working at?

Watching her return to her daily work, Sakaguchi finally shook his head with a smile. The director's decision had been entered into the hospital records, and the absurd appendectomy from a few days earlier had truly become a precedent at Hoshimi Hospital.
strings.collections.special_event_steps.sayaka_s: At nine in the morning, Sakaguchi runs into Sayaka in the corridor as she checks the ward records.
Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi! Let's both do our best today!
By the way, that appendectomy last week... Are you really feeling no effects at all now?
Oh, that? I'm completely fine! The very next day, I couldn't even see the incision anymore!
That's right! Not even a scar. You're pretty good at this, you know!
W-wait. That was an open appendectomy! There were so many layers of tissue beneath the skin!
I know. Sakaguchi, you performed the operation yourself, so why are you asking me to explain it?
I am... Why? Are you asking me out?
No. Could you get an abdominal ultrasound in Imaging later?
I want to see how things have healed inside. I can't see a wound on the outside, but I'm still not at ease.
Sure! Hehe, since Dr. Sakaguchi is so worried about me, of course I'll cooperate!
I'll head over once I'm done with what I'm doing. I'll come find you after the scan!
Sayaka waves with a smile, then turns to leave.
Sakaguchi watches her go, momentarily lost in thought.
...The scar was gone by the very next day? What kind of recovery rate is that...?
That afternoon, Sayaka has the abdominal ultrasound as planned.
At nine in the morning, Sakaguchi has been staring at yesterday's abdominal ultrasound report at his desk for quite some time.
Good morning! How did yesterday's scan turn out? Has everything healed beautifully?
I want to confirm something with you first.
What is it? You sound so serious.
About that operation last time... We did remove your appendix, right?
Of course! Didn't you write the operative report yourself? You put me through quite a lot!
The specimen we removed was sent to pathology, too.
...Then can you explain why yesterday's ultrasound showed your perfectly healthy appendix again?
Sayaka walks over to Sakaguchi and bends down to peer at the computer screen.
This is a little beyond 'healed really well,' isn't it?!
Oh, Sakaguchi, why are you making such a fuss?
Sayaka! We removed it with our own hands! And now it's back, perfectly healthy, as if it had never been operated on! That makes no sense!
Hehe, why are you still hung up on that? Didn't I tell you already?
This is anime logic! Anime logic! Don't take it so seriously!
...I'm starting to wonder whether I'm even a doctor.
Oh, don't worry. There's nothing wrong with your surgical skills. You really did remove my appendix that day—I saw it with my own eyes!
Sayaka puffs her cheeks a little.
But don't get the wrong idea! Sure, my appendix grew back, but having you operate on me that day really hurt! Don't tease me for crying out so loudly again!
Sakaguchi silently looks back at the report.
...So you're saying you could even have another appendectomy?
Hey! Why are you suddenly thinking along those lines?!
No, I just want to make sure... If even an appendix can grow back, then in theory, could other operations also...?
Oh, of course they could! I told you, this is anime logic!
Sayaka suddenly smiles as if a thought has occurred to her.
Although, if I can, next time I'd like to try a different procedure!
...You're already thinking about the next one?
She remembers the last operation, and her smile suddenly turns a little strained.
But next time... please be gentler, or maybe give me some anesthesia?
But preferably not general anesthesia. I don't want to fall asleep and miss everything.
...I need a moment to process this.
At nine in the morning, Sakaguchi has just entered the hospital lobby when he sees Asuka making her rounds.
Oh, Dr. Sakaguchi! Good morning! Let's do our best today, too!
Good morning, Director. Oh, right—there's something I've been meaning to tell you.
It's about that appendectomy we performed on Dr. Nanjo without approval from the hospital administration.
Oh, that! What about it? She recovered well, didn't she? I see Sayaka coming to work in great spirits every day!
...Director, this isn't a question of whether she recovered well.
I just looked at her abdominal ultrasound. Her appendix... has grown back.
And it looks completely normal, as if she'd never had surgery! I'm certain we removed it that day, and the pathology specimen—
Yes! Doesn't that make the surgical practice we discussed even more worthwhile?
Think about it. If even a removed organ can recover, young doctors will have more chances to practice all kinds of procedures!
Director, I don't think that's the issue here...
Asuka continues speaking, brimming with enthusiasm.
Hehe, our hospital has so many young, healthy doctors and nurses! If everyone helps each other practice, our surgical skills will improve in no time!
...How have you already started thinking about the next operation, too?
Hm? Isn't that a good thing? To train excellent young doctors, of course we should create more opportunities for everyone to practice!
For a moment, Sakaguchi doesn't know how to respond.
Just then, Hiroko Sugimura passes by them carrying a ward document.
Hiroko gives a small bow and is about to continue on her way.
Asuka suddenly remembers something and turns to look at Hiroko.
You see, Dr. Sakaguchi? Nurse Sugimura is always so energetic, and she looks especially healthy, too!
She seems like a perfect fit!
Asuka turns and winks at Sakaguchi with a knowing smile.
Director? What do you mean... a perfect fit for what?

strings.collections.staff.nurse_ishigami.persona: A cool, taciturn and highly observant Head of Nursing. She almost never raises her voice, yet can restore order across the nursing service with a few calm words.

“Nursing supervision confirmed. I will not make medical judgments for you, and I will not allow the nursing side to run on overwork.”
“Who is treating the patient, who is calling support, and who is documenting? Say it clearly, then continue.”

“Something sounding frightening is not the same as something going wrong. If we need to stop, we will know before you do.”
“You really want to hear it? All right. Let us clear up the easiest parts to misunderstand before you are lying there pretending everything is fine.”
strings.collections.staff.nurse_rin.team_dialogu: “I’ll verify the ward handoff and transport documents. Dr. Sakaguchi, just make sure the first time you see the whole patient isn’t after she is already on the table.”

“Understood. I judged that step by an old habit, and I’ve corrected it. Keep going; I’ll complete the record.”

“One thing at a time. Who is treating the patient, who is calling for help, and who is documenting what happened? Don’t let everyone do the same job at once.”

Fully review both pedicles, cuff hemostasis, and support
“Understood. Continuing.”
“Please check once more.”
Complete hemostasis and cuff preparation as usual
“Understood. Continuing.”
Address the obvious problems and proceed to closure as soon as possible
“Understood. Continuing.”
The uterus has been removed. How thorough will you be before closure?
Pelvic Hemostasis / Cuff Support Review

`{assistant_name}` changes the retraction angle in sequence to bring both pedicles, the vaginal cuff, and the pelvic entry back into view, while `{scrub_name}` assists with irrigation, additional hemostasis, and suturing preparation. The focus now is to confirm that the cuff is stable and restore appropriate support for final closure.
The cuff / pedicles have been re-exposed and additional treatment completed.
Re-expose the cuff and corresponding pedicle, then complete additional hemostasis / revision
“Understood. Continuing.”
“Please check once more.”
Treat only the most obvious problem, then continue closure
“Understood. Continuing.”
Additional treatment is needed.
Re-exposure of the Cuff / Pedicles

Before closure, one pedicle or part of the cuff remains less than satisfactory. `{assistant_name}` re-establishes deep exposure in the corresponding direction, while `{scrub_name}` prepares additional hemostatic and suturing materials; `{circulator_name}` records the extra treatment time.
Vaginal exposure and cervical traction have been established.
Confirm the approach and begin the operation
“Understood. Continuing.”
Stable exposure of the cervix has been established. Confirm the approach and begin the total vaginal hysterectomy.
Vaginal Exposure / Cervical Traction

Once vaginal exposure is established, `{assistant_name}` maintains downward traction on the cervix, while `{scrub_name}` prepares incision, retraction, and hemostatic instruments for the vaginal approach in sequence; `{circulator_name}` checks positioning, lighting, and records outside the sterile field. The total hysterectomy proceeds upward from around the cervix.
The posterior fornix has been opened and posterior pelvic entry established.
Fully establish posterior entry
“Understood. Continuing.”
The current entry is sufficient; continue
“Understood. Continuing.”
The posterior plane is identifiable. Will you fully open the posterior fornix before proceeding to the deep structures?
Posterior Fornix Entry / Establishing the Posterior Operative Field

As posterior dissection continues, `{assistant_name}` adjusts the direction of the cervix to keep the posterior fornix and posterior pelvic entry clearly visible, while `{scrub_name}` prepares long-handled retractors and suction instruments. Once posterior entry is established, the deep supporting structures can be brought into reach more easily, step by step.
The uterosacral and cardinal ligament pedicles have been managed, allowing greater uterine descent.
Control the uterosacral / cardinal ligament pedicles group by group, gaining descent as you proceed
“Understood. Continuing.”
Manage the pedicles on both sides continuously at a normal pace
“Understood. Continuing.”
Reduce interim adjustments and advance upward quickly
“Understood. Continuing.”
The uterine supporting structures are gradually coming within the vaginal approach. How will you control these pedicles as you proceed upward?
Uterosacral / Cardinal Ligament Pedicle Management

As the cervix becomes more mobile, `{assistant_name}` maintains steady downward traction to bring the uterosacral and cardinal ligament regions on both sides into view in sequence; `{scrub_name}` continuously supplies ligation, clamping, and hemostatic materials. Each group of pedicles treated allows the uterus to descend further.
The upper pedicles have been managed and the adnexa preserved as planned by default.
Confirm the adnexal relationships on each side before completing upper pedicle control
“Understood. Continuing.”
Complete upper pedicle management at a standard pace
“Understood. Continuing.”
“Please check once more.”
Use the descent already achieved to divide the upper attachments quickly
“Understood. Continuing.”
The uterus has descended considerably. How will you divide the upper attachments while maintaining the relationships of the adnexa being preserved?
Upper Pedicle Management / Ovarian Preservation

Once the lower and lateral supports have been released, the uterus can be drawn further toward the vaginal opening. `{assistant_name}` exposes the upper pedicles in sequence, while `{scrub_name}` prepares ligation and hemostatic materials. The default case preserves the ovaries, so the relationships of the adnexa being retained must remain clear while the uterine attachments are divided.
Uterine vessel control is complete.
Reconfirm the vascular pedicle positions and establish control step by step
“Understood. Continuing.”
Complete uterine vessel control at a standard pace
“Understood. Continuing.”
“Please check once more.”
Manage the vessels quickly using the current exposure
“Understood. Continuing.”
The uterine vascular pedicles are now within reach. What pace will you use to complete control?
Uterine Vessel Control

`{assistant_name}` stabilizes tension between the cervix and sidewall to keep the uterine vessel area as clear as possible, while `{scrub_name}` prepares vascular control and additional hemostatic instruments. This stage places the greatest bleeding pressure on the team during the total vaginal hysterectomy.
The uterus has been removed vaginally and the specimen handed off.
Remove the uterine specimen and proceed to cuff management
“Understood. Continuing.”
The uterus is fully mobilized. Confirm removal and proceed to vaginal cuff management.
Uterine Removal / Specimen Handoff

After the final upper attachments are divided, the uterus is removed intact through the vagina. `{scrub_name}` receives the specimen and hands it to `{circulator_name}` for verification outside the sterile field and documentation for submission; `{assistant_name}` immediately re-exposes the vaginal cuff and pedicles on both sides.
