strings.patient_bundles.patient_emi_koda.patient: Emi Koda
I don't usually have any serious illnesses, and I'm not aware of any drug allergies.
Um… I suddenly fainted at work, and I haven't felt quite right since.
I'll try to explain clearly… Please let me know if I'm not explaining it well enough.
And… I don't want this to cause trouble for my colleagues or our customers.
"With general anesthesia… at least I won't embarrass myself in front of everyone, will I…?"
"I understand… If I can't stop trembling, please tell me what to do. I'm not trying to be uncooperative."
"I'm sorry… Does no anesthesia mean I'll be awake and feel you making the incision…? Is that right?"
"A-are we past the hardest part already…? Thank you… I must have made such a scene just now…"
"Yes… I'll try not to move. B-but my hands keep shaking… Please don't misunderstand; I really am trying…"
"Thank you for explaining everything so carefully… Um, please tell me directly whenever you need my cooperation. I'll do my best."
"Hospitalization… I see. May I ask how much time I'll need to take off…? I don't want to cause the company any more trouble."
"All right, I understand… I'm supposed to be the one looking after others, but now so many people are looking after me. I feel terribly sorry about that."
"Aah—!! It hurts—it hurts so much! W-wait…! I'm sorry, I-I couldn't help crying out… Ah!"
"Thank you, Dr. Sakaguchi… I'll try to relax. I hope I won't cause everyone any more trouble once I'm asleep…"
"N-no…! I'm sorry, I know everyone's already prepared, but… I really can't face being cut like this…!"
"I'll do my best to cooperate… But if I get too nervous, please don't think I'm being difficult…"
"P-please wait, Dr. Sakaguchi… That doesn't seem to be the same surgical site you explained to me earlier… Has there been a mistake?"

"The line you're drawing now… Is that where you're going to cut without anesthesia…? A-are we really going to start like this…?" (Drawing an incision line on unanesthetized flesh... Is a raw scalpel really slicing here next?!)
"Wait… Let me look at it once more… Are you about to cut here? I-I'm not ready yet…!" (I just saw the nurse hand over the scalpel... Give me three seconds to breathe, I'm terrified!)
"This position… Do I have to stay like this for a long time? I-I'll try to do as you ask…" (Wrists and ankles buckled into the straps... I can't even lift a hand to cover myself!)

"I'm sorry, I'm a little nervous… I used to remind customers to keep their footing, and now I'm not even sure how I'm supposed to lie down…" (Everyone is looking down around the table checking my body—I'm clenching my toes in shame...)

"W-wait… You're going to secure me like this before I've had any anesthesia…? I'll try not to move, but I'm already trembling…" (Strapping all four limbs down without a drop of anesthesia... I can't even writhe when the blade cuts?!)

"P-please wait… If it really hurts when you make the incision, will I be able to stay in this position the whole time…?" (No anesthesia and strapped wide open like this... Can I really survive what's coming...?!)

"The urinary catheter… Does it go in through there…? I understand it's necessary, but… I'm really embarrassed…" (Before the scalpel even starts, I have to spread my legs under the lamp for a catheter...!)
"I'll cooperate… But could you please not keep looking at me…? I'm sorry, I know you're doing your job…" (Warm urine is flowing out through clear tubing while I'm wide awake to feel every second...!)

"W-wait…! Are you really going to insert the urinary catheter while I'm completely awake…? I-I'm so scared…!" (Shoving a catheter straight in without anesthesia... That searing sting nearly made me scream!)
"Ah…! P-please be gentle… I know I shouldn't move, but this feeling… I really can't pretend I'm all right…!" (It's throbbing raw inside me—I don't even dare twitch my hips a fraction of an inch...!)
"An e-enema… Are you going to do it here? I'm sorry… I-I'm not quite sure what to do…" (As warm water rushes into my belly, my whole face feels hot enough to catch fire...!)

"U-um… May I ask, will the nurse stay beside me the whole time…? I've never had this kind of preparation done in front of anyone before…" (My insides are churning like crazy and I have to clench hard in front of everyone... This is torture!)

“Huh... this procedure didn't actually require an enema...?! B-but you already made me pull my panties down and pumped my belly full of fluid...!” (Made to bare my backside for nothing, and my lower belly is still aching and full...!)

“Pumped full even though it wasn't required... With my belly churning like this, I haven't the strength left to keep my composure...” (My stomach is churning so hard I can barely hold it in—all that humiliation for nothing...!)

"Skin preparation… Does that mean shaving the hair there too…? I'm sorry, I'm not trying to get in the way of the preparations…" (Feeling the blade glide across such tender skin has me too scared even to breathe...!)
"I have to uncover this part too…? I-I know it's needed for surgery, but… Please give me a moment…" (Shaved completely bare down there—even shifting an inch feels chilly and strange...)

“Huh... that area wasn't actually inside the required prep field...?! Yet you already shaved away all the hair there... i-it's so embarrassing...” (Shaved completely smooth where the scalpel won't even touch—the draft down there is mortifying...!)

“Even private parts that needed no shaving are completely bare now... It feels so drafty below I barely dare press my legs together...” (Bare skin touches directly whenever I close my legs—it feels so weird I can barely sit still...!)
"The cap… Thank you. Now I really do look like a patient who's about to have surgery…" (Even the last lock of hair hiding my face is tucked away—I'm really about to go under the knife...)

"I just need to tuck all my hair inside…? All right… I normally take such care with my appearance at work. Things are completely different now…" (Seeing the gurney waiting right beside the bed, my palms are already slick with cold sweat...)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_iwai_yoshimi.pat: Yoshimi Iwai

I work as a nurse at another hospital. It's not that I don't trust my coworkers there... It's just so embarrassing to imagine the people I work alongside every day caring for me if I need an examination with my clothes off, an admission, or even surgery. That's why I chose Hoshimi.
Um, Doctor... I came in today because: {line}
The most noticeable discomfort is: {line}... I'll do my best to explain clearly.
There's one more thing. Please make a note of this too: {line}
"I really can't lift my legs anymore... Thank you for positioning them for me. I know it's the anesthetic, but I'm still a little panicked."
"Okay, I'll stay still... Ah, I jumped when you steadied me. Sorry—I'll do as you say."
"You're going to secure me already...? I know it's so I won't move, but without anesthesia, I'm afraid I won't be able to hold still when it hurts..."
"Is that all...? I know everyone is busy, but could you tell me a little more about how we'll begin? Sorry, I can't quite sit still."
"With an epidural, I'll stay awake the whole time, right? I know a little about nursing... but the thought of not being able to move my legs still worries me."
"General anesthesia... I always tell patients they'll sleep through it and it'll be over. But when I'm the one who's really going to fall asleep... I'm still a little scared."
"Local anesthesia—I understand. I'll try to stay still, and if I feel discomfort deeper inside, I'll be sure to tell you."
"N-no anesthesia at all?!... I know exactly what you're saying, and that's why I'm even more frightened... Are we really going to operate like this?"
"Okay... breathe slowly. I remember. I've taught this to so many people, but doing it myself is surprisingly difficult..."
"It's really almost over...? That's wonderful... Thank you. When I return to work, I'll remember to comfort my patients properly too."
"...All right. I won't say anything for now. Knowing you're all still beside me makes me feel much safer..."
"Okay, I won't move... I know this is important, but my body keeps trembling... I'm sorry, I'm not doing it on purpose."
"Mm... You can continue. Please warn me before the next step, and I'll do my best to cooperate."
"D-did you stop...? Thank you... Please give me a moment to catch my breath. I'll try to steady myself again."
"That explanation makes me feel a little better. I used to explain things this way to patients... I didn't expect it to feel so nerve-racking to hear it myself."
"Will I need to be admitted...? I should ask someone to cover my shifts. Oh, sorry—why am I thinking about work again...? Doctor, about how many days would I be staying?"
"All right, I'll be admitted. I'm a nurse too, but this time I'm the patient... Please tell me everything just as you normally would, okay?"
"...Have you started cutting? It isn't a sharp pain, but that tugging feeling inside... I didn't know I'd feel it so clearly on the operating table..."
"Ah...! The outside doesn't seem to hurt, but that tug inside just now was really unpleasant... Doctor, how far along are you?"
"Aah—!! It hurts! W-wait...! I'm sorry, I can't take it... Doctor, it hurts so much...!"
"Thank you... I'll cooperate. Ah, why are my hands still shaking...? I won't cause any trouble once I'm asleep, will I...?"
"Doctor... I know you have to continue, but it really hurts...! I'm sorry—could you please listen to me for a moment...?"
"Thank you... I'll do my best to cooperate. I went out of my way not to come to a hospital where people know me, and I'm still blushing from nerves here... I'm sorry."
"Ah... you're looking at me. Thank you... I thought everyone was so focused on the operation that no one could hear me."
"Thank you for telling me how far you've gotten... I used to talk patients through things like this. Now I know how much it helps."
"Um... Doctor? Is something wrong...? I'm not trying to rush you—it's just that everyone suddenly went quiet, and I'm a little scared..."
"Huh...? Wait, I don't think that's the procedure you just explained to me. Could you check my chart once more, please?"

"The incision will be marked here... I understand why marking is important. Could you check that the anesthesia is working once more?" (It's only ink for now, yet that's the exact spot about to be cut open...)
"Seeing that line makes me even more nervous... Doctor, please tell me before you begin, all right?" (As long as the surgery goes safely... Deep breaths—don't start crying before the first cut...)

"That line... is where you'll cut me in a moment without any anesthesia...? I-I'm really scared..." (When even the marker nib feels this distinct, how am I supposed to endure a raw blade cutting in?!)

"Doctor, the knife hasn't even touched me, and I already want to run... I know I shouldn't move, but I'm so frightened..." (Squeezing my eyes shut and gritting my teeth, praying the first cut doesn't make me pass out...!)

"My arm goes here, and my legs need a slight adjustment... I understand. Please tell me before you position me, and I'll cooperate." (That click of the restraint strap is terrifying—I'm completely at their mercy now...)

"I know this position makes the operation easier... but having so many people adjust my body still makes me uncomfortable. I'm sorry..." (The cold pad presses against my back while every nervous breath stays in plain view...)

"You're securing my arms and legs before giving me anesthesia...? I know it's so I won't move, but I'm afraid I won't be able to control myself when it hurts..." (The second the straps cinch tight, the terror of being cut open raw nearly drives me mad!)

"Doctor, if I cry out loudly in a moment, please don't think I'm making trouble on purpose... I'm afraid I really won't be able to help it." (Cold sweat trickles down my temple; I can only pray these straps hold me through the first cut...)
"Ah, it's cold... Oh, it's the antiseptic, I know! It was such a sudden chill that I couldn't help flinching..." (Wet amber antiseptic covers the field, making every breath catch in my throat...)
"Mm, I won't move. I've had anesthesia, but I can still feel how cold the antiseptic is... That's strange." (With the monitor beeping this fast, there's no hiding how nervous I really am...)
"You've started disinfecting... Once you've finished, are you really going to begin cutting...?" (Shivering from the chill, knowing I'm about to take the knife wide awake and unnumbed...!)
"It's so cold... You haven't even made the incision, and I'm already trembling. Sorry, I'll try not to move..." (The monitor's beeping faster and faster—the whole OR can hear how terrified I am...!)

"A urinary catheter... Yes, I know what it's for. But lying here and waiting for someone to insert it... could you warn me first?" (Being parted and wiped down there just to have a tube pushed in—I've never felt this humiliated...!)

"I've explained this to patients so many times... I never expected to be the one lying here with my legs positioned, waiting for a catheter. I'm so nervous..." (Having a tube draining me right between my legs makes me want to keep my eyes shut forever...)

"Ah...! You're placing the catheter before anesthesia...? I'll do my best to cooperate. Please give me a moment to breathe..." (Tears sprang straight to my eyes—every millimeter feels like needles down there!)

"Ugh... It feels so uncomfortable...! I know it needs to stay in, but being awake makes every sensation so noticeable...!" (Even breathing makes the tube rub raw against the most sensitive spot—it hurts and it's mortifying!)

"An enema... usually I'm the one preparing patients on the ward, but lying on my side having the tube inserted and fluid pumped in leaves my belly hot and bloated, and I'm too ashamed to lift my head..." (I know it's standard prep, yet feeling that tip slip in makes me freeze up in shame...)

"I know how to cooperate with this preparation... Um, could I have another moment? Being the one receiving care feels more embarrassing than I expected." (Every ounce of strength is going into holding it in—even my voice is shaking...)

“Dr. Sakaguchi...! As a nurse I know perfectly well this procedure didn't need an enema—yet you still made me take the whole bag on my side...!” (Thinking how I didn't even need that enema makes my ears burn with embarrassment and frustration...!)

“Marked not applicable on the order sheet and I still got put through a full enema... My lower belly is cramping so hard I can barely hold on...!” (Still damp and cramping down there, and all of it was completely unnecessary... ugh!)

"The shaving goes this far...? Do you need to shave such a low area too? I understand it's for surgery, but... it's so embarrassing." (That soft scraping sound is way too loud in this quiet room—my face is burning up!)

"I usually tell patients not to be nervous... but when it's my turn to expose the area that needs shaving, my face still goes bright red." (Please stop parting it to check for missed spots—I'm already on the verge of tears...!)

“Wait, Dr. Sakaguchi! The incision isn't on my lower abdomen or perineum—why did you shave all my private hair off anyway?!” (Exposing my most private spot to be shaved for nothing—just thinking about it makes my ears burn...!)

“Left completely bare where no prep was needed... Just closing my legs presses bare skin straight together in mortification...!” (Breezy and bare without a single hair left, and all of it was completely unnecessary... ugh!)

"The cap needs to cover my hair and ears... Yes, I know. Ah, a little hair is still loose in the back. I'll tuck it in myself!" (With my forehead and ears completely exposed, even pretending to stay calm is hard...)

"The cap is on... I put them on patients all the time, but wearing one myself suddenly makes it feel like I'm really being wheeled into the operating room." (With every strand tucked inside, I'm officially nothing but a patient waiting for the blade...)

I work at a fisheries cooperative in Kyushu, and there's Suzume, whom I've looked after since she was little, at home. I'm used to taking care of work and household matters myself… But today I came to the hospital to take my own health seriously.
Doctor, please take a look at me first. The main reason I came in today is: {line}. I can manage things at home and work, but I can't handle this physical discomfort on my own.
The most noticeable discomfort is: {line}. Please ask me anything; I'll do my best to explain when it started and what it's like.
There's one more thing I'd like you to note: {line}. Could it be related to what I mentioned earlier?
“I really can't move my legs… Please help position them securely. Mm, I know it's the anesthesia, but not being able to adjust myself still makes me uneasy.”
“Is it all right to put my arm here? I can cooperate… Ah, please say something before you support me. You startled me just now.”
“You need to secure my arms and legs… I understand, so I won't jerk away when it hurts. But if I really can't take it, please listen to me.”
“Just ‘we'll proceed as planned’? How is that supposed to reassure me…? Sorry, I'm not trying to nitpick. Could you at least tell me what happens next?”
“An epidural means I'll stay conscious but won't be able to move freely… I understand, but just imagining it makes me a little anxious.”
“General anesthesia… So once I fall asleep, I'll really be leaving everything in your hands. Please tell me how the operation went as soon as I wake up, all right?”
“Local anesthesia, right? I'll try to stay still. If the pulling inside feels unpleasant, I'll tell you right away—just don't make me try to endure it in silence.”
“Wait… You're going to operate without any anesthesia? Doctor, it's not that I refuse treatment, but everything about this sounds frightening!”
“Okay, breathe in and out slowly… I'll follow along. It's easy to tell someone else what to do, but when I'm nervous I even need someone to teach me how to breathe.”
“It's almost over? …Thank goodness. A moment ago I was wondering why I had to be so useless when it was my turn… Thank you all for taking care of me.”
“…Mm, I heard you. I'll be quiet for a little while. Just knowing you're all still beside me already helps a lot.”
“I understand, I mustn't move… I'll try. But my body keeps trembling; I'm not doing it on purpose. Please understand.”
“Mm… I'm ready. You can continue. If the next step will be uncomfortable, please tell me beforehand.”
“…You stopped? Thank you. Let me catch my breath. I was trying so hard not to make a sound that I only panicked more…”
“Mm, now that you've explained it one step at a time, I understand. Thank you, Doctor. I know I ask a lot of questions, but that's better than worrying and guessing.”

“Hospitalization…? I understand we shouldn't put off dealing with our health. Doctor, about how long would I need to stay? I should ask for leave from the fisheries cooperative and let my family know.”
“All right, I'll follow the plan and be admitted. I know someone can help with things at home… It's just that I'm so used to taking care of everything myself that it's hard to let go all at once.”
“…Have you started already? It isn't a sharp cutting pain, but I can still feel the pressure and pulling inside… So this is what it's like…”
“Sss…! W-wait, the skin doesn't hurt much, but that tugging sensation inside just now… Doctor, is that normal?”
“Aah—!! It hurts! D-Doctor, wait! You're really cutting now… I can't take it, please stop for a moment…!”
“Okay… I've taken care of everything I needed to. Doctor, I'll leave the rest to you. …Funny, usually I'm the one telling everyone else not to worry. Today I can't seem to let go myself.”
“Ah… It hurts! N-no, I can't take that…! I know you're still operating, but could you please listen to me for a moment?”
“I understand. I'll cooperate. Don't worry, I'm usually pretty good at handling things… Sigh, today I really wish someone would tell me one more time not to be afraid.”
“Doctor… you're still looking at me. Mm, I'm all right… No, I'm still a little scared. Thank you for not only focusing on the operation.”
“Thank you for telling me what you've done so far. I always thought that having a plan was enough, but today I realize how reassuring it is to hear someone explain things clearly.”
“…Doctor? Why did everyone suddenly go quiet? You're busy, right…? Just say something back. It's making me so anxious over here.”
“Wait. The operation you just explained wasn't called this, was it? Sorry, please check the chart first. This is my body, so we can't be careless.”

“You're marking the incision here… Seeing the line makes it feel real. You've confirmed the anesthesia is working, right?” (That marker tip feels so vivid—knowing the scalpel will slice right along this line makes me panic...)
“I know marking it is necessary… Mm, I'll stay still. Just don't skip explaining the next step; I'll get scared.” (The line is longer than I pictured... Please be gentle when the blade comes down...)

“That line… is where you'll cut without anesthesia in a moment? …Doctor, I don't know if I can bear even thinking about it.” (Drawing an incision line on unanesthetized flesh... Is a raw scalpel really slicing here next?!)

“I can see it. The scalpel will cut along that line, right? P-please give me a moment… I'm already trembling so badly.” (I just saw the nurse hand over the scalpel... Give me three seconds to breathe, I'm terrified!)

“My shoulders go here, and my arms out… All right, I'll do that. It's just a little nerve-racking to have so many people adjusting my position at once.” (Wrists and ankles buckled into the straps... I can't even lift a hand to cover myself!)

“I have to be positioned this way, right? I understand it's for the operation. But could you tell me before you adjust my legs?” (Everyone is looking down around the table checking my body—I'm clenching my toes in shame...)

“You'll secure me in this position without anesthesia…? I understand why, but when it starts hurting, I don't know if I'll be able to keep still.” (Strapping all four limbs down without a drop of anesthesia... I can't even writhe when the blade cuts?!)

“Doctor, if I end up crying out loudly, please don't think I'm making trouble… I'll try to cooperate, but I'll be scared too.” (No anesthesia and strapped wide open like this... Can I really survive what's coming...?!)
“Ah, that's cold…! Oh, it's antiseptic. Even with the anesthesia, I can still feel how cold it is.” (That antiseptic is freezing! Swabbed across bare skin, it means the blade is moments away...)
“Mm, I won't move. It's just a little cold when you wipe it on… Sorry, I almost flinched.” (As the liquid evaporates and steals my warmth, I can't stop a faint shiver...)

“You're starting the antiseptic… So you'll really make the incision soon, right? I know we agreed, but my heart is beating faster and faster…” (If a cold sponge feels this sharp, how much will it hurt when the raw scalpel cuts me open?!)

“It's so cold… I haven't had any anesthesia at all. Doctor, please tell me before you actually begin.” (Watching the doctor's hand move toward the instrument tray makes me want to bolt right off the table!)

“A urinary catheter too… I understand. But that area will need to be exposed; could you give me a moment to prepare? It's a little embarrassing.” (Before the scalpel even starts, I have to spread my legs under the lamp for a catheter...!)

“Ah… So this is another thing someone else has to do for me. All right, I'll try not to move. Just tell me before you start.” (Warm urine is flowing out through clear tubing while I'm wide awake to feel every second...!)

“Wait, you're going to insert a catheter without any anesthesia…? I know I need to cooperate, but please warn me first!” (Shoving a catheter straight in without anesthesia... That searing sting nearly made me scream!)

“Ah…! That feels so uncomfortable… Doctor, I'm still awake; I can feel everything… Could you let me pause for a moment?” (It's throbbing raw inside me—I don't even dare twitch my hips a fraction of an inch...!)

“An enema is part of the preparation here too… I know it's a medical step. Um, could you close the curtain first? I'm not used to being looked after this way.” (Having my pants pulled down on the bed for a tube... I want to bury my face in the pillow!)

“I should lie on my side to cooperate, right? All right, I'll do it… But when it's my turn, even straightening my clothes makes me feel clumsy.” (Please stop timing me right beside the bed—if you keep watching, I won't last another minute...!)

“Kyaa... D-Doctor, this operation didn't even need an enema, so why make me undress and take a bellyful of warm water...?!” (It wasn't even required and yet my belly's pumped full of warm water... You did this on purpose!)

“Calling it safer just to put me through all that embarrassment for nothing... My stomach is churning so hard I can barely hold it...!” (Humiliated like that for no reason—I can't even bring myself to look the doctor in the eye...)

“Skin preparation… Do you need to shave that far down? Mm, I know it's for the operation, but I'm still embarrassed to have someone do it while watching.” (Having to spread my legs so they can shave right down there... I'm curling my toes in mortification!)

“W-wait, don't pull the blanket all the way off at once! Tell me which area you're preparing first, and I'll uncover it for you.” (Bare skin brushing directly against the sheet feels so cold and sensitive it makes my heart race...)
“Mm...! The cut isn't down there, so why did you shave my private hair completely clean too...?!” (The incision isn't even down there, yet you made me spread my legs and shaved me bare... So unfair!)

“Shaved bare somewhere that needed no touching... Every brush of the sheet down there feels unbearably embarrassing...” (Clutching my gown hem and scared to move—they saw and shaved every last bit of me for nothing...)

“My hair and ears both need to be tucked completely inside? All right, I'll tuck the ends in at the back… Now I finally look like a real surgical patient.” (Even the last lock of hair hiding my face is tucked away—I'm really about to go under the knife...)

“Usually I'm the one reminding my family to get ready before we go out. Today it's the nurse checking my cap… Mm, could you take another look?” (Seeing the gurney waiting right beside the bed, my palms are already slick with cold sweat...)

I work in pharmacology and drug-safety research at a pharmaceutical research institute. I'm used to analyzing data and adverse reactions... but my own body won't obediently follow an experimental plan.
Doctor, please hear me out first. The symptom that concerns me today is: {line}
The most noticeable change is this: {line}
There's one more thing I'd like you to note: {line}
"My legs aren't responding very well... Please help keep me in position. Even knowing the mechanism, it still feels strange."
"Thank you, just steady me a little... My hands are shaking. Please don't mistake that for me refusing to cooperate."
"Ah...! Don't suddenly hold me down! I know I shouldn't move, but without anesthesia my body really does try to pull away!"
"Just 'follow the usual process'? If a research report were written that way, it would never pass review. Could you explain a little more?"
"An epidural... I understand how it works, but being awake while unable to move freely probably won't feel as easy as it sounds in a lecture."
"General anesthesia... I know the medication will make me lose consciousness. Still, actually entrusting myself to that blank stretch of time feels unreal."
"Local anesthesia? Deep traction may still be noticeable. I'll tell you honestly how much it hurts."
"...No anesthesia at all? As someone who studies medicines, Doctor, I'd really like to hear why you chose that."
"Breathe slowly... Yes, I'll do that. Please keep guiding me through the rest, too."
"The hardest part is over...? That's a relief. I almost couldn't keep smiling just now."
"...Are you wrapping up? Could you tell me? Hearing only the instruments for so long is unsettling."
"All right, I'll try not to move... But if the next step will hurt, please tell me first."
"Mm... go ahead. But if I say I can't take it, please take me seriously, all right?"
"Thank you for stopping... Let me catch my breath. Knowing how pain works doesn't make it hurt any less, does it?"
"Thank you for explaining it so clearly. Knowing the reasons actually makes it easier for me to leave the next steps in your hands."
"I see, I need to be admitted... Doctor, could you tell me how long you expect me to stay and what examinations are planned?"
"All right, I'll cooperate. A colleague can cover things at the lab... I didn't expect to be the one receiving care today."
"...You've already made the incision? There's no sharp pain, but that pressure and tugging... Oh, so my body really can tell."
"Ah...! The surface is numb... but that pull inside just now really hurt...!"
"Aah—! It hurts...! W-wait! Doctor, it really hurts... Please stop for a moment!"
"The medication is ready, right...? Then I'll leave things to you all. Please tell me how it went when I wake up."
"Doctor... I know I agreed to surgery. But the pain is more than I can bear... Please listen to me, all right?"
"You're being so thorough that I should feel reassured... but my heartbeat doesn't seem to be following the smile on my face."
"...You're finally looking at me. Sorry, I just wanted to make sure my voice was reaching you."
"I'm glad you're telling me what you're doing... Knowing the progress is better than guessing by myself."
"Doctor...? Why did it suddenly get so quiet...? Please answer me. I'm getting a little scared."
"Oh, one moment. The procedure you just mentioned is different from the one we confirmed. Could you check it again first?"

"So this is where the incision will be... I see. Thank you for marking it first. Please confirm the anesthesia is working before you begin." (Seeing that dark incision line drawn across my own skin sends cold sweat down my back...)

"The mark is clear. Knowing what to expect doesn't stop me feeling nervous... at least I know where you'll start." (My fingers clutch the table pad tight—only one step left before the actual incision...)

"...This line is where you'll cut without anesthesia in a moment? Doctor, I want to confirm once more..." (That marker trail feels like a sentence on bare skin—every muscle in my body just locked stiff!)

"P-please don't bring the knife over yet... I understand what the mark means, but I'm not ready for that pain." (My teeth won't stop chattering—facing cold steel without anesthesia strips away all bravado...!)

"My arms go here and my body stays at this angle... Understood. I'm still awake, so please tell me before you adjust me." (The surgical lamp is blinding, and knowing I'll be cut open in this pose makes my heart pound...)
"I'll need to hold this position for a while, right? I'll do my best, though anesthesia doesn't mean I won't feel discomfort." (Wide awake yet unable to budge a limb—my palms won't stop sweating...)

"You're going to secure me before anesthesia...? I know I shouldn't move, but if it hurts badly, I may not be able to control myself." (Bound wide awake waiting for the raw scalpel... My teeth are already chattering in terror!)

"...Lying here, I can't even get away. Doctor, I'm not trying to frighten you; I just want you to know how nervous I am." (Pinned fast to the table by my wrists and ankles—even the thought of bolting is gone...)

"The antiseptic is cold... Yes, I won't move. It's surprising how clearly I can still feel it after anesthesia." (Goosebumps rise the instant the cold sponge wipes past, and my heart is beating faster and faster...)

"Is the disinfection area set? Understood. Before the next step, could you check the anesthesia is working once more?" (Glistening wet under the surgical lamp, all I can do is wait for the drapes and the knife...)
"...That's cold. Once disinfection is done, you'll cut here with no anesthesia at all, right...?" (Every swipe feels like tracing a path for the raw blade—my unnumbed skin is already trembling!)

"I know the antiseptic itself doesn't hurt... but thinking about the knife touching me soon has my heart racing." (Please don't cut without warning me first—I'm not ready for raw steel on bare flesh...!)

"The catheter goes through the urethral opening... Yes, I know its purpose. But please wait; I need a moment to prepare myself." (Feeling that tube slide inch by inch into my urethra is terrifyingly vivid and uncomfortable...)

"Please warn me before you begin. Words I say so calmly in the lab sound completely different when I'm lying here." (How am I supposed to ‘just relax’ right now when even my inner thighs are trembling...)

"Ah...! Wait... You're inserting the catheter with no anesthesia at all? It really feels uncomfortable... Please go slowly!" (Raw, unanesthetized mucosa forced open inch by inch—the burning ache and urge to pee are brutal!)

"Ugh... I know this preparation is necessary... but I can feel every touch there... Please tell me what's next!" (The scalpel hasn't even touched me and this catheter already has me drenched in cold sweat...!)

"An enema is part of the preparation...? I know what it's for. Still, having to lie on my side for it is embarrassing." (As warm water rushes into my belly, my whole face feels hot enough to catch fire...!)

"All right, I'll cooperate. Could everyone not involved step outside first? Knowing the procedure doesn't make it less awkward." (My insides are churning like crazy and I have to clench hard in front of everyone... This is torture!)

“Oh my... this surgery wasn't indicated for an enema at all, Dr. Sakaguchi, yet you still had me undress and take a bellyful of warm fluid...!” (Made to bare my backside for nothing, and my lower belly is still aching and full...!)

“Hehe... putting me through the indignity of an unnecessary bowel wash under the name of prep nearly breaks even my composure...” (My stomach is churning so hard I can barely hold it in—all that humiliation for nothing...!)

"The skin prep goes this far...? Including here? I understand it's for surgery, but saying it out loud is still embarrassing." (Feeling the blade glide across such tender skin has me too scared even to breathe...!)

"Even the area I usually keep private has to be shaved...? All right. I'll cooperate; please explain the boundaries first." (Shaved completely bare down there—even shifting an inch feels chilly and strange...)

“That private area wasn't actually required for skin prep... Now that you've shaved me completely bare yourself, how am I supposed to keep smiling...!” (Shaved completely smooth where the scalpel won't even touch—the draft down there is mortifying...!)

“Not a single hair spared even outside the field... Bare skin rubbing directly together when I close my legs is truly mortifying...” (Bare skin touches directly whenever I close my legs—it feels so weird I can barely sit still...!)

"I have to take off my butterfly ornament too...? Of course, the cap needs to cover my hair and ears. It just feels strange to look like this." (Putting on this surgical cap makes my heart jump straight into my throat...)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_kyrie_canaan.pat: Kyrie Canaan

I'm Kyrie, an information broker from the Fifth District. I take on the occasional odd job, too. Don't listen to people who say I'm unreliable... For this appointment, I promise I won't send someone else in my place at the last minute.
Doctor, doctor, listen! I thought it was nothing serious, but then it turned into this: {line}
The most obvious problem is: {line} I really am not exaggerating to get attention this time!
Oh, one more piece of intel: {line} ...It's a symptom, so I'm not charging an information fee.
My lower half feels weak, so why does it still feel like something's tugging inside...? Mm, that's strange. Could you tell me before you adjust anything?
Okay, I know I have to stay still... but when you hold me here, it feels uncomfortable inside. Nurse, am I talking too much?
W-wait! Just hold me steady, okay? That doesn't mean it won't hurt! I'll try not to move, but you have to listen if I tell you to stop!
Just 'we'll follow the usual process'? That's not a full explanation! Even I spell out the terms when I'm doing business. Doctor, tell me what happens next.
An epidural... I'll still be conscious, but my lower half won't listen to me? I understand how it works, but it doesn't sound fun at all in practice.

General anesthesia... I close my eyes and leave everything to you? I really won't be able to change my mind halfway through this time. Make sure you tell me the operation is over when I wake up, okay?
With local anesthesia, I can still talk, right? Good. I'll give you timely feedback, and you make sure to listen! ...If it feels awful inside, I'm not going to pretend I'm fine.
What?! No anesthesia at all? Doctor, I've never taken on a high-risk job like this! No, this time I can't even pass it off to someone else... Are you serious?!
Okay, breathe slowly... I'll follow along. Mm, I finally know how much effort it takes to be a good listener.
It's really almost over? That's great... I thought I might use up all my courage in here. Thank you.
...Mm. I heard you. Let me rest for a bit... I really don't have the energy to put on a brave face anymore.
I know, I'll try not to move! But could you avoid giving orders out of nowhere...? The moment you speak, I get even more nervous!
We have to keep going...? O-okay. Tell me what comes next first. I don't want to be caught unprepared.
Phew... You finally stopped for a moment. Doctor, can I catch my breath first? I'm not stalling this time, really.
Ohhh, now I get it! If you explain the steps in advance, I'm the easiest patient you'll ever have. ...Probably.
Huh, admission? I thought I could just leave after getting a test order! Um... how many days will I be here? I've got several deals waiting on me.
All right, I'll stay. But I mean it—I will cooperate, so don't spring extra procedures on me! I hate finding out there's another step right when it's about to happen.
...Have you started cutting? It isn't as sharp as I imagined, but that pushing and pulling feeling... Oh wow, this is really happening.
Tss—! My skin doesn't seem to hurt as much, but why does it feel so tight inside? Doctor, wasn't this supposed to be numb...?
Aah—!! It hurts! Wait, you're really cutting! I won't bargain anymore, please stop for a moment... Aah!
Wait, I still had something to say... Mm, never mind. Doctor, I'm counting on you this time... I hope I wake up and get to announce that the job went smoothly.
Aah! It hurts, it hurts so much! I take back everything I bragged about! Doctor, please listen... I really can't take it!
When I said I wasn't scared at all... I may have exaggerated a little. Doctor, if I really panic later, you'll listen to me, right?
Doctor, look at me for a second... Yes, just like that. Don't laugh. I talk a lot normally, but right now I really need someone to look at me.
Mm, keep explaining. I'm listening... I used to be the one reporting the news to everyone, but today's progress report is making me more nervous by the second.
...Doctor? Why did everyone go quiet? Hey, when you suddenly stop talking, I can't help imagining the worst!
Wait, wait! That isn't the operation we just discussed, is it? Doctor, you can't just change the name of the job and call it the same thing! Check it properly first!

Is this mark where you'll make the incision? ...It was nothing on a diagram, but seeing it drawn on me is suddenly frightening. (It's only ink for now, yet that's the exact spot about to be cut open...)
Oh, so this is where you'll start... Wait, why does that line look longer than I expected? (As long as the surgery goes safely... Deep breaths—don't start crying before the first cut...)
Got it, I'll look carefully. Could you tell me once more before you actually begin? (Staring at that stark purple line on my skin, my throat is so dry I can barely swallow...)

You're going to cut right along this mark? Without anesthesia? ...No, my heart is pounding like it's about to burst out of my chest! (When even the marker nib feels this distinct, how am I supposed to endure a raw blade cutting in?!)

You're only drawing the line for now, right...? But just thinking about the knife following it makes me want to run! (Squeezing my eyes shut and gritting my teeth, praying the first cut doesn't make me pass out...!)

Doctor, I was going to ask if we could switch to an easier plan... Never mind. Just tell me when the first cut will happen. (Help, the blade is hovering right over the line... My heart feels like it's about to explode!)

My hands there, my legs here... All right, all right, I'll cooperate! I used to be quick on my feet when escaping. Why am I so clumsy on the table? (That click of the restraint strap is terrifying—I'm completely at their mercy now...)

Wait, are you going to keep me in this position the whole time? ...I'm not refusing. I just realized I don't have any room to maneuver. (The cold pad presses against my back while every nervous breath stays in plain view...)
Lift this side a little more? Okay... Nurse, don't let my smile fool you. My palms are sweating from nerves. (Strapped down so tight I can't even flinch... Please be gentle with me...)

No anesthesia, and you're going to secure me like this before surgery?! I'm telling you, if it really hurts, I can't promise I won't struggle! (The second the straps cinch tight, the terror of being cut open raw nearly drives me mad!)

Hey, the way you've positioned me, there's nowhere to even dodge... Doctor, are you really sure about no anesthesia? (Cold sweat trickles down my temple; I can only pray these straps hold me through the first cut...)

You want me to lie still right now? What happens when that knife comes down...? I'm not putting on a show for you! (The blade hasn't even touched me yet and every muscle is already locked stiff with dread...!)
Whoa, that's cold! You're disinfecting such a big area... I thought it would be over in a second. (Wet amber antiseptic covers the field, making every breath catch in my throat...)

All right, I know it needs to be disinfected properly. You're just moving so quickly that I haven't had time to prepare myself. (With the monitor beeping this fast, there's no hiding how nervous I really am...)
Are we getting ready to start surgery now? ...Don't let me talking fool you. I'm really nervous. (Chilled air hits the freshly swabbed skin while my heart hammers against my ribs...)

It's cold... Wait, once you're done disinfecting, you go straight to surgery, right? I don't have any anesthesia at all! (Shivering from the chill, knowing I'm about to take the knife wide awake and unnumbed...!)

I already want to pull away while you're just applying antiseptic... Doctor, please warn me before the first cut! (The monitor's beeping faster and faster—the whole OR can hear how terrified I am...!)
You all sound so casual... but I'm the one who's going to be cut open! How could I not be scared? (Not a drop of anesthesia... Please let me take one deep breath before the blade comes down...!)

A catheter?! ...Wow, that's not an experience I can broadcast to everyone! C-could you block my view first? (Being parted and wiped down there just to have a tube pushed in—I've never felt this humiliated...!)

I know it's necessary care... but could you avoid announcing it in front of so many people? My face is burning! (Having a tube draining me right between my legs makes me want to keep my eyes shut forever...)

All right, I'll try to relax like you said... Nurse, please warn me before you begin. I'm afraid I'll startle and move. (Hearing that faint sound in the tubing, I can only bite my lip and turn my burning face away!)
A catheter without anesthesia? W-wait... I'm so tense my legs are stiff. Could you give me a moment? (Tears sprang straight to my eyes—every millimeter feels like needles down there!)

I know, I mustn't move... but I'm terrified every time you touch me. Nurse, tell me before you do anything. (Even breathing makes the tube rub raw against the most sensitive spot—it hurts and it's mortifying!)

I'm already like this before surgery even starts... Doctor, can we pretend you never heard me say I wasn't scared? (Digging my nails into the pad just to keep from sobbing—uncut catheterization is a nightmare...!)

A-an enema?! I knew the hospital had procedures that weren't listed on the sign! ...All right, could you close the door first? (Even the nurse is standing right there with the tray... I've never been this mortified in my life!)

I usually hear about this sort of thing before anyone else, but it still startled me when it happened to me... Nurse, could you explain the steps first? (My lower belly aches so heavily I'm terrified even taking a breath will make me lose control...!)

I know you're just getting me ready... but having to cooperate this earnestly with something like this is so embarrassing! (If I let anything slip right here on the bed, I might as well pass out on the spot...!)

“Whoa, Doctor! The chart clearly said not applicable—how'd you talk me into dropping my pants for a full enema anyway?!” (Using extra precaution as an excuse to watch me squirm... I went through that mortifying enema for nothing!)

“That wasn't even a required step, was it... My stomach's churning like crazy—quit watching me suffer!” (Stuck clenching my legs together fighting the urge... This doctor has a seriously wicked streak!)
Skin prep? Huh? You have to prepare even there? Wait, let me make sure you're only doing the area needed for surgery! (With the light shining right down there, there isn't a single place to hide...)
I know it's for disinfection and the operation... b-but don't just pull the blanket off all at once! Give me a warning! (With every last hair gone, I feel even more exposed than being naked...!)

The staff don't look embarrassed at all... Okay, I'm the embarrassed one. Go ahead; I'll try not to move. (With everything shaved bare, the cool air hits right against me—I don't even know where to put my legs...)

“Hold up! The surgery isn't down there, so why'd you shave my private spot completely spotless too?!” (Telling me it wasn't required AFTER shaving me bare down there—you just wanted to watch me blush!)

“Shaved bald when no prep was needed... Bare skin rubbing straight together whenever I close my legs is mortifying!” (It'll take weeks to grow back after discharge... This doctor's taste is seriously twisted!)

What, all my hair has to go inside? I can't even wear my trademark hat? ...All right, this one's for medical use. (With my forehead and ears completely exposed, even pretending to stay calm is hard...)
Even my ears are covered... I don't look anything like that famous information broker now, do I? (With every strand tucked inside, I'm officially nothing but a patient waiting for the blade...)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_makimura_kaori.p: Kaori Makimura
My partner and I take jobs in Shinjuku, and I'm used to looking after other people. Sitting in an exam room while everyone asks about me...honestly, it's awkward.
I wanted to finish my current job first, but my body really doesn't feel right: {line}
Doctor, note this first—the clearest symptom is: {line}
And don't miss this too: {line}
"Don't move my legs suddenly...I can't move them myself right now."
"Just steady me...my hands are shaking. I can still hear what you're saying."
"D-don't hold me down so hard! Ah...that hurts! I know I can't move, but my body keeps flinching!"
"Just 'the usual procedure'? No. At least tell me how you'll prepare me."
"My legs will go numb and I won't be able to move? ...I know it's the medicine, but it still sounds awful."
"General anesthesia...when I wake up, you'll tell me it's over, right?"
"Local anesthesia? All right, I'll try to stay still. If I feel pain inside, I'll tell you."
"No anesthesia?! Just because I'm usually brave doesn't mean I'm not scared!"
"Breathe slowly, relax your shoulders...okay, I'll try."
"We're finally at this point... Whew, I almost embarrassed myself back there. Thank you."
"...How much longer? Doctor, I just want to hear you say we're almost done."
"Got it, I won't move! But...could you tell me what comes next?"
"Hey...! I just said it hurts. Did you hear me?!"
"...Thanks. Let me catch my breath and I can keep going."
"That makes sense. Tell me how to cooperate and I'll do it."
"Hospitalization? Hey, do I really have to stay? I still have a job to finish...but I know my health comes first."
"All right, I'll stay. Just tell me the hospital rules and I'll follow them."
"...You've already cut? It feels like pulling and pressure. It barely hurts, but it's still creepy."
"Hiss...! I felt that! Doctor, did you already make the incision?!"
"Aah—!! It hurts! W-wait!! You're really cutting...it hurts so much! Stop!"
"...Okay. Then I can relax. I'll leave the rest to you."
"Wait...! I said I'd cooperate, not that I could take a knife while awake!"
"...Thanks. I may be loud most days, but I'm pretty nervous today."
"...You're still looking at me. All right, I'll keep hanging on."
"Mm, keep talking me through it. Knowing where we are helps me stay calm."
"What's wrong? Why did everyone go quiet...? Doctor, is something happening?"
"Wait! This isn't the operation we agreed on, is it? Stop and check my chart again!"
"The incision goes here...seeing the line makes this feel too real." (Seeing that dark incision line drawn across my own skin sends cold sweat down my back...)
"Don't draw the line and then cut without warning! At least look at me before you start." (My fingers clutch the table pad tight—only one step left before the actual incision...)
"Wait! That's where you'll cut me without anesthesia?!" (That marker trail feels like a sentence on bare skin—every muscle in my body just locked stiff!)
"Thinking about the knife coming down here...ha, I don't feel like pretending to be brave anymore." (My teeth won't stop chattering—facing cold steel without anesthesia strips away all bravado...!)
"Arms out? Legs like this too? ...Okay, but tell me how long I have to hold the position." (The surgical lamp is blinding, and knowing I'll be cut open in this pose makes my heart pound...)
"All right, I won't move...but having everyone arrange my posture is awkward." (Wide awake yet unable to budge a limb—my palms won't stop sweating...)
"They'll restrain me without anesthesia? Don't joke! If it hurts, I can't promise I won't move!" (Bound wide awake waiting for the raw scalpel... My teeth are already chattering in terror!)
"My arms and legs can't move now...are you really going to start like this?" (Pinned fast to the table by my wrists and ankles—even the thought of bolting is gone...)
"Brr, that's cold! ...Okay, I won't flinch. Are we nearly ready to start?" (Goosebumps rise the instant the cold sponge wipes past, and my heart is beating faster and faster...)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_mouri_ran.patien: Ran Mouri

I live in Tokyo, practice karate regularly, and often worry about my family. When trouble comes up, I instinctively take care of everyone else. But this time, I want to listen carefully to the doctor about my own health.
Hello, Doctor. I thought I could just wait it out, but today I decided to get checked: {line}
The most noticeable issue is: {line}. I've been keeping track of when it started; you can ask me about it.
There's this too: {line}. Should I tell you about that as well?
I really can't move my legs... I'm not trying to move around; I'm just a little frightened. Could you talk to me, please?
Mm, I know I need to hold this position... It's just that sudden tug inside made my shoulders tense up. I'll do my best to cooperate.
W-wait! I'll try not to move, but when it hurts my body really does try to pull away... Please, tell me first!
Just ‘it's routine’...? I'll cooperate, but could you at least tell me what the first step is?
With an epidural, I'll still be conscious, but I won't be able to move my legs... Mm, I'll try not to get nervous. Please tell me before you begin.
General anesthesia... Will the surgery be over by the time I wake up...? All right. I'll be counting on you.
With local anesthesia, I'll still be able to hear everyone, right? If I feel pain inside, I'll say so right away. I won't try to tough it out.
No anesthesia at all?!... Even though I practice karate, surgery isn't a training exercise... Do we really have to do it this way?
Mm... Breathe in, breathe out... I'll follow along with you. If I hold on a little longer, it'll be over, right?
Is it really almost over...? That's wonderful... I thought I wouldn't be able to do it. Thank you, everyone.
...Are you still stitching? I'll wait quietly... Mm, I won't move until I hear that it's over.
O-okay, I won't move...! I know I need to hold still, but I'm so scared... Please keep talking to me!
...Mm, I hear you. You're going to continue now, right? I'll do my best to cooperate.
...Did you stop? Thank you... Give me a moment to catch my breath, and I'll tell you whether I can continue.
I see... Thank you for explaining each step. Knowing what's coming next makes me feel much more at ease.
Do I need to be admitted...? I know I shouldn't push myself, but there are a few things I need to take care of at home. About how long would I be staying?
All right, I'll be admitted. I'll contact Dad... This time, I need to learn to let other people take care of me, too.
Huh...? You've already made the incision? It isn't as sharp as I imagined, but I can feel pressure inside in waves... So it's really started...
Ah...! It doesn't seem to hurt as much on the outside, but something suddenly tugged inside... Doctor, may I tell you what that feels like?
Aah—!! It hurts! Wait... You've really cut me... Doctor, stop for a moment! I can't take it!
Thank you for talking to me the whole time... I'm a little scared, but I trust you all. Please tell me how it went when I wake up, okay?
No...! It hurts too much. I can't take it! Doctor, please listen to me—stop for a moment...!
I'll do my best to cooperate... but I'm still a little nervous. Doctor, could you go over it with me once more?
Doctor... Are you looking at me? ...Thank you. I'm still trying, but I can't stop my tears.
Thank you... If you keep telling me what you've done, I won't have to keep guessing. Please keep me updated.
...Doctor? Why did you suddenly go quiet...? I'm not rushing you. I just want to know everyone can still hear me.
Wait, Doctor. This doesn't seem to be the procedure you just explained to me... Could you please confirm it again first?
Are you marking where the incision will go? ...Watching that line suddenly makes me nervous. (It's only ink for now, yet that's the exact spot about to be cut open...)
You've marked it so clearly... I know it's for accuracy, but I can't help staring at it. (As long as the surgery goes safely... Deep breaths—don't start crying before the first cut...)

Is that where you'll make the incision...? With no anesthesia at all, will I really feel the first cut? (When even the marker nib feels this distinct, how am I supposed to endure a raw blade cutting in?!)

Doctor, could you confirm it once more? Now that you've marked the spot, does that mean you're really going to cut there? (Squeezing my eyes shut and gritting my teeth, praying the first cut doesn't make me pass out...!)

My hands and legs go here? I usually adjust my own position when I practice, so it's strange to have someone arrange me while I'm lying down. (That click of the restraint strap is terrifying—I'm completely at their mercy now...)
...All right, I'll hold still. If I feel uncomfortable, I can tell you right away, right? (The cold pad presses against my back while every nervous breath stays in plain view...)

You'll secure my body even though I have no anesthesia... I know it's for safety, but if it really hurts, can I promise I won't move...? (The second the straps cinch tight, the terror of being cut open raw nearly drives me mad!)

P-please tell me why I need to be positioned this way first... I'll do my best to cooperate, but I'm already trembling a little. (Cold sweat trickles down my temple; I can only pray these straps hold me through the first cut...)
The disinfectant is a little cold... Ah, it's all right. I know it's necessary. (Wet amber antiseptic covers the field, making every breath catch in my throat...)
You're disinfecting so carefully... You're really going to operate on this part of my body, aren't you...? (With the monitor beeping this fast, there's no hiding how nervous I really am...)
After you disinfect me, you'll cut right in...? I-I'm not ready yet... (Shivering from the chill, knowing I'm about to take the knife wide awake and unnumbed...!)

It feels so cold... But when I think about how much it might hurt soon, I almost wish this step would take longer. (The monitor's beeping faster and faster—the whole OR can hear how terrified I am...!)

I need a urinary catheter too...? I understand it's part of the surgical preparation, but this is still so embarrassing... Could only the necessary staff stay here? (Being parted and wiped down there just to have a tube pushed in—I've never felt this humiliated...!)

All right, I'll try to relax. W-wait, I'm not ready yet... Could I take a moment to steady my breathing? (Having a tube draining me right between my legs makes me want to keep my eyes shut forever...)

You'll catheterize me while I'm completely conscious...? I know it's a normal preparation, but the closer we get to surgery, the more scared I feel... (Tears sprang straight to my eyes—every millimeter feels like needles down there!)

Please tell me when you'll start... I'll try not to move, but I can't help getting nervous when I think about the surgery afterward. (Even breathing makes the tube rub raw against the most sensitive spot—it hurts and it's mortifying!)

An enema...? Ah, I understand it's part of the preparation. But knowing that and having it happen to me are two different things... Could you tell me when you'll start? (Having my pants pulled down on the bed for a tube... I want to bury my face in the pillow!)
I-I'll cooperate... but this is really embarrassing. Could you close the curtain first? (Please stop timing me right beside the bed—if you keep watching, I won't last another minute...!)

“Ah... D-Doctor, this operation didn't actually require an enema...?! Yet I already pulled my pants down and got pumped full of warm fluid...!” (It wasn't even required and yet my belly's pumped full of warm water... You did this on purpose!)

“Put through such embarrassing bowel prep for nothing... With my belly churning like this, my ears burn crimson even trying to be cooperative...” (Humiliated like that for no reason—I can't even bring myself to look the doctor in the eye...)

Skin preparation... You mean removing the hair around the surgical area, right...? Mm, I know it's for the operation. (Having to spread my legs so they can shave right down there... I'm curling my toes in mortification!)

Um... Does the area really include here...? If it's necessary, I'll cooperate. Just please tell me first. (Bare skin brushing directly against the sheet feels so cold and sensitive it makes my heart race...)

“W-wait, Doctor! The incision isn't even down there, so why did you still shave my private hair completely clean...?!” (The incision isn't even down there, yet you made me spread my legs and shaved me bare... So unfair!)

“Even an area that needed no prep at all is completely bare now... Just closing my legs presses bare skin straight together—I could die of embarrassment...!” (Clutching my gown hem and scared to move—they saw and shaved every last bit of me for nothing...)
I need to tuck all my hair in? All right, I'll arrange it myself... Huh, even my ears need to be covered? (With my forehead and ears completely exposed, even pretending to stay calm is hard...)

Is it on properly like this...? Once I put this cap on, it really feels like I'm about to enter the operating room. (With every strand tucked inside, I'm officially nothing but a patient waiting for the blade...)
Huh...? You've already made the incision? It isn't as sharp as I imagined, but I can feel pressure inside in waves... So it's really started...

"'We'll follow the usual process' isn't a complete explanation. At least tell me how you plan to begin."

"The hardest part is over? ...Wonderful. Could we pretend my little lapse just now never made it into the chart?"
"Are you wrapping up already? Doctor, I can wait, but I don't like waiting without any updates."
"I understand. I won't move. If the next step may be noticeable, please warn me first."
"Doctor...! You heard me say it hurts, right? Don't make me repeat myself."
"Thank you. Let me steady my breathing...I couldn't fake that composure the way I do during an interrogation."
"That was a very clear explanation, thank you. Knowing the order and reasons helps me feel safe entrusting this to you."
"Hospitalization? ...So this is more than signing a form and leaving. Doctor, how long should I expect to stay?"
"All right, I accept the admission. Please keep the chart and arrangements accurate; I dislike discovering omissions afterward."

"Hiss...! Wait, the surface is numb, but I felt that tug inside just now..."
"Aah—!! It hurts! W-wait...you're really cutting! No...Doctor, stop for a moment!"
"...All right. I'll leave the rest to you. Don't make me wake up and personally chase down everyone's report, okay?"
"Wait. I agreed to treatment, not to enduring every bit of pain while fully conscious. Do you understand?"
"Don't worry, I won't deliberately get in the way. It's just that today...I suppose I'm the one who has to trust someone else's judgment."
"You finally looked up at me? ...Good. At least someone is listening to my report."
"Mm, keep telling me how it's going. Every step you explain is one less thing I have to guess."
"Why did it get so quiet? ...Doctor, say something so I know we're still in control of the situation."
"Hold on. That isn't the procedure we just confirmed, is it? If you want my cooperation, let's verify the record first."

"...Don't finish marking and immediately cut. At least tell me how many seconds I have, okay?" (My teeth won't stop chattering—facing cold steel without anesthesia strips away all bravado...!)

"Arms at my sides, legs held at this angle...all right. How long will I need to stay in this position?" (The surgical lamp is blinding, and knowing I'll be cut open in this pose makes my heart pound...)
"Anesthesia doesn't erase every sensation. Please warn me before adjusting my position; I'll cooperate." (Wide awake yet unable to budge a limb—my palms won't stop sweating...)

"I'm not trying to disrupt the operation. But being positioned like this while awake, then told 'don't move'...doesn't sound easy." (Pinned fast to the table by my wrists and ankles—even the thought of bolting is gone...)

"That's cold...I can still feel it clearly even after anesthesia. You'll drape the area next, right?" (Goosebumps rise the instant the cold sponge wipes past, and my heart is beating faster and faster...)
"All right, I won't flinch. I see the area you've disinfected...call me before you actually begin." (Glistening wet under the surgical lamp, all I can do is wait for the drapes and the knife...)

"...That's cold. You're all so calm, but I know that once this is wiped down, the next step is the scalpel." (Every swipe feels like tracing a path for the raw blade—my unnumbed skin is already trembling!)
"Wait...the disinfection is done already? ...I thought I could stay composed, but my heart isn't listening." (Please don't cut without warning me first—I'm not ready for raw steel on bare flesh...!)

"The catheter...you're going to insert it there? All right, I understand. Please give me a moment to prepare myself." (Feeling that tube slide inch by inch into my urethra is terrifyingly vivid and uncomfortable...)

"I know you're experienced...but I'm the one lying here having the catheter placed. Please tell me before you begin." (How am I supposed to ‘just relax’ right now when even my inner thighs are trembling...)
"Ugh...! W-wait...you have to do this while I'm fully awake too? This is really uncomfortable...!" (Raw, unanesthetized mucosa forced open inch by inch—the burning ache and urge to pee are brutal!)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_sagiri_sakurai.p: Sagiri Sakurai
I'm Sagiri Sakurai, the chief of VTX Union's Special Operations Section 3 and the lead pilot of its test machine. I tend to make things sound lighthearted, but I don't take my work lightly.
Doctor, I meant to finish my work before coming in, but my body suddenly started protesting: {line}
The most noticeable problem is this: {line}. I can explain what happened in order.
Yes, there's one more thing to add to the report: {line}. Oh, force of habit—don't mind me.
“My legs are still there, but they don't feel like mine... I won't move around. Please let me know you're still beside me.”
“All right, I'll try not to move. It's just that being held steady like this makes it even clearer that I'm really on the operating table.”
“D-don't hold me down without warning! I know I need to stay still, but the scalpel is right here... At least tell me what you're doing next!”
“Just ‘follow the procedure’? I'm not fond of long reports either, but you could at least tell me what's coming next.”
“An epidural... I'll be awake, but I won't be able to move my lower body? Understanding it is one thing. I really don't relish experiencing it myself.”
“General anesthesia... Handing over all control just like that really is a first for me. Please tell me how it went as soon as I wake up.”
“With local anesthesia, I can still talk to you, right? Good. If anything hurts in a way that feels wrong, I'll tell you immediately.”
“What? No anesthesia at all? I can pilot a test machine, but I've never trained to lie still while someone cuts me open! Doctor, are you serious?”
“All right, slow breaths, just as you said... Hoo... I can do this. There's only a little left, right?”
“Is it really almost over? Thank goodness... I couldn't pretend I had everything under control this time. Thank you.”
“...You don't have to make me keep talking. Just call my name softly when it's all over... Thank you.”
“Don't move, right... I heard you. I'll try, but I really want to pull away right now. Please keep a close eye on me.”
“Mm... I'm listening. Could you tell me again before you continue? That way, at least I'll know how to get through it.”
“...Thank you. Let me catch my breath first. A moment ago, I thought I could handle this easily... Looks like I overestimated myself.”
“Now that's clear. You handle the medical decisions, and I'll focus on cooperating—a clear division of responsibilities. I like it.”
“Hospitalization? Well, now I really do need to take sick leave. Doctor, how many days are we looking at? I need to arrange the handover and leave paperwork right away.”
“All right. If something's wrong with my body, I can't just push through it. I'll leave work to my colleagues and put my treatment in your hands.”
“...Have you started cutting already? There's no sharp pain, but it feels like something's being pushed apart inside... So it really has begun.”
“Hss...! The surface feels all right, but that tugging deeper inside just now felt awful... Doctor, I need to say something.”
“Aah—!! It hurts! It really hurts! W-wait... I can't take it! Doctor, please stop for a moment!”
“All right, I'm in your hands—w-wait! Don't bring that knife down... I-I'm really scared now!”
“All right, I'll stop putting on a brave face. I'll think of it as handing you the controls this time... When I wake up, just let me know everything went smoothly.”
“Wait! I said I'd cooperate, not that I wouldn't feel pain! Doctor, let me finish first...!”
“Don't worry. I've always been good at entrusting tasks to reliable people... That said, my heart's beating much faster than I expected.”
“Ah... Are you watching me because you're worried I won't be able to keep still? ...All right, then don't look away.”
“Thank you for telling me which step you're on. It's still frightening to hear, but it's better than being left to imagine things on my own.”
“Doctor...? Why has everyone suddenly gone quiet? I understand you're concentrating, but at least tell me things are still going smoothly...”
“Wait, that isn't the procedure we just confirmed, is it? Even when I fly a test machine, I double-check the checklist. We can't skip that step in surgery.”

"D-don't hand over the scalpel so fast! Looking at that marker line on my bare skin has my teeth chattering out of control...!" (Squeezing my eyes shut and gritting my teeth, praying the first cut doesn't make me pass out...!)

"Doctor, please promise me... Right before the tip of the blade touches that marker line, warn me out loud first—please don't slice into me without warning...!" (Help, the blade is hovering right over the line... My heart feels like it's about to explode!)

"The cold OR air is blowing right against my bare thighs and skin... Being placed in such an open posture in front of all these staff members has my whole face burning..." (The cold pad presses against my back while every nervous breath stays in plain view...)
"Wait a moment—warn me before you tighten the wrist straps and leg stirrups! I won't move around..." (Strapped down so tight I can't even flinch... Please be gentle with me...)

"With zero anesthesia at all, you're strapping my wrists and legs tightly to the operating table...?! If it hurts unbearably when you cut into me, I won't even be able to flinch!" (The second the straps cinch tight, the terror of being cut open raw nearly drives me mad!)
