strings.patient_bundles.patient_rami_amasaki.pat: Rami Amasaki
“Hospitalization...? P-please wait. I'd like to confirm how many days you expect. There's so much to hand over at Special Section 3... I'm not trying to avoid treatment!”
“Understood. I accept the admission arrangements. Someone will take over my work... I just can't stop wondering whether there's some preparation I've missed.”
“Wait! That's different from the procedure we confirmed. Perhaps it's just a recordkeeping problem... but please check first. We can't carry on hoping it'll be fine!”
“I see... Let me repeat that: we finish the preparations, then follow the plan we've confirmed, right? Yes, knowing the steps helps a lot.”
“Just 'follow the procedure'...? Sorry, I know you're familiar with it, but the less I know, the more I imagine the worst. Please at least tell me what comes next.”
“I trust your expertise. I really do... My mind just won't stop. Could you tell me once more that someone will check how I'm doing before you begin?”
“With general anesthesia, I won't know anything afterward, will I...? Someone will be watching the medication and monitors, right? All right. I'll try to relax and leave it to you.”
“Epidural anesthesia... I'll be conscious, but part of my body won't move freely. I understand the theory, but will it be frightening when I actually feel it...?”
“Local anesthesia will let me stay awake... Understood. If the pulling inside gets uncomfortable, I can tell you right away, can't I?”
“N-no anesthesia at all?! That's completely different from the plan I expected! I'm not refusing to cooperate... but how could I not be nervous like this?!”
“Yes... Breathe, slowly... I've asked everything I needed to ask. I'll leave the rest to you...”
“Wait! I know I said I'd cooperate, but it really hurts! You can't just tell me to bear it... Please let me finish!”
“I-I'll try not to move! But I haven't even had anesthesia... What if the pain makes me pull away? P-please tell me you're still beside me!”
“Understood. Hold this position... I'll do that. It's just that the tugging made me shake. Could you check again, please?”
“My body's so numb it won't do what I tell it... I know you'll help me stay in position, but I'm still not used to it. Please tell me before you do anything.”
“W-wait! I already checked everything... but that blade is really coming down! No... Please, don't cut yet!”
“...Have you already made the incision? It doesn't sting the way I imagined, but the pressure inside is so noticeable... I-I'm still frightened.”
“Ah...! The surface seems numb, but that tug inside was so uncomfortable! Doctor, is this feeling normal...?”
“Aah—!! It hurts! You really cut...! I know I mustn't move, but I can't stand it! Doctor, stop for a moment!”
“H-have you stopped...? Thank you. Let me catch my breath... A moment ago, all I could think about was the pain.”
“...Understood. Don't move. I'm trying... But please don't suddenly go quiet. That makes me panic even more!”
“We have to continue... All right. I know I need to cooperate. Could you please tell me each step as you do it?”
“You're moving on to the next step now, right?... Thank you. Hearing how it's progressing keeps my imagination from running away with me.”
“Doctor... You're still watching me, aren't you?... Good. When someone answers, I know I haven't been left here alone.”
“...Doctor? Why has everyone suddenly stopped talking? I know you're working, but please tell me whether something's wrong...!”
“It's almost over...? Thank goodness. I'm sorry I asked so many times... Thank you for always answering me.”
“All right... I'll breathe along with your voice. I just need to hold on a little longer, right?... Yes, I can do it.”
“...If it's almost over, let me be quiet for a moment. It's not that I don't trust you... I can just finally relax a little.”

"An enema too...?! I know it's pre-op bowel prep, but lifting my hospital gown and lying on my side with my bottom bare... P-please draw the curtain shut first!" (Having my pants pulled down on the bed for a tube... I want to bury my face in the pillow!)

"Nngh... the nozzle is inside my rear... The warm solution keeps flowing into my belly, and my lower stomach is swelling fuller and fuller... I-I'll try my best to clench tight!" (Please stop timing me right beside the bed—if you keep watching, I won't last another minute...!)

"My belly feels so full and crampy, I'm almost at my limit...! Do I really have to hold it for several more minutes before using the toilet...?!" (If I let anything slip right here on the bed, I might as well pass out on the spot...!)

“W-wait, Doctor!! Non-abdominal surgery doesn't indicate an enema in any guideline—why did you still pump the whole bag into me yourself?!” (It wasn't even required and yet my belly's pumped full of warm water... You did this on purpose!)

“Enduring a bowel wash for nothing... Everyone can hear my gut rumbling loudly—I can never hold my head up again...!” (Humiliated like that for no reason—I can't even bring myself to look the doctor in the eye...)

"Skin prep... you have to shave all the hair below my lower abdomen clean too?! I understand it's for sterile disinfection, but exposing that place to be shaved is way too embarrassing..." (Having to spread my legs so they can shave right down there... I'm curling my toes in mortification!)

"Nngh... the warm lather is on, and I can feel every stroke of the razor scraping across my skin so clearly... P-please go slowly!" (Bare skin brushing directly against the sheet feels so cold and sensitive it makes my heart race...)

"I'm not pulling away... It's just that when your fingers press down there to hold the skin taut, my body trembles on its own... Please finish shaving quickly." (With everything shaved bare, the cool air hits right against me—I don't even know where to put my legs...)

“Kyaa—the anatomical incision isn't down there at all, so why did you shave my vulva completely bare too?!” (The incision isn't even down there, yet you made me spread my legs and shaved me bare... So unfair!)

“My private area is bare and drafty for no surgical reason... Every tiny shift brushes sensitive skin against the gown—I want to die of shame...!” (Clutching my gown hem and scared to move—they saw and shaved every last bit of me for nothing...)
"Tuck all my hair inside the sterile cap... Okay, is it on properly like this?" (Even the last lock of hair hiding my face is tucked away—I'm really about to go under the knife...)

"Even the stray locks by my ears are tucked in... Putting on this cap really turns me into nothing more than a patient about to go under the knife." (Seeing the gurney waiting right beside the bed, my palms are already slick with cold sweat...)

"My wrists have to be buckled into restraint straps and my legs spread and secured in holders...?! I know it's required for surgical positioning, but strapped to the table like this, I can't even cover myself!" (Wrists and ankles buckled into the straps... I can't even lift a hand to cover myself!)

"The cold OR air is blowing right against my bare thighs and skin... Being placed in such an open posture in front of all these staff members has my whole face burning..." (Everyone is looking down around the table checking my body—I'm clenching my toes in shame...)
"Wait a moment—warn me before you tighten the wrist straps and leg stirrups! I won't move around..." (Strapped down so tight I can't even flinch... Please be gentle with me...)

"With zero anesthesia at all, you're strapping my wrists and legs tightly to the operating table...?! If it hurts unbearably when you cut into me, I won't even be able to flinch!" (Strapping all four limbs down without a drop of anesthesia... I can't even writhe when the blade cuts?!)

"The feel of the restraint straps biting into my wrists is terrifying... Just thinking about taking the scalpel alive in this completely exposed posture has my legs shaking uncontrollably..." (No anesthesia and strapped wide open like this... Can I really survive what's coming...?!)

"P-please make sure the straps are secure... I'm not trying to break free, I'm just terrified my body will thrash on instinct when the real blade slices into me...!" (The blade hasn't even touched me yet and every muscle is already locked stiff with dread...!)

"You're inserting a urinary catheter while I'm wide awake...?! Doesn't that mean spreading my legs apart so you can push a tube into my most private spot... This is way too mortifying!" (Before the scalpel even starts, I have to spread my legs under the lamp for a catheter...!)

"Ah...! The freezing antiseptic swab just touched right there... As the thin tube slides into my urethra, it stings and aches so strangely—my body can't possibly 'relax' like you're asking...!" (Warm urine is flowing out through clear tubing while I'm wide awake to feel every second...!)

"Nngh, haah... Is it all the way inside my bladder now? With the balloon inflated, there's a constant swollen urge inside as if I'm leaking..." (Hearing that faint sound in the tubing, I can only bite my lip and turn my burning face away!)

"Without any anesthesia at all, you're pushing the catheter straight in...?! Nngh—ah...! That sharp sting just now felt like my insides were being forced open...!" (Shoving a catheter straight in without anesthesia... That searing sting nearly made me scream!)

"My legs are spread wide in the cold air with a tube sticking out of my bladder... Thinking about the un-anesthetized scalpel coming next has my whole body trembling...!" (It's throbbing raw inside me—I don't even dare twitch my hips a fraction of an inch...!)

"Is the catheter taped to my inner thigh now...? Just having a tube put in already hurts and humiliates me this much—what am I going to do when the real blade comes down..." (Digging my nails into the pad just to keep from sobbing—uncut catheterization is a nightmare...!)

"Sss—it's freezing! The swab soaked in antiseptic is wiping directly across my bare skin, circling outward from the incision center... The chill goes straight to my bones." (That antiseptic is freezing! Swabbed across bare skin, it means the blade is moments away...)

"The disinfection area is even wider than I imagined... With my chest, belly, and private area glistening wet under the shadowless lamp while everyone looks down, I feel as helpless as a specimen awaiting dissection." (As the liquid evaporates and steals my warmth, I can't stop a faint shiver...)

"Wait! The freezing antiseptic has coated the whole surgical field... Does that mean with no anesthesia at all, the very next step is slicing straight into my bare skin with a scalpel?!" (If a cold sponge feels this sharp, how much will it hurt when the raw scalpel cuts me open?!)

"Just the antiseptic swab brushing across my skin has me shivering uncontrollably... Picturing the searing agony of a real blade slicing through my flesh makes it impossible to catch my breath!" (Watching the doctor's hand move toward the instrument tray makes me want to bolt right off the table!)

"D-Doctor, please don't go silent after wiping on the antiseptic! I'm strapped down here unable to move—please say something to me before you bring the blade down...!" (Not a drop of anesthesia... Please let me take one deep breath before the blade comes down...!)

"I can feel the tip of the marker gliding across my bare skin so clearly... That purple line is the exact spot where you're about to cut my body open, isn't it?" (That marker tip feels so vivid—knowing the scalpel will slice right along this line makes me panic...)
"Seeing that line drawn across my body makes it sink in that I'm really about to be opened up by a scalpel..." (The line is longer than I pictured... Please be gentle when the blade comes down...)

"Without a single drop of anesthesia... you're going to cut my flesh open alive right along the line you just drew on me?! ...I can't bear to look down!" (Drawing an incision line on unanesthetized flesh... Is a raw scalpel really slicing here next?!)

"D-don't hand over the scalpel so fast! Looking at that marker line on my bare skin has my teeth chattering out of control...!" (I just saw the nurse hand over the scalpel... Give me three seconds to breathe, I'm terrified!)

"Doctor, please promise me... Right before the tip of the blade touches that marker line, warn me out loud first—please don't slice into me without warning...!" (Help, the blade is hovering right over the line... My heart feels like it's about to explode!)
Doctor, I meant to finish handing over my work before coming in... But this is what's been happening with my body: {line}
The most noticeable symptom is: {line}. I can explain it again in chronological order so I don't leave anything out.
Please note one more thing as well: {line}. Sorry, I always feel that leaving out even one detail could affect the assessment afterward.

My name is Rami Amasaki. I'm a new member of VTX Union's Special Section 3 and the co-pilot of the prototype Tiranedo. Ever since graduating from military university, I've been used to checking every step repeatedly... But when something goes wrong with my own body, the more I try to understand it, the more nervous I become.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_rami_amasaki.enc: "I-I have to strip completely naked for the basic physical...? Even my bra and panties have to come off? I understand the necessity, it's just... could you tell me the exact sequence of what you'll examine first?" (Even pre-sortie checks don't make you strip bare... I don't even know where to put my hands.)

"We're skipping the full-undress exam for now? ...Phew, that's a relief. Still, if it's an essential item for the diagnosis, please don't leave it out just because I hesitated!" (I don't have to stand stark naked in front of them right now, though leaving an unchecked box on the examination checklist makes me anxious in a whole different way...)

"U-understood! Since it's standard protocol for a complete physical, I'll follow it strictly! Just please draw the curtain shut and give me half a minute..." (That was ordered like a commanding officer. Obeying orders is second nature in Special Section 3, yet taking off my own bra and panties piece by piece still has my face burning like wildfire...) Swallowing nervously, she quickly unfastens her uniform jacket, skirt, and underwear and folds them neatly into the tray; with her bare body fully exposed under the examination lamp, she stands at attention with burning red ears, stiffly enduring your full visual and palpation exam.

"Thank you for explaining the sequence and purpose of the exam step by step... Now I can follow along properly." (Even knowing the purpose of every step, actually sliding off my panties and standing stark naked before the doctor and nurse is ten times more mortifying than I imagined...) Taking a deep breath, she removes her uniform jacket, skirt, and underwear in order as guided, lowering the arms that instinctively tried to cover her chest with a blazing red face as she trembles slightly through the naked physical exam.

"I-I'm sorry! Please don't suspend my care...! I wasn't trying to stall—I'll take off all my clothes right now!" (I got reprimanded... If I get sent back to the ward and delay my surgery, the consequences could be disastrous. No matter how humiliating it is, I have to strip bare immediately!) Flustered, she unbuttons her uniform jacket, skirt, and underwear and pulls off her underwear into the tray, standing stark naked before you with misty eyes and a rigid posture through the entire physical exam.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_rami_amasaki.pre: Rami Amasaki's Preoperative Arrangements
“Dr. Sakaguchi... I have handed over my work at Special Section 3. Could we check today's surgical arrangements once more? I am worried I missed something.”

“I would like to ask about the details... Once I am on the table, in what order will positioning, disinfection, and the incision happen? If I do not understand it beforehand, I am afraid I will keep imagining the worst.”

At first, Rami tries to stay composed and listen carefully to every pre-op explanation. Yet as she hears about stripping in the ward for an enema and intimate shaving, lying bare on the cold operating table with her limbs strapped down, having her legs parted under the glaring lights for a urinary catheter, and finally having her flesh sliced open by a scalpel, her breathing noticeably falters. Those clinical steps that sounded so routine on paper are about to happen inch by inch to her unshielded body; she clutches the blanket tightly, unable to hide the shame and fear rising in her eyes.
Dr. Sakaguchi will serve as the lead surgeon for Rami Amasaki's operation. Select the assistant surgeon, scrub nurse, and circulating nurse to form the surgical team.

Rami Amasaki waits in her ward room for pre-op preparation. Assign a ward nurse (or have Dr. Sakaguchi perform the prep personally) to complete the required bowel and skin preparations and up to two optional comfort measures.
“Everything is ready now...? All right. I have checked so many times, yet I still feel the most important thing is not ready... Me.”
With ward preparations complete, you and the surgical team head to the locker room to change into sterile scrubs, complete your surgical scrub at the sink, and step into the operating room.
“That light... It is even brighter than I expected. Usually I watch status displays from the co-pilot's seat, but today it feels as though I am the one being monitored...”

Before the operation begins, the team gathers around the operating table to verify Rami Amasaki's identity, surgical site, planned procedure, and roles. Lying on the cold table amidst the clinking of instruments, Rami's voice tightens slightly as she confirms her name.
Review the diagnosis and pre-op assessment for Rami Amasaki's current case, and confirm the surgical procedure to perform.
“Wait, that is not the procedure you mentioned earlier, is it? Please check the chart first... I know it is a bother, but we cannot skip over a discrepancy like that!”
Rami Amasaki has completed ward preparation and is waiting on the operating table. Confirm the anesthesia method and conditions to begin the operation.
“All right. I will stop checking everything again... At least this once, I want to trust others to watch over every step for me. Please take care of me...”

As the anesthetic takes hold through the mask and IV line, Rami Amasaki's eyelids slowly close, and she sinks into the deep, unconscious sleep of general anesthesia. With vitals steady on the monitor, Dr. Sakaguchi signals the team to begin.
“My lower body really is numb... I can hear everyone talking, but I cannot adjust my position myself. Please tell me before you start.”
“Has the local anesthesia taken effect? All right... I will stay still. If something feels wrong, I will tell you immediately.”
“You are really starting without anesthesia...? Wait, I know we already confirmed this, but now the thought of that blade is making my mind go blank!”
Dr. Sakaguchi extends a gloved hand with a brief command, and the scrub nurse places the first gleaming scalpel firmly into his palm.
The assistant surgeon places both hands on either side of the planned incision with sterile gauze, maintaining steady skin tension as she awaits Dr. Sakaguchi's cut.
The shadowless lamp focuses squarely on the center of the exposed surgical field. The sharp tip of the scalpel hovers millimeters above the purple marker line on Rami Amasaki's bare skin.

Deep under general anesthesia, Rami Amasaki feels nothing as the blade parts her skin. Dr. Sakaguchi and the team work in seamless coordination, dissecting tissue layer by layer and completing the core procedure while the monitor ticks steadily.

The instant the scalpel slices into her flesh, the awake Rami Amasaki jolts violently against her restraints, her breathing and physical distress spiking at once. Dr. Sakaguchi must decide how to respond.

Instruments continue separating and retracting deeper within the incision. Wide awake, Rami Amasaki endures the visceral dread, tugging, and pain of having her body opened, breathing rapidly as she awaits Dr. Sakaguchi's next response.

The most intense phase of the operation is over, and the team moves into hemostasis and suturing. Looking at the exhausted, sweat-drenched Rami Amasaki, how will Dr. Sakaguchi bring this intraoperative exchange to a close?
With the incision fully exposed, the surgical team advances into the key anatomical steps of the procedure.
The core lesion has been addressed and hemostasis across the operative field is secure. You are ready to close and suture the incision.
As the final suture is tied and covered with a sterile dressing, the scrub and circulating nurses complete the instrument and sponge counts, bringing Rami Amasaki's operation to a successful close.

strings.patient_bundles.patient_meryl_spaanna.pa: Meryl Spaanna
“Hospitalization? Wait. Explain the reason and how many days you expect first. I still have work to hand over at Special Section 3... I didn't say I'd go back sick. Don't glare at me yet.”
“All right, I'll stay in the hospital. I'll hand the maintenance work over to my colleagues. I'll follow your lead on treatment, but tell me promptly if anything changes.”
“Stop! That isn't the procedure we just checked. Is the chart wrong, or has the plan changed? Confirm it first. Don't be vague!”
“Now I understand. If there's a reason for each step, I can cooperate... I'm not trying to find fault. I just don't like missing important checks.”
“You think saying 'follow the procedure' counts as an explanation? I'm not asking for a whole textbook. At least tell me what you're doing next!”
“I can see how seriously you've prepared... You're being thorough. Don't worry, I won't cause trouble on purpose. I may sound tough, but my heart is racing like crazy.”
“General anesthesia... Then I won't even have a chance to ask a question afterward. All right, I'll leave it to you. Tell me the result straight away when I wake up.”
“Epidural anesthesia... I'll be awake, but unable to move my legs? I understand the explanation, but when it's my own body, I still don't like that feeling.”
“Local anesthesia, right? Fine. I'll stay still as instructed. If the pulling inside is uncomfortable, I'll tell you. Don't assume I'm just finding fault.”
“No anesthesia at all?! Wait, have you thought this through? Just telling me to 'bear with it' doesn't count as a pain-control plan!”
“I don't need you to coax me... No, wait. Nurse, say something to me again. Hearing your voices helps me feel safer.”
“It hurts! I said I'd cooperate, not that I could switch off the pain! Doctor, listen to me first—I really can't take it anymore!”
“Don't suddenly hold me on both sides at once! I know I need to stay steady, but without anesthesia I'll really pull away when it hurts... Tell me how you're going to help first!”
“All right, I'll try to hold steady. But that tug inside made even my shoulders flinch... Don't rush me. I'm trying to regulate my breathing.”
“My legs are so numb they won't do what I tell them... I know you'll keep me in position. Just tell me before moving me, please.”
“Hey! Don't bring that blade down yet...! I'm not angry. I'm genuinely frightened!”
“...You've already started cutting? There's no sharp sting, but the pressure inside is so noticeable... You really are operating on me.”
“Ah—! The outside seems numb, but that tug inside made me shake! Doctor, wait. Let me tell you what I'm feeling here!”
“Aah—!! It hurts! You really cut! S-stop for a moment! I know I mustn't move, but my body won't listen to me!”
“...You've stopped? Phew... Give me a little time. I'm not trying to yell at anyone. It just hurt so much I couldn't even get my words out properly.”
“I know, don't move! ...But don't have two people shouting instructions at me at once. Even my fingers are shaking!”
“We have to continue... All right. Warn me before you do anything. Don't leave me guessing, okay?”
“Yes, I'm listening. Knowing which step you've reached is better than hearing nothing... Thank you for explaining.”
“Don't just stare at me... It's not as though I'm planning to run. ...Never mind, keep watching. It actually helps to know someone's paying attention.”
“Doctor? Why has everyone suddenly gone quiet! ...Don't leave me imagining things. At least tell me it's still going smoothly!”
“It's almost over...? All right, I'm holding you to that. I'm sorry I was so sharp earlier... You've really helped me a lot.”
“All right, breathe at the pace you tell me... Phew... I can hold on. Nurse, don't leave. Remind me once more.”
“...Don't make me talk anymore. I'm really tired. Just tell me softly when you're finally done.”

"I can feel the tip of the marker gliding across my bare skin so clearly... That purple line is the exact spot where you're about to cut my body open, isn't it?" (It's only ink for now, yet that's the exact spot about to be cut open...)

"Seeing that line drawn across my body makes it sink in that I'm really about to be opened up by a scalpel..." (As long as the surgery goes safely... Deep breaths—don't start crying before the first cut...)

"Without a single drop of anesthesia... you're going to cut my flesh open alive right along the line you just drew on me?! ...I can't bear to look down!" (When even the marker nib feels this distinct, how am I supposed to endure a raw blade cutting in?!)

"D-don't hand over the scalpel so fast! Looking at that marker line on my bare skin has my teeth chattering out of control...!" (Squeezing my eyes shut and gritting my teeth, praying the first cut doesn't make me pass out...!)

"Doctor, please promise me... Right before the tip of the blade touches that marker line, warn me out loud first—please don't slice into me without warning...!" (Help, the blade is hovering right over the line... My heart feels like it's about to explode!)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_meryl_spaanna.en: "This exam requires stripping off all my clothes? Not even leaving my bra and panties on?! I know it's a medical checkup, but explain the exact scope to me before we start!" (Normally I'm the one stripping down machinery, and now I have to strip bare for an exam!)

"No need to strip completely for now? ...Phew, at least you're reasonable. Still, if it really affects the diagnosis, just say so—I'm not a coward who can't handle an exam." (At least I don't have to strip bare on the spot, though I hope they didn't notice how sweaty my palms got just now...)

"I heard you, it's standard protocol, right? Pull the curtain shut and I'll strip myself!" (The doctor's strictly business attitude leaves me no room to argue. I can strip armor plating without blinking, yet unhooking my own bra makes my fingers feel hopelessly clumsy...) Keeping her flushed face taut, she briskly removes her mechanic workwear, tank top, and underwear into the tray; as her unshielded bare body is exposed beneath the examination lamp, she bites her lip to keep up her tough front while her tense body endures your full visual and palpation exam.

"...Since you explained the reasons clearly first, of course I'll cooperate. I wasn't trying to pick a fight earlier—anyone would feel awkward being told to strip naked out of nowhere." (When spoken to that gently, I can't keep bristling. Still, sliding off even my panties to stand here barefoot has my whole face burning...) Muttering softly with crimson ears, she follows your prompts to remove her mechanic workwear, tank top, and underwear piece by piece, standing stark naked under the lamp with averted eyes until the basic physical is complete.

"W-who are you threatening with refusing treatment?! When did I ever say I wouldn't cooperate... I'll strip naked right now, so examine me properly!" (Damn it, forcing my hand by threatening to cancel care! But my health comes first, so no matter how humiliating it is, I have to strip down to nothing...) Clenching her jaw, she yanks off her mechanic workwear, tank top, and underwear along with her underwear and tosses them into the tray, standing stark naked before you as she trembles with mortification and anger through the entire exam.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_meryl_spaanna.pr: Meryl Spaanna's Preoperative Arrangements

“Dr. Sakaguchi, I have handed everything over at Special Section 3. Could you go over today's surgical arrangements again? I do not like finding out at the last moment that something has not been confirmed.”

“I would like the details. From positioning and disinfection to the actual incision, what will you do along the way?... It is not that I enjoy finding fault. When I think about it being done to my own body, I cannot settle for just hearing 'don't worry'.”

At first, Meryl tries to stay composed and listen carefully to every pre-op explanation. Yet as she hears about stripping in the ward for an enema and intimate shaving, lying bare on the cold operating table with her limbs strapped down, having her legs parted under the glaring lights for a urinary catheter, and finally having her flesh sliced open by a scalpel, her breathing noticeably falters. Those clinical steps that sounded so routine on paper are about to happen inch by inch to her unshielded body; she clutches the blanket tightly, unable to hide the shame and fear rising in her eyes.
Dr. Sakaguchi will serve as the lead surgeon for Meryl Spaanna's operation. Select the assistant surgeon, scrub nurse, and circulating nurse to form the surgical team.

Meryl Spaanna waits in her ward room for pre-op preparation. Assign a ward nurse (or have Dr. Sakaguchi perform the prep personally) to complete the required bowel and skin preparations and up to two optional comfort measures.
“All the preparations are finished?... That was fast. I am always telling people not to drag their feet, but now I actually wish you would slow down a little.”
With ward preparations complete, you and the surgical team head to the locker room to change into sterile scrubs, complete your surgical scrub at the sink, and step into the operating room.
“The lights are so bright... And so many people are already waiting. Tch, I usually hate people gathering around to watch work, and today I am the one lying right in the middle.”

Before the operation begins, the team gathers around the operating table to verify Meryl Spaanna's identity, surgical site, planned procedure, and roles. Lying on the cold table amidst the clinking of instruments, Meryl's voice tightens slightly as she confirms her name.
Review the diagnosis and pre-op assessment for Meryl Spaanna's current case, and confirm the surgical procedure to perform.
“Wait! That is not the procedure you mentioned earlier. Check the chart and what was agreed to for the operation first. Continue only after confirming it!”
Meryl Spaanna has completed ward preparation and is waiting on the operating table. Confirm the anesthesia method and conditions to begin the operation.
“All right, I know I should leave this to the professionals... Make sure you watch over me. ...Nurse, could you say something again?”

As the anesthetic takes hold through the mask and IV line, Meryl Spaanna's eyelids slowly close, and she sinks into the deep, unconscious sleep of general anesthesia. With vitals steady on the monitor, Dr. Sakaguchi signals the team to begin.
“My lower body really will not move... I know that is the anesthesia, but now I cannot even adjust my position myself. Do not start without warning.”
“Has the local anesthesia taken effect? All right... I will try not to move. If anything really feels wrong, I will tell you immediately.”
“Wait! You are really starting without any anesthesia at all? I know we already discussed it, but seeing these instruments... I really cannot say I am not frightened now.”
Dr. Sakaguchi extends a gloved hand with a brief command, and the scrub nurse places the first gleaming scalpel firmly into his palm.
The assistant surgeon places both hands on either side of the planned incision with sterile gauze, maintaining steady skin tension as she awaits Dr. Sakaguchi's cut.
The shadowless lamp focuses squarely on the center of the exposed surgical field. The sharp tip of the scalpel hovers millimeters above the purple marker line on Meryl Spaanna's bare skin.

Deep under general anesthesia, Meryl Spaanna feels nothing as the blade parts her skin. Dr. Sakaguchi and the team work in seamless coordination, dissecting tissue layer by layer and completing the core procedure while the monitor ticks steadily.

The instant the scalpel slices into her flesh, the awake Meryl Spaanna jolts violently against her restraints, her breathing and physical distress spiking at once. Dr. Sakaguchi must decide how to respond.

Instruments continue separating and retracting deeper within the incision. Wide awake, Meryl Spaanna endures the visceral dread, tugging, and pain of having her body opened, breathing rapidly as she awaits Dr. Sakaguchi's next response.

The most intense phase of the operation is over, and the team moves into hemostasis and suturing. Looking at the exhausted, sweat-drenched Meryl Spaanna, how will Dr. Sakaguchi bring this intraoperative exchange to a close?
With the incision fully exposed, the surgical team advances into the key anatomical steps of the procedure.
The core lesion has been addressed and hemostasis across the operative field is secure. You are ready to close and suture the incision.
As the final suture is tied and covered with a sterile dressing, the scrub and circulating nurses complete the instrument and sponge counts, bringing Meryl Spaanna's operation to a successful close.
“...You've already started cutting? There's no sharp sting, but the pressure inside is so noticeable... You really are operating on me.”
“Ah—! The outside seems numb, but that tug inside made me shake! Doctor, wait. Let me tell you what I'm feeling here!”
“Aah—!! It hurts! You really cut! S-stop for a moment! I know I mustn't move, but my body won't listen to me!”
strings.patient_bundles.patient_amis_ernest.pati: Amis Ernest
“Hospitalization is necessary?... Then I'll have to change my work schedule. Could you explain the reason, expected duration, and required tests all at once?”
“All right, I agree to be admitted. I'll handle the handover. Please notify me promptly of changes here too, so neither side has to redo its work.”
“Please stop. The procedure in the chart isn't the one you just explained. I'm not finding fault for its own sake. The two pieces of information really don't match.”
“That explanation makes sense. Frankly, I prefer an explanation with reasons to 'just leave it to us.'”
“'Following the rules' only proves you have rules. It doesn't help me understand what they involve. Could you fill in the key steps, please?”
“I can see how carefully you've all prepared... But normally I'm good at pointing out problems, and today I can't carry out even one step for myself. It's really unsettling.”
“General anesthesia... Once I lose consciousness, everything afterward will be in other people's hands. Please tell me the facts about the outcome when I wake up.”
“Epidural anesthesia. I'll be awake, but my lower body won't move as I want it to... I understand. Just imagining it feels rather uncomfortable.”
“Local anesthesia. All right. If there is still pain or pronounced pulling, I'll report it directly. Please don't mistake an accurate report for complaining.”
“No anesthesia at all?... This really is a treatment plan, not a test of the patient's endurance, isn't it? Please give me a reason I can understand.”
“I was going to ask one more question... Never mind. Doctor, when I wake up, please don't leave out anything I ought to be told.”
“Ah... It h-hurts! I'm not bargaining. I really can't bear any more! Doctor, please listen to me!”
“Don't hold me without saying anything...! I know you need me to stay in position, but I'm so frightened I don't even know how I might pull away.”
“I'll try my best not to move. But that tug inside made my whole body tense up. Please give me a little time to adjust.”
“...My legs really won't listen to me. Tell me before adjusting my position, please. I don't like being the last to know that my own body has moved.”
“Please wait...! I'm not picking at problems. That blade really is coming down... I'm so scared. Don't cut yet!”
“...Have you already started cutting? There's no sharp sting, but the pressure inside... It's much more real than I imagined.”
“Ah—! The outside seems numb, but inside... Doctor, I can still feel something here! Please listen to me first!”
“Aah—!! It hurts! You're really cutting... No, I can't bear it! Please stop for a moment. I'm begging you!”
“You've stopped... Thank you. I couldn't even finish a sentence just now. Really... There's nothing funny about it.”
“I heard you. Don't move... But I'm shaking! Could you speak a little more slowly? I'm really trying!”
“We're continuing again... I know. At least tell me beforehand, so I have time to catch my breath.”
“Yes, please keep talking. Hearing the actual progress is much more useful than trying to guess the outcome from your faces.”
“...Are you watching me all this time to check my responses? Then don't look away. I may really need someone paying attention.”
“Everyone suddenly stopped talking...? Doctor, could you tell me whether it's going smoothly? Don't leave me imagining every worst-case scenario.”
“It's almost over?... So there really is an end. Thank you. I may have sounded even sharper than usual just now.”
“All right, I'll follow your count... Breathe... Once more. Usually I don't like being told how to do things. Today is an exception.”
“...I don't have the energy to analyze anything anymore. Please handle the rest. Just tell me softly when it's over.”

"Nngh... the nozzle is inside my rear... The warm solution keeps flowing into my belly, and my lower stomach is swelling fuller and fuller... I-I'll try my best to clench tight!" (My lower belly aches so heavily I'm terrified even taking a breath will make me lose control...!)

"My belly feels so full and crampy, I'm almost at my limit...! Do I really have to hold it for several more minutes before using the toilet...?!" (If I let anything slip right here on the bed, I might as well pass out on the spot...!)

“Please wait, Doctor! This procedure required no enema, so why insist on making me lie on my side and take the entire bag?!” (Using extra precaution as an excuse to watch me squirm... I went through that mortifying enema for nothing!)

“Putting me through such indignity in the name of caution... My cramping abdomen barely lets me sit upright—how unthinkable...!” (Stuck clenching my legs together fighting the urge... This doctor has a seriously wicked streak!)

"Nngh... the warm lather is on, and I can feel every stroke of the razor scraping across my skin so clearly... P-please go slowly!" (With every last hair gone, I feel even more exposed than being naked...!)

“Ah—the incision isn't near my lower abdomen or perineum, so why shave away every bit of my intimate hair too?!” (Telling me it wasn't required AFTER shaving me bare down there—you just wanted to watch me blush!)

strings.collections.special_event_steps.mizuho_f: [9:00 a.m., Hoshimi Hospital's inpatient building. Pulling a small suitcase, Mizuho walks briskly up to the nurses' station.]
“Good morning! I'm here to check in!”
“Mizuho Shite. I'm being admitted today, with surgery next Monday!”
[Asakura checks the booking and admission documents.]
“Found it, Miss Shite. Dr. Sakaguchi has your room ready.”
“Great! Oh, is my room near Chihaya's?”
“Miss Kuramoto is still recovering. Your room is on the same floor.”
“Perfect! Now I won't get bored here.”
“Because I'm perfectly healthy! Weren't all my test results normal?”
“Yes. Your chart is quite clear about that.”
“Good. I don't want being in the hospital to make me all sickly.”
“From today, though, you'll need to follow the inpatient routine.”
“Today we'll complete admission and review the preparations. On Monday morning, we'll follow the surgical schedule. You may not feel quite so relaxed then.”
“You too, Nurse Asakura? Chihaya's already tried scaring me so many times.”
“I'm simply explaining what we'll be doing.”
“Don't worry. It's not my first time in a hospital!”
“...It is your first time here as a surgical patient, though.”
“Ahaha, true! That's what makes it interesting.”
[Asakura hands Mizuho her admission supplies and takes her to the room.]
“Put your things away first. If anything feels wrong, use the call button.”
“Roger! I probably won't need to call for anything today, though.”
“I hope you say the same on Monday.”
“...Why did that sound a little scary?”
[Asakura smiles faintly and straightens the documents at her bedside.]
“Oh, can I go see Chihaya now?”
“Yes. She's able to get out of bed today, but don't get her too excited.”
“I'm visiting a patient, not going to war!”
[Chihaya's room. Wearing her patient pajamas, Chihaya slowly gets to her feet with a hand on the bed, preparing to walk over to the window.]
“I'm officially admitted! We're fellow patients on the same floor now!”
“...Why do you make that sound like joining a club?”
“Aren't you happy? Now you've got company.”
“Of course I am... But you really are having surgery next Monday.”
“I know. I haven't forgotten the date.”
[Mizuho approaches the bed and looks Chihaya over.]
“Yeah. I still have to keep my movements small, though.”
“You're recovering nicely! Then we should be fine to leave together on the Monday after next.”
“Speaking of that... How are you not nervous at all?”
“Why would I be? The doctor confirmed I'm perfectly healthy, and I chose the surgery myself.”
“It's because you've never had surgery that you don't know how scary it is!”
“I'm serious! Before you get on the table, nurses are bustling all around you, checking everything.”
“Isn't it good that the nurses are thorough?”
“It is! But when they say, ‘We'll start the next preparation,’ you wonder what else there is to prepare!”
“I did! Finding out made it even scarier!”
“Don't laugh! And there's the surgical light, the instruments, that scalpel you can tell they're really going to use...”
“Chihaya, you're making this sound like a horror movie.”
“Lie down there yourself and see if it isn't!”
“I'm different. I'm going willingly, so there's no reason to run away.”
[They glare at each other. Mizuho laughs first. Chihaya can't help laughing too, then gently presses a hand to her abdomen.]
“I know. It's your fault for making me laugh.”
“Then I'll try not to laugh at you on Monday. Happy now?”
“Let me stay with you on Monday.”
“From when you go into the operating room. I want to stay with you the whole time.”
“I know. I won't run around. I should be able to sit beside you, right?”
“...Are you coming to watch me embarrass myself?”
[Chihaya takes Mizuho's hand, her tone turning earnest.]
“Last time you came with me to the operating room door. Let it be my turn, okay?”
“What a truly brave surgical patient looks like!”
“When it's over, you'll have to admit I'm tougher than you.”
“Let's wait until you're actually on the table!”
[Later, in a hospital corridor. As Sakaguchi passes outside the room, Chihaya calls out to him.]
“Miss Kuramoto? Why have you run out here on your own?”
“...All right. How is walking going today?”
“Pretty well! So there's something I want to ask you.”
“Can I go into the operating room and stay with Mizuho during her surgery on Monday?”
“You want to go into the operating room?”
“Yeah. Just stand beside her and talk to her.”
“You've only just had surgery. You mustn't push yourself.”
“And you can't enter the sterile area. That isn't somewhere visitors can stand.”
“I know. I won't touch the instruments or go where the doctors work.”
“You'll also need scrubs, a surgical cap, and a mask.”
“Yes. Cover your hair properly. Stay wherever you're assigned to sit.”
“Like an observer. You're not a qualified nurse.”
“Sit and rest when you're tired, and return to your room early if necessary.”
“If Mizuho wants you there too, and you follow those conditions, yes.”
“Then all right. I'll ask a nurse to help you change.”
“Um... You won't put me on the operating table again this time, will you?”
“I know! But hearing ‘operating room’ still scares me.”
“This time you're going to keep someone company.”
“...Yeah. This time it's my turn to be there for her.”
[The hospital work area. Sakaguchi finds Aqua sorting through case notes.]
“Dr. Mizuki, are you free next Monday?”
“Mizuho Shite's open abdominal exploration. I'm operating, and I'd like you as first assistant.”
“Oh—the girl paying for her own laparotomy!”
“None. Her preoperative tests are entirely normal.”
“We'll explore the healthy abdominal and pelvic cavities within the agreed scope.”
“No cysts? Nothing to remove? Not even a gynecological lesion?”
“There's currently no evidence of any abnormality.”
“Hmm... So it's just opening her up, taking a look around, and sewing her back up.”
“I know! It just doesn't sound very challenging this time.”
“Ask someone else! I have cases I want to study.”
[Later, in Diagnostic Imaging. Serika is sorting the day's documents.]
“I have an elective laparotomy next Monday. I'd like you to assist.”
“Mizuho Shite, eighteen. All preoperative tests are normal.”
“Then what's the purpose of the laparotomy?”
“She requested an exploration while healthy. The hospital and I have agreed to accept her.”
“Does she understand what she's going to undergo?”
“We've explained it, and she's signed consent. She's also chosen no anesthesia.”
“You can refuse. I'm only asking if you're willing to assist.”
[Serika watches him for a moment, then opens Mizuho's test results.]
“If the decision is made, her being healthy is no reason to reduce the preparation.”
“I want to confirm the abdominal surface landmarks, instruments, and extent of exposure beforehand.”
“No problem. I'll take responsibility for the final operative plan.”
“Thank you. Hiroko will handle instruments, and Nurse Yoneda will circulate.”
[Later that morning, in Mizuho's room. Sakaguchi brings Serika, Hiroko Sugimura, and Shiori Yoneda to her bedside. Asakura is there too.]
“We're here to confirm Monday's arrangements. This is your surgical team.”
“She said you're amazing, and you tell funny stories about girls' high school!”
“Hello, Miss Shite. I'll prepare whatever the doctors need at the operating table.”
“Yes. But you must listen to the doctors on Monday.”
“I'll assist with monitoring, preoperative preparation, and the necessary records. Please tell me directly if anything feels wrong.”
“Okay! I'll try not to cause any trouble.”
“I'll handle the ward preparations. We'll start early on Monday morning.”
“One final confirmation. Surgery doesn't end with the examination. You personally will undergo preparation, incision, exploration, and closure.”
“I know. That's why I came here.”
[Serika makes a note in the record.]
“On Monday, I'll tell you step by step when we need your cooperation.”
[The team prepares to leave. Mizuho suddenly calls Sakaguchi back.]
“Make sure you sew me up nicely. I still want to wear swimsuits!”
“We'll close the wound carefully as planned. You'll need to cooperate with recovery and scar care too.”
[Serika nods to Sakaguchi, and they leave. Mizuho is still smiling toward the doorway.]
[Saturday evening. Having finished his work, Sakaguchi passes through the inpatient building and stops by Mizuho's room.]
“I wanted to see how you're doing before surgery. Monday's only two days away.”
“I know. I can remember what day it is.”
“Because that's the answer. Once I decided on surgery, I prepared myself mentally.”
“Mm. Even if you requested it yourself, you can still tell me you're scared.”
“And I've decided. On Monday I'll be braver than Chihaya, and I can use the money saved on anesthesia for other things.”
“...So you are still thinking about that anesthesia fee.”
“Of course! I don't like wasting money.”
[Mizuho moves toward the edge of the bed, smiling slyly.]
“By the way, Doctor. Are you busy tonight?”
“Then... Would you keep me company a little longer?”
[She lowers her voice and makes a direct invitation to adult intimacy.]
“I mean, stay and do something grown-up with me.”
“But it's not like you don't like me. You don't dislike me, at least?”
“So strict. In games I've played, doctors and patients do this all the time, don't they?”
“...Wait. Which game did you just say?”
[Mizuho blinks and gives him a mischievous grin.]
“Hehehe. Just pretend you didn't hear that.”
“All right, I understand. I won't make things difficult for you today.”
“Get some rest early tonight. Monday's preparations start in the morning.”
“I'm counting on you on Monday. Take good care of me!”
[Sakaguchi leaves. Mizuho stretches and happily settles back into bed.]

[Monday morning, in Mizuho's room. Preoperative preparations have been underway for a while. Asakura organizes the preparation records. Mizuho lies face down, her face buried in a pillow, unwilling to move at all.]
“Miss Shite, we're nearly done with preparation. Are you all right?”
[Asakura looks at the record, then back at Mizuho on the bed.]
“This morning's shaving and enema are finished. We'll arrange transport next.”
“How can you say those two words so calmly...?”
“Far too thoroughly... All I want to do now is lie here.”
[Chihaya sits beside the bed, trying hard not to laugh.]
“A few days ago you were saying the preparation would be no problem.”
“Nurse Yoneda will place the catheter in the operating room.”
“That's why I said you haven't reached the scariest part yet!”
“Because you said you'd definitely be braver than me!”
[Mizuho lifts her face slightly from the pillow.]
“...Anyway, they haven't operated yet. I'll cooperate properly during the actual surgery.”
“Then please sit up first. You'll need help getting onto the stretcher.”
“...Can I stay like this for one more minute?”
[There is a soft knock. Rumi Iwasaki wheels in a stretcher, still in her ordinary nursing uniform.]
“Good morning! Miss Mizuho Shite, your ride to the operating room is here!”
“Your appointment is today. Huh, why are you lying there so still?”
“She just finished her preparations, and she's already exhausted.”
“Oh dear. A few days ago I heard about a very brave young lady who was even skipping anesthesia.”
“So it really is you! Looks like being brave takes energy too!”
[Rumi and Asakura help Mizuho sit up, adjust her covering, and prepare to transfer her to the stretcher.]
“Miss Chihaya, you're coming along too, right?”
“Yes! Dr. Sakaguchi said I could go in and stay with her.”
“I know. I'll take you to get changed afterward.”
“Fine. Chihaya, just watch how well I do.”
[With both nurses' help, Mizuho lies down. Rumi pushes the stretcher out of the room, with Chihaya walking alongside.]
[The operating room. With her hair covered by a patient cap, Mizuho is transferred onto the operating table. Yoneda connects the monitors while Hiroko checks the instruments they will need later.]
“Miss Shite, I'm Yoneda. We met in your room last Friday. I'll be your circulating nurse today.”
“Blood pressure and heart rate first. Put your arm here and relax your shoulders a little.”
[Sakaguchi comes to the table in scrubs, not yet wearing a sterile gown.]
“Let's confirm once more. Today we'll perform the agreed open exploration of your healthy abdominal and pelvic cavities. Is no anesthesia still your choice?”
“All right. Tell us directly if anything feels wrong.”
[Yoneda helps position Mizuho, and the nurses adjust her covering. Mizuho looks up at the surgical light directly overhead.]
“Wow... So this is what it looks like lying here.”
[Sakaguchi performs a final routine external examination, noticing the balanced muscle tone from her regular exercise.]
“You're in very good shape. You exercise a lot?”
“Hehe! You can tell? I take good care of my figure!”
“Your abdominal muscles are in good condition too.”
“Of course! I'm a little more mature than Chihaya!”

[Hiroko, not yet at her sterile instrument station, notices Mizuho's striking contrast in skin tones while helping check the preparations. Her arms and outer body are tanned, while the chest and abdomen normally covered by her one-piece swimsuit form a broad area of pale skin.]
“A one-piece swimsuit, right? The contrast is so neat.”
“You caught me! I used to sunbathe outdoors a lot.”
“They certainly stand out. Even more under the surgical light.”
“And you have a lovely figure. Honestly, quite sexy.”
“Hehehe! You've got a good eye, Hiroko!”
[She proudly straightens her shoulders, then notices the instruments being prepared beside the table. Her smile suddenly falters.]
“But... I'm lying on an operating table right now.”
“What's going on... Am I making this surgery seem more and more like some strange kind of play...?”
[Yoneda adjusts her arm position and continues checking the monitors.]
“Are you comfortable in that position? Are your shoulders being pulled too tightly?”
“You were so pleased a moment ago. Why so quiet all of a sudden?”
“I was just thinking... You really seem to be starting the preparations.”
“Yes. Didn't you come here specifically for surgery today?”
[Mizuho glances toward her abdomen, then back up at the surgical light.]
“You'll stay here the whole time, right?”
“I'm the surgeon. We'll begin when everything's ready.”
[Serika approaches the table in scrubs. She has reviewed Mizuho's records but has not yet scrubbed in or put on a sterile gown.]
“Miss Shite, I'll examine your abdomen again. Please lie flat.”
“Relax your knees a little. I'll check your abdomen first.”
[Serika puts on examination gloves and palpates Mizuho's abdomen.]
[She continues examining the planned area. Mizuho involuntarily tenses her stomach.]
“Because your hands are so cold, Doctor...”
“Then I'll give you a moment to steady your breathing.”
[Mizuho exhales. Serika examines her again, then confirms the findings with Sakaguchi.]
“The external examination matches the records. No change to the planned exploration.”
[Serika picks up a marker and draws the planned incision line at the location agreed with Sakaguchi. Watching the line appear on her abdomen, Mizuho suddenly falls silent.]
“We need sufficient exposure to complete the examination.”
[Serika turns to Hiroko and confirms the instruments one by one.]
“Nurse Hiroko, prepare a number ten blade for the skin incision. Have the subsequent dissection instruments ready according to the list.”
“Understood. I'll check the handle and blade.”
“Confirm the retractor size again as well.”
“Miss Shite, please don't lift your leg suddenly.”
“I know! But you're being so specific!”
“O-of course I'm all right... It's just, looking at that line...”
“You can say you're scared. Don't move suddenly during the examination.”
“Th-then can I stop looking at the line for now?”
[Mizuho immediately looks away toward the surgical light.]
[The incision marking is complete. Yoneda continues with catheterization and preoperative skin preparation.]
“Miss Shite, we'll place the urinary catheter next. I'm letting you know first.”
“Yes. We confirmed this during your preoperative explanation.”
“I remember... I've just suddenly decided I'd rather not remember.”
“There will be some discomfort. I'll tell you when we're starting.”
[Yoneda begins the preparations for catheterization while Mizuho is awake, adjusting the covering. Mizuho nervously clutches the sheet beside her.]
“We're about to. Please relax as much as you can.”
[During catheterization, Mizuho draws a sharp breath, her face flushing at once.]
“Don't lift your hips. We're almost finished.”
“You say almost, but why does it feel so long?!”
“It's in place. Next I'll secure the catheter and check the drainage.”
“...Why do you have to emphasize ‘this step’?”
[Yoneda confirms drainage and the monitoring records, then proceeds to disinfect the operative skin area.]
“I'll disinfect the skin now. It may feel a little cold.”
“Bear with it a little. It won't take long.”
[Sakaguchi checks the preparations and confirms Serika's incision marking.]
“The incision mark is fine. Nurse Yoneda, let me know when you're finished here.”
“To get ready for sterile work. I'll be right back.”
[Sakaguchi steps away. Serika and Hiroko also begin scrubbing and sterile gowning for their roles. Watching Yoneda continue her preparations, Mizuho can't help speaking up.]
“I know. Your heart rate is a little higher than when you arrived.”
“You've been cooperating. Being nervous and cooperating are different things.”
“If you need her, I can remind Miss Chihaya to come over sooner.”

[The operating room changing area. Rumi is already in scrubs, a surgical cap, and a mask. She has found properly sized scrubs for Chihaya and checks that Chihaya's cap covers her hair. Now changed, Chihaya adjusts her mask in the mirror.]
“It does! But... I really look like an operating room nurse now!”
“Hehe, you're only an accompanying observer today.”
“I know! It just feels so strange.”
[Chihaya raises both hands and looks down at her scrubs.]
“Last week I was lying on that table, scared to death... Now I'm wearing almost the same clothes as you.”
“You walked into the operating room yourself last week. I thought you'd made so much progress.”
“You were still surrounding me on both sides!”
“No need to worry this time. Nobody's putting you on the table.”
“Ahaha! Right. It's finally my turn to stand today.”
“But not for too long. Your own incision is still healing.”
[Rumi checks her mask and straightens the loose edge of her cap.]
“...My fourth time in an operating room, and dressed like this.”
“...A little. But Mizuho's probably more nervous than I am.”
[They arrive near the operating room entrance. Sakaguchi has just finished scrubbing and is preparing to gown up.]
“Yep! Look! Don't I look the part?”
“Hehe, that's the first time you've praised me like that!”
“Don't get carried away. You're here to keep a patient company today.”
“Mizuho's waiting inside. She's starting to get nervous.”
“Yes. Going in and talking to her should help.”

[Sakaguchi continues gowning up. Rumi brings Chihaya into the operating room through the designated route. Yoneda has finished the preoperative preparations. Mizuho lies on the table, so tense she barely dares move.]
“You... Why are you dressed like that?”
“Impressive, right? I'm your personal companion now!”
“More precisely, an observer permitted to sit beside you.”
“Rumi! Let me be cool for a moment!”
[Rumi helps Chihaya sit in the designated nonsterile position.]
“Of course. I promised I'd stay with you.”
[Mizuho looks into her eyes for a moment, then nods gently.]
“Then I'll leave Miss Chihaya with you. Nurse Yoneda, I've brought everything needed here.”
[Rumi leaves this operation's working area. Chihaya stays where Mizuho can hear her.]

[The team finishes sterile gowning and draping. Sakaguchi and Serika take their places, Hiroko stands beside the instrument table, and Yoneda remains at her monitoring and circulating station. Watching everyone line up, Mizuho's shoulders tense abruptly.]
“I won't. The doctor said I can sit here.”
“I'm suddenly thinking... You were amazing before.”
[Yoneda checks the monitors and preparation records.]
“Monitoring stable, preparations complete. Catheter draining normally.”
“Final check. Patient Mizuho Shite, planned open exploration of healthy abdominal and pelvic cavities. No anesthesia by her own choice. Preoperative confirmation records complete.”
“I know I agreed already... But you're really all ready?”
“Yes. If there's something you need to say, you can say it now.”
“You can cry out. Keep your body as steady as you can, and explain clearly if something feels wrong.”
[From the nonsterile area, Chihaya reaches out and gently touches Mizuho's hand beside her head.]
“If you're scared, say so. I won't laugh at you.”
[Before Mizuho can retort again, Hiroko has handed the scalpel to Sakaguchi.]
[Sakaguchi takes the instrument and begins the skin incision.]
[Mizuho draws a sharp breath, then lets out a loud scream.]
“Miss Shite, don't hold your breath. Let it out slowly first.”
“You can shout. Don't suddenly lift your body. Follow me: breathe in, slowly out.”
[Mizuho tries to exhale in broken breaths. Sakaguchi and Serika continue working on the incision as planned, while Hiroko passes the instruments in sequence.]
“Ugh... Why are you still talking so calmly?!”
“Then why are you so calm now too?!”
“Because I don't have to lie there this time!”
[Mizuho bites her lip, then cries out again at the next wave of pain. Yoneda checks the monitors and urinary drainage.]
“Miss Shite, your heart rate is a little fast. I know it hurts. Follow Dr. Misono's breathing rhythm first.”
“I can see you're cooperating. Don't try to pull yourself up.”
[Yoneda checks the collection bag and notes the change.]
“Urine output has increased. Noting that down.”
“The urine in the collection bag. I'm recording the monitoring observations.”
“The catheter is meant to drain urine. Try not to get distracted.”
[Mizuho's face turns bright red. Chihaya gently squeezes her fingers.]
[Hearing Serika suddenly use her given name, Mizuho struggles to turn her gaze toward her.]
“Just keep up with the breathing. You're already doing it.”
[Mizuho manages to finish exhaling. Sakaguchi and Serika complete the initial work on the incision and continue the exploration into the abdominal cavity.]
“We've only just begun. We'll examine everything step by step as planned.”
“That's why I told you it was scary...”
[The operation continues. Sakaguchi and Serika work together to adjust exposure; Hiroko prepares the retractor while Yoneda keeps checking the monitors.]
“We need to hold the incision in the right position to see clearly inside.”
“Mizuho, you may feel a strong pulling sensation shortly. Keep as still as you can.”
[The retractor is positioned. Mizuho squeezes her eyes shut for a moment, then can't help opening them again.]
[Seated in the nonsterile observation position, Chihaya has been watching only Mizuho's face. Hearing the doctors discuss the operative field, she can't help glancing over.]
“I-I think I saw... Inside your stomach...”
“Sorry! I didn't mean to! I was just a little curious!”
“Don't get casually curious about things like that!!”
[Serika adjusts the traction, keeping her eyes on the operative field.]
“Small bowel position is normal. We'll examine the upper abdomen in order, then the mesentery and pelvis.”
“I'll maintain exposure. The tissue planes are clear here.”
“It's something we use in surgery. The name sounds scary, but it's ordinary work.”
“Heart rate is coming down. Miss Mizuho, your breathing is much steadier than at the start.”
“Really. You haven't forgotten to follow the doctors' instructions.”
“...So I am doing pretty well, right?”
[The doctors continue the examination as planned.]
“Liver surface normal. No obvious gallbladder abnormality.”
“Then can you just tell me whether the results are good?”
[Sakaguchi begins examining the bowel and relevant parts of the mesentery. Serika adjusts the instruments and direction of traction to maintain visibility.]
“We simply need to confirm this area properly.”
“The tissue looks healthy. No lesions found.”
“...Then why did you suddenly get so serious?”
“...That makes so much sense I can't argue.”
[Hearing that Mizuho can still complain, Chihaya relaxes a little and looks back at the doctors' work.]
“Look, Dr. Serika's movements are so steady. And Hiroko passes things so quickly.”
“...Are you here to be their cheerleader now?”
“I know! That's why I think you're amazing too.”
[Mizuho pauses, then manages a strained smile.]
“...Complimenting me now won't make me forgive you for peeking inside my stomach.”

[The operation continues. Yoneda checks the monitors regularly, while Hiroko maintains steady instrument exchanges with both doctors. Through pain and fatigue, Mizuho tries to follow Serika's breathing cues.]
[The operation has reached the pelvic exploration. The door opens, and Aqua approaches the table, already scrubbed in and wearing a surgical cap, mask, and sterile gown.]
“Thanks for your hard work, everyone! I'm here for a look—”
[Aqua stops, looking at the exploration underway.]
“Mizuki? Didn't you say today's surgery wasn't interesting?”
“Assisting wasn't interesting. But seeing a healthy girl's pelvis like this in open surgery is such a rare opportunity!”
“Oh, Miss Mizuho, good morning! You're so energetic!”
“I'm in this much pain! Where do you see any energy?!”
[Serika looks up at Aqua and shakes her head slightly.]
“You checked with the circulating nurse before coming in, didn't you?”
“Confirmed. Dr. Mizuki has completed sterile preparation and entered as an additional observer.”
“All the formalities are done! I won't get in the way!”
“Then observe from the side. Don't block the surgeon's view.”
[Aqua observes intently. Sakaguchi and Serika continue examining, with Hiroko passing instruments as requested.]
“What beautiful normal anatomy. Such clear tissue planes are a rare sight.”
“Yes! When everything is healthy, it's especially easy to see how the structures relate to one another.”
“You're a patient undergoing an examination. We're completing the exploration you agreed to.”
“But you really are healthy! I've always wanted a close look at a pelvis in this condition.”
“...Suddenly I don't know whether to be happy or cry!”
“Haven't you wanted everyone to praise how healthy you are all day?”
“Praising my health and saying the inside of my stomach looks pretty are two different things!!”
[Aqua looks at the operative field Serika is maintaining.]
“Dr. Misono, have you checked here already?”
“Can I stand a little closer to look?”
“Stand on my side. Don't touch the retractor.”
[Aqua moves to the position Serika allows and leans forward to observe.]
“You can tell with my mask on?”
“I can hear it in your voice!!”
“Because I'm happy. There's really nothing wrong here. Being healthy is a good thing!”
[A wave of pain makes Mizuho's voice suddenly tremble.]
“...Oh dear, this really is hard on you.”
[Chihaya can't help letting out a laugh, then immediately looks back at Mizuho.]
“Hang in there, Mizuho. They're nearly finished examining.”
[Sakaguchi and Serika finish exploring the agreed area. Aqua listens carefully to their confirmations, while Hiroko prepares the instruments needed to conclude the examination.]
“No abnormalities found throughout the pelvis. The planned examination is complete.”
“Confirmed. No lesions requiring treatment or removal.”
“...Could all three of you say that again?”
“No, no, I want the part before that.”
“You didn't know! All you knew was that I'd be operated on!”
[Mizuho looks at the ceiling and sighs with relief, then frowns at the pulling sensation inside her body.]
“...So can you close my stomach now?”
“We still need a final review, confirm hemostasis, and then close the abdomen layer by layer.”
“Since we've opened you up to check, we have to be thorough to the end.”
“Hiroko, don't make it sound like opening a parcel!”
“Well, you keep telling us to hurry up and finish work.”
“I really do want this work finished!”
[Yoneda checks the monitoring data and records the times of the operative stages.]
“Patient stable. Exploration completion time entered in the circulating record.”
“We can photograph it using the agreed medical documentation procedure.”
“Mizuho. You said before that you wanted a memento of this experience.”
“...I've said a lot of foolish things. Which one?”
“If you'd like, we can take a medical record photograph of the explored area, as a memento of this operation.”
“...A photo of the inside of my stomach?”
“Yes. Only for the agreed medical record and for you to keep personally.”
“Didn't you say you wanted a special souvenir?”
“You don't need to force yourself to decide now. We'll continue with the remaining procedures.”
[She tries to relax her shoulders. That familiar defiance returns to her eyes.]
“O-of course... I'm already opened up like this... Wouldn't it be a waste not to...!”
“Wow, Miss Mizuho, you really are brave!”
“C-call it the last of my courage...!”
[Yoneda takes the photograph and completes its record. Sakaguchi and Serika perform the final review while Hiroko continues checking instruments.]
“Suturing is next. We'll need your cooperation a little longer.”
“Why doesn't ‘sewing me up’ sound any easier than ‘cutting me open’?!”

[With the examination complete, Sakaguchi and Serika begin closing the abdomen layer by layer. Hiroko prepares suturing instruments and materials, while Yoneda continues recording the patient's condition.]
“Well, I've seen the part I wanted. You've worked hard, Miss Mizuho!”
“Because it's closure next. I have other work in a little while.”
“I've suffered here all day, and you make it sound like the tour's over!”
“If there's another unusual case next time, I'd love to help!”
[Aqua says goodbye to Sakaguchi and Serika, steps out of the sterile working position, and leaves the operating room following procedure.]
“Mizuho, we're ready to begin suturing. It'll take a while longer. Keep your breathing as steady as you can.”
“We need to take care of each layer properly.”
“Just how many layers... does ‘each layer’ mean...?”
[Mizuho squeezes her eyes shut, her shoulders tensing.]
“Don't hold your breath. Breathe in, then slowly out.”
“You got through the first cut. You can do this too.”
“I only dare say that because it's you.”
[Mizuho struggles to smile, tightening her fingers around Chihaya's hand.]
[Sakaguchi and Serika work on the deeper layers of the incision. Hiroko assists with instrument exchanges.]
“Material for the next stitch is ready.”
[Yoneda checks the monitors and updates the circulating record.]
“Breathing is steadier than in the previous stage. Miss Mizuho, just keep this up.”
“...You make it sound... like I'm really capable...”
“...If I'd known it would hurt this much, I would have...”
“...Had one more delicious meal before coming!”
[Chihaya laughs, then quickly wipes the corner of her eye with her other hand.]
“Who's crying?! You're the one who was screaming loudest!”
[The surgery continues. Sakaguchi finishes a section of suturing, and Serika checks the approximation of the incision.]
“Dr. Sakaguchi, I can complete this next section too.”
“I know. You've done very well today.”
“Let me finish the rest. You've been working since preparation began. Go and rest.”
[Serika looks at the incision, then at Sakaguchi.]
[Serika steps away from the sterile field and moves to Mizuho's head. Mizuho's eyes are closed, her face exhausted, her lips still trembling slightly with pain.]
“Dr. Sakaguchi will finish this last part. The examination results are very good.”
“...I know... You've all said it so many times...”
“Hold on a little longer. You'll be able to rest soon.”
[Serika gently rests her still-gloved hand on Mizuho's bare shoulder.]
[Mizuho slowly opens her eyes and looks at Serika, dazed.]
“Today's operation will end well. You can rest assured.”
[Looking at Serika's rare smile, Mizuho nods faintly.]
[Serika withdraws her hand, nods to Sakaguchi, and leaves the sterile working position beside the table.]
[Sakaguchi continues the remaining layered closure. Mizuho grips Chihaya's hand tightly, occasionally letting out a quiet cry of pain.]
“Now... I think I understand a little... Why you're so scared every time.”
“...Yeah. A hundred times scarier... than I imagined.”
“...I've done it three times, you know.”
[Mizuho smiles again, then squeezes her eyes shut at the pulling sensation from the suturing.]
[Sakaguchi completes the final suture and rechecks the incision.]
[Mizuho lets out a long breath, her eyes suddenly filling with tears.]
“You make it sound like you went to death's door!”
[Chihaya and Mizuho look at each other and laugh together.]
[Hiroko and Yoneda perform the final instrument, needle, and dressing counts and check the records.]
“Circulating record checked. Patient stable. Preparing postoperative transfer.”
“Congratulations, Miss Mizuho. Your first surgery is over.”
“...Next time you call me sexy... Could you do it somewhere else...?”
“Of course. Next time I'll compliment you in your room.”
[Yoneda checks the dressing and transfer preparations. Chihaya slowly releases Mizuho's hand.]
“I'll wait for you back in the ward.”
“Mizuho, rest now. We'll keep monitoring your recovery.”
“...That photo... Don't forget to show me...”
[Mizuho closes her eyes. At last, a faint smile returns to her lips.]
[Tuesday, 9:00 a.m., in Mizuho's room. Awake now, Mizuho carefully tries to shift her upper body. Asakura checks the nursing record at her bedside.]
“Slowly. You only had surgery yesterday. You'll need help getting up today.”

“Who was saying before yesterday that she'd recover faster than Miss Chihaya?”

[Asakura looks at her and can't help smiling.]
[A knock sounds. Sakaguchi and Serika enter.]
“Good morning, Mizuho. How are you feeling today?”
[Mizuho tries to wave as brightly as she did on Friday, but immediately pulls at her abdomen and frowns.]
“Good morning. How did you sleep last night?”
[Seeing Serika, Mizuho suddenly remembers her cold, stern face before yesterday's incision. Her shoulders reflexively tighten.]
“She woke several times during the night. Her pain and wound condition have been recorded.”
[Sakaguchi checks the record. Serika approaches the bed to examine Mizuho's recovery and dressing.]
“Lie back properly for now. I'll look around the wound.”
[Mizuho settles down and lets Serika examine her.]
“Recovery looks good. The dressing has been kept in good condition.”
“So that really scary face yesterday was your work face?!”
“...That's my expression when I need to concentrate on the operative field.”
“I see. So when I see that face again, I'll know I'm in trouble.”
“Not necessarily. Yesterday she was examining a very healthy patient.”
[Serika adjusts the dressing and smooths the blanket beside Mizuho.]
“...Um, what will the wound look like later?”
“There'll be a mark for a while. Follow the care plan as you recover. It will fade gradually.”
“Enough that it won't be very noticeable in a swimsuit?”
“The incision edges are well aligned. With the prescribed care, the mark will be very faint once you've recovered.”
[Mizuho sighs with relief, then suddenly raises her head.]
“Wait, I have a more important question.”
“Where's yesterday's photo? The one of my perfectly healthy organs!”
“It's a precious souvenir from the surgery I paid for! Of course I'd ask!”
“The photography and documentation are done. Once it's organized, we'll show you.”
[Mizuho starts to sit up happily, sees Asakura's expression, and obediently leans back against her pillow.]
[Serika puts the examination supplies in order.]
“It really hurt yesterday. Especially when you started drawing that line—that was when I realized everyone meant business.”
“...Did I? I was screaming so loudly.”
“Screaming loudly and cooperating with surgery are separate things.”
“You kept following the breathing cues, and didn't move at critical moments. I could see that.”
[Mizuho pauses, then smiles with a mixture of shyness and pride.]
“...When you put it that way, I suddenly feel pretty cool.”
“You can think of it that way.”
“You did hold on until the end.”
“...You smiled, didn't you? When I called you ‘Dr. Daimon.’”
“...You still had the energy to remember that?”
“How could I forget! You were so serious all day, but for that one moment you really looked like Michiko Daimon!”
“Right! And you patted my shoulder too. So cool!”
[Asakura presses her lips together to keep from laughing. Sakaguchi closes the record.]
“All right. You're doing well today. Focus on recovering now. Don't rush to race Chihaya out of bed.”
“Tell Nurse Asakura if anything feels wrong.”
[Sakaguchi and Serika finish giving Asakura the follow-up observation instructions and prepare to leave.]
[As the door opens, Chihaya peeks in. Still in her patient clothes, she walks much more steadily than a few days ago.]
“Good morning. Don't forget your own recovery.”
“I know! I'm just here to see Mizuho!”
“...Dr. Misono, why does everyone keep telling me to walk slowly now?”
“Because the way you rushed through the door didn't look like someone who'd just had surgery!”
“That's because you shouted for me so loudly!”
[Sakaguchi and Serika leave. Asakura returns to work at the nurses' station. Chihaya pulls up a chair beside Mizuho's bed and sits down.]
“What are you laughing at?! I really thought I was done for yesterday!”
“I told you on Friday how scary it was.”
“Who said she absolutely wouldn't be scared like me?”
[Chihaya rocks with laughter, then presses a hand to her still-recovering abdomen.]
“Ah, ow, ow... I can't laugh that hard...”
“Serves you right! You're not fully recovered either!”
“...True. You're still recovering, and I've just had surgery.”
[They fall quiet briefly, then laugh together again.]
“...Weren't you watching me make a fool of myself all day?”
“No! I was worried about you too.”
[Mizuho looks down at the folds in her blanket.]
“When the first cut came yesterday, all I could think was, ‘I'm doomed. Why did I choose no anesthesia?’”
“And then you were beside me the whole time. Every time I wanted to shut my eyes and just scream, I heard you talking to me.”
“I always thought you got scared far too easily. Now I realize that going into the operating room again and again, when you're that frightened... Is actually amazing.”
“It's not that... It's just a little embarrassing.”
“There were still ways I was braver than you yesterday!”
“At least I didn't run away once!”
“You only started getting scared after you were already secured on the table!”
“And I didn't run the third time either! I walked in myself!”
“Okay, okay, you were super brave the third time!”
“You sound like you're humoring a little kid!!”
[Mizuho's eyes curve into a particularly smug smile.]
“...But there is one thing you're really better at.”
“Sitting beside me in scrubs yesterday, you looked like an old hand. If it were me, I might not dare enter an operating room again.”
“...I was actually nervous too. Seeing the operating table still makes my heart jump.”
[Mizuho has no reply for a moment.]
“You stayed with me before. What's strange about it being my turn?”
[Mizuho reaches out. Chihaya takes her hand, and they sit quietly for a while.]
“...I came here to keep you company in the hospital. Instead, you spent the whole day with me yesterday.”
“...Hmph. I'll count this one as your win.”
“Why does even this have to have a winner?!”
[A moment later, Chihaya suddenly remembers something.]
“Oh! We can leave together next Monday, right?”
“That's the plan. We'll have to celebrate properly!”
“After what you went through yesterday, you still want to celebrate?”
“Of course! Now I have a photo of the inside of my stomach that nobody else has!”
“Please don't take that to a restaurant to show people!”
[Mizuho laughs for a while, then carefully presses a hand against the blanket.]
“Haha, even that's the same for us.”
“Once we're discharged... Let's have a good meal first.”
“Anything, as long as I don't have to hear ‘scalpel,’ ‘retractor,’ or ‘suture needle.’”
“Then next time we're at a restaurant, I'll call a surgical time-out before ordering.”
[After their laughter subsides, Chihaya remains at the bedside with Mizuho. Mizuho carefully adjusts her pillow, finally regaining some of the brightness she had when admitted on Friday.]
strings.collections.special_event_steps.chihaya_: [Monday, nine in the morning. In the inpatient building, Chihaya stands beside her bed in her own clothes, carefully checking her packed travel bag.]
