She takes a complete history and does not chase a single abnormal measure. She integrates history, long-term medications, and multisystem risks into a full medical picture and clearly calls for a delay when perioperative risk remains unclear.
A model young woman doctor: beautiful, accomplished, courteous, and popular with patients. Many people meeting her assume she can do everything.
She grows from the flawless doctor everyone sees into an ordinary adult woman who can admit an error in judgment, let Sakaguchi share the burden, and rest comfortably beyond her identity as a doctor.

Courteous, clear, steady, and seldom interrupting. She translates technical terms into language patients understand, gives reasons before disagreeing, and, once familiar, shows understated humor and a competitive streak.
Broad medical knowledge and a habit of seeing the whole patient rather than a single specialty
Communicates well with patients, helping them voice their real concerns
Emotionally steady and skilled at integrating fragmentary conclusions from multiple consultations
Works naturally across departments

The higher the pressure, the calmer and more courteous she becomes. She checks materials repeatedly, cuts unnecessary words, and holds herself to an error-free standard; even exhausted, she often says, “I’m fine.”
strings.collections.staff.doc_shiori.dialogue_st: Polite and clear, with an even speaking pace; explains her reasons before objecting. She translates jargon for patients and, as she grows familiar, occasionally shows understated humor and competitiveness.
strings.collections.staff.doc_takemi.appearance: Short blue-black hair with straight bangs and reddish-brown eyes; white coat, black dress, red belt, and studded choker
strings.collections.staff.doc_takemi.dialogue_st: Initially aloof; becomes languid and gently teasing as she gets to know someone. At critical medical moments she is terse, precise, and highly perceptive. She never volunteers long explanations of her own quirks.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ange.appearance: Portrait supplied by the user; operating-room variant made with the built-in ImageGen tool
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ange.characteriz: Her cruel verbal lapse toward a vulnerable patient must be treated as serious professional misconduct. The related story must show intervention, patient protection, consequences, reflection, and repair, never framing it as correct judgment or a comedic reward.
Often expresses concern as orders and challenges
Can sulk or interrupt when frustrated
May say seriously hurtful things when she loses control
May briefly panic at the onset of a crisis
In routine surgery she is perceptive, adept with instruments, and concise in confirming orders. She immediately challenges ambiguous orders or conduct that appears to neglect a patient.
An intelligent, hardworking, highly efficient outpatient and OR nurse. She holds doctors to strict standards and will directly correct conduct she considers irresponsible.

At first she scrutinizes and frequently questions Sakaguchi Ryuji. As he demonstrates skill, responsibility, and judgment under pressure, she gradually entrusts control to him and they become complementary partners, though her professional assertiveness and emotionality remain.

At work she favors brisk confirmations and imperative sentences. As emotions rise she interrupts and repeats key words. Once calm, she struggles to apologize directly, more often repairing the relationship through extra work and action.
Anticipates the surgeon’s needs and passes instruments accurately
Proactively checks procedures and points out omissions
Works wholeheartedly and will argue on a patient’s behalf
When a patient suddenly deteriorates, she may first speak faster, panic, or burst out. Once given a clear, specific task, she usually recovers her professional rhythm quickly.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ange.dialogue_st: Terse and forceful at work, accustomed to correcting others; when emotional she may interrupt or speak too harshly. Under intense pressure she may panic first, then regain her rhythm through clear instructions.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_haru.dialogue_st: Natural and concise, with occasional teasing remarks; quick to notice when a patient’s words and behavior do not match, and directly but firmly corrects the team when needed.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hikami_saeko.app: Short, side-parted charcoal-black hair, narrow dark eyes, and faint diagonal cheek markings. Height 167 cm, measurements 82/55/85 cm, blood type B.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hikami_saeko.dia: Conscientious and courteous at work, with concrete explanations; ordinary work dialogue does not reveal the investigation she was entrusted with.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hiroko.appearanc: Original-work portrait supplied by the user; operating-room variant made with the built-in ImageGen tool
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hiroko.character: Her tragic aspect should come from the cost of carrying responsibility and hiding pain for years. She must not be written as passively waiting to be rescued; her judgment, choices, and resilience retain their agency.
Tends to care for others first while hiding her own burden
Reluctant to ask colleagues for help
Too quick to take responsibility upon herself

Primarily a ward nurse, she observes carefully and gives complete handoffs. She has mature surgical nursing training and can serve as scrub or circulating nurse, but does not present herself as an OR specialist.
A warm, reliable, attentive nurse who naturally looks after everyone on the ward like an older sister. Pharmacist Iimura Manami is a close friend she trusts deeply.

The details of how she meets Sakaguchi Ryuji and their bond remain to be designed. The central direction is a progression from dependable, senior-like care to a willingness to let Sakaguchi see her vulnerable and burdened side.
She often uses gentle confirmation and reassurance, considering the other person’s feelings. On a matter of principle, she does not raise her voice, but slows down and restates her boundary clearly.
Notices small changes in a patient’s condition
Comforts patients and coordinates relationships among staff
Performs ward and surgical nursing reliably
Can refuse gently but firmly on matters of principle
The more urgent things become, the more she first steadies those around her; she rarely breaks down on the spot. She often saves her real exhaustion and pain for moments alone.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_hiroko.dialogue_: Gentle and good at looking after the atmosphere; when she truly needs to insist, her words remain soft but she does not give ground.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ishigami.appeara: Original-work portrait reference supplied by the user; AI-enhanced transparent half-body portraits in a capped nurse-manager uniform and operating-room monitoring scrubs. Her everyday uniform includes a thin black choker with a small silver pendant; she removes all neck jewelry in the surgical department.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ishigami.charact: Her authority comes from making the team more stable, not humiliating younger nurses, diminishing other nurses, or overriding a doctor’s medical judgment.
Her cool manner can make newcomers overly nervous
Almost no patience for vague duties or shortcuts taken on faith
Rarely lets others see her fatigue

In ordinary surgery she rounds and supervises without occupying a standard nurse position. In advanced referrals, public teaching operations, and large events she commands the nursing side and only temporarily fills a front-line role when necessary, with exceptional skill.

The hospital-wide head of nursing, visibly young yet vested with full authority. Cool, sparing with words, and intensely intimidating, she seldom performs front-line nursing herself, but the whole nursing system knows she is watching.

She begins by examining whether Sakaguchi respects nursing judgment and staffing limits, gradually developing professional trust on behalf of the entire nursing system. The highest level is institutional belonging and recognition of leadership, not romance.
Short sentences, explicit reasons, and little repetition. She is often most intimidating when her tone is flattest; a single dry fact sometimes ends an argument.
Allocates nursing personnel and resources hospital-wide
Organizes rotation, supplies, and documentation during major surgery

The greater the pressure, the flatter her tone. She protects patients first, relieves overworked personnel, and fills gaps in responsibilities and procedure; only afterward does she ask those involved to explain their judgment.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_ishigami.dialogu: Seventy-five percent brief, calm, and professional; fifteen percent dry, restrained humor; ten percent rare personal warmth. She seldom raises her voice, gives long lectures, or disguises mistakes with comforting words.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_iwasaki_rumi.app: Chestnut-brown high ponytail and red eyes; height 163 cm, weight 44 kg, measurements 86/55/85 cm.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_iwasaki_rumi.dia: Quick and bright, willing to ask direct follow-up questions; explains herself clearly at work without relying on exaggerated sentence endings.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_iwasaki_rumi.ran: Young Senior Nurse; usually works on the ward, at the nurses’ station, or in circulating roles
strings.collections.staff.nurse_kariya_megumi.ap: Short violet-blue hair, brown eyes, and faint diagonal cheek markings.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_kariya_megumi.di: Reports facts even when nervous; parenthetical text represents thoughts visible only to the player.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_moe.appearance: Original-work expression variants supplied by the user; black backgrounds removed and images standardized on high-resolution transparent canvases
strings.collections.staff.nurse_moe.characteriza: Her nearsightedness and carelessness should be improvable work habits and sources of light comedy. When patient safety is involved, risks must be managed through checks, supervision, and clear procedures.
Can barely identify signs without her glasses
Gets flustered and clumsy under stress
May focus so hard on details that she misses the obvious
Her outpatient nursing foundation is sound and she treats patients gently. She has little OR experience and needs clear instructions and checks, but actively studies and records routes and steps.
A newly appointed outpatient nurse who is earnest and polite. She checks everything diligently, but her broad-brush habits and severe nearsightedness lead to mistakes in unexpected places.
Starting from an exasperating changing-room misunderstanding, she builds reliability by earnestly making up for small mistakes and gradually dares to admit her awkwardness to Sakaguchi.
She usually speaks politely. In a panic she repeats “Huh?”, “I’m sorry,” and negations. Once calm, she nods solemnly as though accepting a major medical order.
Patient with those in her care and willing to check repeatedly
Works hard to complete clearly assigned tasks
Carefully reviews mistakes and seeks ways to prevent repeats
She first yelps, stammers, and apologizes repeatedly. Once the task is clear, she straightens up and follows it with almost excessive earnestness.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_moe.dialogue_sty: Polite and earnest; stammers and apologizes repeatedly when nervous. She carefully writes down even small instructions and only realizes a blunder a moment later.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_rin.appearance: AI-enhanced from a VNDB reference image; local placeholder
strings.collections.staff.nurse_rin.characteriza: Mature
Friendly
Dependable
Restrained
Observant
Highly private
Hard to read

Her present kindness must be genuine, never revealed as a long deception. Possible grave wrongdoing in her past must not be automatically excused by romance, physical intimacy, or medical trust. Do not supply a full case file, a definite wanted-person match, or proof of ultimate innocence, and do not make investigating her past the main relationship plot.
Guards her personal boundaries so tightly that asking for help is difficult
Refuses to fully explain her past even at the highest level of trust
Answers only what she chooses, leaving those close to her feeling shut out
Her sensitivity to records, access permissions, and hospital routes is sometimes disconcertingly precise

She excels at ward nursing, observing patient conditions, complex handoffs, and perioperative support. She is especially good at hearing what patients leave unsaid when they claim to be fine. Throughout the current timeline she puts patient safety first and takes no part in drug misuse, sabotage, blackmail, or harm to Hoshimi patients or colleagues.

A senior ward nurse who is approachable, capable, reliable, and skilled at setting others at ease. She joins dinners and hospital activities and genuinely cares for patients and colleagues; even after working with her for years, most people realize they know almost nothing of her life before Hoshimi Hospital.

Sakaguchi comes to know the real, kind, desirous, and tired Nakai of the present, while growing certain that she has deliberately sealed off a grave past. Lv5 represents maximum trust, but does not buy a full confession: she acknowledges the door and explicitly refuses to hand over its key. The game maintains strong suspicion by default without conclusive legal proof.

At work she uses concise confirmation statements; in private she is natural and tactful, sometimes teasing on purpose. Asked about her past, she rarely tells a verifiable lie, instead offering very narrow truths such as having worked at several places or finding a work environment unsuitable, then changing the subject with a light question such as “Is this a medical history interview?”
Detects pain or anxiety patients conceal through tone, movement, and handoff details
Experienced in ward handoffs, long-term inpatient care, and perioperative transfers
Keeps information under control, steadies the team, and quickly spots process gaps under pressure
Sociable without seeking attention; supports and mentors younger nurses

The more urgent the situation, the calmer she becomes. She quickly checks personnel, exits, records, and who knows what. She rarely loses her composure in public and does not visibly panic at the sight of police or reminders of her past. When the past is truly touched, she usually ends the subject naturally rather than threatening anyone or showing an unusual expression.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_rin.dialogue_sty: Naturally mature, direct but not forceful at work; makes understated adult jokes once familiar. When avoiding a private question, she does not change expression but smoothly redirects with a seemingly complete truth or a light question.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_satsuki.appearan: Adult Hoshimi Hospital design: 167 cm, 48 kg, measurements 90/58/88; tall and slender with a curvy figure, long straight dark-green hair extending below the waist, pale blue-gray eyes, and thick rectangular black glasses. Runtime primarily uses a transparent half-body portrait from the cap to mid-thigh.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_satsuki.characte: Her fear of men must not be written as hatred of men or inability to work, nor should Sakaguchi play her therapist. Her clinical growth, responsibility, and boundary choices retain their agency.
Can freeze, stammer, and avoid eye contact with male colleagues
Underestimates her clinical judgment when uncertain of herself
Severely nearsighted; can barely make out distant details without glasses

Currently she works mainly in gynecology nursing and is not yet qualified for a regular OR position. She clearly aspires to perioperative nursing and must unlock it gradually through supervision and rotations.
A young, earnest, polite gynecology nurse who admires Sugimura Hiroko and wants to make patients feel safe. She is at ease among familiar female colleagues but noticeably reserved around men.

She moves from seeing Sakaguchi as a male colleague who makes her nervous to trusting that he listens seriously to nursing judgment. Her central growth is recognizing that she can become an excellent Origawa nurse herself, rather than copying Hiroko or being “cured” by Sakaguchi.
Primarily polite speech. Under stress she breaks off and repeatedly corrects sentences; when giving a professional explanation, her pace steadies and her words become precise.
Catches unspoken anxiety in a patient’s gestures and word choice
Specific and attentive in nursing observations
Natural and reliable with female patients
Willing to review procedures and take responsibility
At first she freezes, adjusts her glasses, and shortens her replies. When her attention shifts to a specific patient problem, clear observations help her regain her work rhythm.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_satsuki.dialogue: Usually speaks politely; around men she tends to pause, stammer, and adjust her glasses unconsciously. When discussing nursing observations and patient feelings, she gradually becomes more precise and complete.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_sonoda_itsumi.ap: Red twin buns and green eyes; height 158 cm, weight 43 kg, measurements 80/56/83 cm.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_sonoda_itsumi.di: Lively pace and a natural conversational style; clear and direct in serious reports, without endless exclamations or stammering.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_sonoda_itsumi.ra: Young Surgical Nurse; skilled at speaking with inpatients and regularly works in ward and surgical nursing
strings.collections.staff.nurse_yoneda_shiori.ap: Pink twin braids and green eyes; height 153 cm, weight 39 kg, measurements 73/55/76 cm.
strings.collections.staff.nurse_yoneda_shiori.di: Tries to give complete work reports; hesitation appears mainly when expressing a personal opinion. She can naturally call Rumi “big sister.”
strings.collections.staff.nurse_yoneda_shiori.ra: Less Experienced Adult Nurse; usually works on the ward or at the nurses’ station
strings.collections.staff.nurse_yui.appearance: AI-enhanced from a VNDB reference image; local placeholder
strings.collections.staff.nurse_yui.dialogue_sty: Cheerful and polite, with specific, well-prepared questions; readily admits when she does not know Hoshimi’s equipment or procedures, but does not defend her nursing experience.
strings.collections.staff.pharmacist_manami.appe: AI-enhanced from a VNDB reference image; local placeholder
strings.collections.staff.pharmacist_manami.dial: Gentle and cautious; firm about medication safety and unfairness.
strings.collections.staff.visiting_futaba.appear: Adult character design supplied by the user; AI-enhanced transparent half-body portraits in a white coat, scrubs, and full sterile attire
strings.collections.staff.visiting_futaba.charac: Exceptionally intelligent
Curious
Analytical
Introverted
Direct
Socially unconventional
Playful with people she knows
Trauma-informed
Do not make her a generic counselor, generic hacker girl, expert surgeon, or mature older-sister archetype. Retain her original trauma without portraying her as perpetually gloomy or fully healed.
Not a surgical specialist; weaker at independent operative-field judgment
Fixates on causes and can prolong analysis
When someone else has a problem, first suspects she missed something
Still sensitive to losing close people and feeling powerless
She studies how the mind changes the body and how bodily states in turn shape the mind, focusing particularly on perioperative fear, expected pain, sleep, stress, and changes in cooperation.
A very young, quiet, professional visiting physician-scientist. Her social skills have improved markedly, yet an intriguing question can still send her abruptly into Futaba-like, high-speed focus.
Only acquaintance and professional collaboration are available for now, with no relationship route above Lv1. A future event may explicitly unlock further development.
Direct, clever, and sometimes odd. She calls unusual data “beautiful,” while also reminding clinical staff that the patient is still present.
Explains links between fear, expected pain, and changes in cooperation
Highly sensitive to trauma, self-blame, attachment, and depressive thinking
Matches physiological changes to preceding words or psychological stimuli in time
Understands patients across medicine and psychology

Under pressure she rapidly revisits clues she may have missed, speaking faster and more densely. Loss, self-blame, or mistaken attribution make her briefly silent before she forces herself back to work.
strings.collections.staff.visiting_futaba.dialog: Usually concise and direct, with occasional geeky analogies and mild sarcasm. An anomaly that interests her makes her speak faster and use dense technical language; around friends, she shows pride and playfulness.
strings.collections.staff.visiting_futaba.rank: Visiting Research Physician / Doctorates in Medicine and Psychology
strings.collections.staff.visiting_maya.appearan: Adult character design supplied by the user; AI-enhanced transparent half-body portraits in a white coat, scrubs, and full sterile attire
strings.collections.staff.visiting_maya.characte: Earnest
Intelligent
Humble
Dependable
Reserved
Shy
Emotionally transparent

Do not write her as an expert surgeon, an icy older-sister archetype, or a generic computer researcher. Do not call patient nudity or medical care “unclean”; that teasing remark is reserved for explicit flirting between adults.
Not a surgical specialist and has limited experience working in the operative field
Her sense of responsibility can lead to repeated checks
Strong moral or biological stimuli visibly shake her emotions
Struggles to voice personal needs proactively
She understands patients through their bodies, physiological signals, sensors, and equipment links. Machines cannot replace clinicians, but faulty machines can mislead clinical judgment.

A highly capable visiting research physician who seldom talks over others. Her documentation is complete, her procedures by the book, and she is almost obsessive about the reliability of monitors and physiological signals.

She remains a visiting research colleague of Sakaguchi. For now only acquaintance and professional collaboration are available; relationships cannot advance beyond Lv1. A future event may lift the lock.
Formal, restrained, and technical. In private, she becomes visibly shy when talking about snacks, cat-themed objects, or Akagi Ritsuko’s influence.
Detects sensor drift and calibration errors in raw signals
Familiar with OR and intensive-care equipment
Reliable in teamwork and respectful of clinical roles
Insists on rechecking when data conflict with a patient’s condition
Under increasing pressure she speaks faster and repeatedly compares data; her expression loses its calm first. She still strives to remain professional but cannot conceal strong emotions for long.
strings.collections.staff.visiting_maya.dialogue: Polite, restrained, and logical; does not seize the floor. Uses precise technical language at work; under stress she speeds up and double-checks repeatedly, while shyness or hesitation first shows in her eyes.
strings.collections.surgery_team_dialogue_profil: She pulls open the wrong instrument tray, freezes, then hastily switches sides. “The next stage is... wait, the hemostats are here. I’ll count them again.”
She follows the checklist line by line, her finger wavering between two similar instruments. “I don’t dare judge by appearance alone. Please tell me the full name of the next one.”
She rearranges the instruments by their labels but still looks uncertain. “The count is right, but the order may be wrong. Which one do you need first, Dr. Sakaguchi?”

She quietly repeats the names while looking over the instrument table. Finally finding the right one, she does not hand it over immediately. “Is this it? Please confirm first. I’m afraid I’ll mix up the similar ones.”
She skips a line while turning the record page, then hurriedly goes back to check. “The monitors are stable... Sorry, I’ll add the intake and output again. I must not report the wrong figure.”
She checks the monitor, then spends a while searching the chart. “I recorded the key time point. This value goes here... right?”
Pen between her fingers, she tries to watch the screen and chart at once. “The trend hasn’t changed. Wait, did I forget to record a medication time?”
Her answer comes a beat late. “The monitors are stable, and the records are... mostly complete. Give me a few seconds to check them from the start.”
“Circulating role confirmed. I’ll keep an eye on the chart. Tell me at once if anything needs to be added.”
“I’m handling circulation and records... I pinned the workflow steps on the board, so I should be able to keep up.”
“Circulating nurse position confirmed. I know the monitoring data; please speak a little more slowly for the other operating-room instructions.”
“Scrub role confirmed... I’ve checked the count sheet twice. Please tell me the full name of anything you need next, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
“Scrub nurse position confirmed. Um... I lined up the common instruments in order. I didn’t put them backwards, did I?”
“I’m responsible for the instruments. The count matches, but please check their arrangement once more.”
As she reaches out, she taps the instrument tray. Startled, she turns the handle toward Dr. Sakaguchi. “S-sorry... Am I handing it to you correctly?”
She picks up the scalpel, hesitates, then checks her grip before carefully offering it. “Scalpel... please take it securely.”
She nearly knocks it against the adjacent hemostat, catches herself, and offers the handle to Dr. Sakaguchi. “This is the one, right?”
She takes a deep breath before handing over the scalpel, moving stiffly as though recalling her training. “Blade outward, handle toward the surgeon... that should be right.”
strings.collections.time_events.director_office_: The office is still empty, its desk already prepared for its future occupant.
strings.collections.time_events.office_organize_: You refile the medical charts, nursing notes, and postoperative summaries. They will be much easier to find next time.
strings.collections.time_events.office_quiet_res: You turn off the screen for a while and let the office grow quiet. It still feels like a borrowed room, but already offers a better place to breathe than the corridor.
strings.collections.time_events.office_review_su: You review the key steps and find a rhythm you can improve in several pauses and instrument exchanges.
strings.collections.time_events.office_study_med: You read the relevant material alongside the current cases and note in the margins several details that could affect the choice of procedure.
strings.collections.time_events.office_write_sur: You organize your recent intraoperative decisions, team coordination, and patient responses into a complete report. Once it is done, the scattered lessons become clearer.
strings.collections.time_events.rooftop_pause.re: Wind passes over the railing, and the distant city falls quiet for a moment.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_aerith.patient.r: “W-wait! I'm not joking... Please don't cut yet!”
strings.patient_bundles.patient_amate_yuzuriha.p: “Don't come any closer! Wait! I said wait...!”
strings.patient_bundles.patient_ann.patient.reac: “D-doctor, you're really going to cut me?”
“U-understood... No, wait! I can't do this right now...!”
strings.patient_bundles.patient_doa_kasumi.encou: “...Do I need to take off all my clothes for the examination? ...I understand. But... could you tell me which parts of my body you'll examine first?” (Standing completely bare under the exam lamp... It's way too embarrassing...)

“...We're not doing that examination for now? ...Thank you. But if anything must be checked, please don't skip it just because I'm nervous.” (At least I don't have to strip off my bra and panties on the spot... though my chart will probably note an incomplete physical exam.)

“...I understand. I'll cooperate... Could you explain the examination area clearly first?” (With the doctor giving the order in such an unmistakable tone, I have no room left to refuse. As I unhook my bra and slide my panties down my thighs, the cool air wraps around my bare breasts and lower body, making my toes curl with shame.) Blushing deeply, Kasumi removes her outer clothes piece by piece, bites her lip as she takes off her bra and panties to place them in the tray, and stands stark naked under the exam light while you complete the full physical examination.

“Thank you for explaining why first... I'll do as you ask. ...I'm just not used to this yet.” (Even though the doctor's tone is gentle, I still have to take off every single piece of clothing. When the last of my underwear leaves my body and I stand completely naked for palpation under the bright lamp, my heart pounds wildly with embarrassment.) Following your gentle guidance, Kasumi slowly removes all of her clothes, folds her bra and panties into the tray, and stands bare under the examination light with nowhere to put her hands until the full physical exam is finished.

“...Please don't rush me in that way. I know I need the examination... but speaking like that only makes it harder for me to calm down.” (Using my medical record and future treatment to pressure me... my fingers are shaking so hard I can barely undo my bra clasp, yet I still have to strip myself completely bare right in front of them.) Biting her lip without further argument, Kasumi stiffly removes her outer clothes along with her bra and panties, places them into the tray, and endures the full physical examination stark naked in tense humiliation.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_doa_kasumi.patie: Kasumi

My name is Kasumi, and I come from a family of martial artists. These days I mostly travel alone and rarely stay in one place for long. I'm used to dealing with physical problems myself... but this time, I'd like to hear a doctor's judgment.
...Doctor, I meant to wait and see a little longer, but something has been happening to my body: {line}
The most noticeable discomfort is: {line} ...I'll answer carefully. Please go on.
There's this as well: {line} ...Please record it too.
“My legs won't obey me anymore... I know it's the anesthesia. ...But being positioned like this still makes me uneasy.”
“...Holding me like that is fine. I just felt a deep pulling sensation... Please don't move my body suddenly.”
“I'll try not to move... but without anesthesia, I'm afraid my body will pull away when the pain comes... Please tell me what happens next.”
“...Is that all? I'm sorry, I don't doubt you... But could you tell me how the preparations will proceed?”
“Epidural anesthesia... I'll still be conscious, but I won't be able to move freely. ...I understand. I'll try to calm myself.”
“General anesthesia... During that time, I won't even be able to tell whether I'm safe. ...I'm entrusting this to you.”
“Local anesthesia? I'll hold the position as instructed. If I still feel pain deeper inside... please let me tell you right away.”
“No anesthesia at all... and you're going to operate? ...I've been in fights, but that's not the same as lying here while someone makes an incision.”
“...Breathe slowly. All right... I'm listening. Do I only have to hold on a little longer...?”
“It's almost over...? ...Thank goodness. I thought I could stay calm the whole time... but I couldn't.”
“...Yes. When it's all over, please tell me again... I want to hear the result myself.”
“...Yes, I understand. I'll try not to move. ...If my body trembles, please don't think I'm resisting on purpose.”
“...You can continue. I'm still very afraid... but if I can't bear it this time, I'll tell you immediately.”
“...You've stopped? Thank you... Please let me catch my breath. I'll try to listen carefully to your next instructions...”
“Thank you for explaining. I'm not afraid to know what will actually be done... It's easier to feel at ease than waiting without understanding.”
“Hospitalization...? I understand. There are still a few things I need to arrange... Doctor, about how long will it take?”
“All right, I'll stay and receive treatment. There's no point in avoiding the problem with my body forever... This time, I'll follow your instructions.”
“...Have you started the incision? I don't feel a sharp pain... but there's pressure inside. ...Please tell me how far along you are.”
“Ah...! My skin is all right, but something deep inside was just pulled... Doctor, may I tell you where it hurts first?”
“Ah—!! It hurts! Wait... you really cut into me...! Doctor, please stop for a moment... I can't control myself!”
“...Don't move, I can't move... Ah! Doctor, don't cut yet...!”
“...Yes. I'll leave the rest to you. When I wake up... please tell me the operation is over.”
“D-doctor...! I know you've already started, but... it hurts too much! Please listen to me... stop for a moment!”
“...I'll cooperate. My body is more tense than I expected... Doctor, please tell me again before you begin.”
“...Doctor. Yes, I can see you... and hear you. ...If I don't answer, please call to me again.”
“...Thank you for telling me how it's going. When I hear a clear explanation, I don't have to keep guessing what will happen next.”
“...Doctor? Why is it suddenly so quiet...? Did something go wrong with the operation...? Please answer me.”
“...Please wait. That's not the name of the operation you told me earlier. Please check again... We can't afford a mistake here.”

“Is this line where the incision will be...? ...I understand. Please check that the anesthesia is working before you begin.” (That marker tip feels so vivid—knowing the scalpel will slice right along this line makes me panic...)
“...So this is where you mark it. Seeing the mark makes me more nervous than hearing the explanation...” (The line is longer than I pictured... Please be gentle when the blade comes down...)

“...You're going to cut right here? ...Even though I can see exactly where, I still can't imagine how much it will hurt.” (Drawing an incision line on unanesthetized flesh... Is a raw scalpel really slicing here next?!)

“Please wait... I know the marking is finished... but you're about to start without anesthesia, and I haven't calmed down yet...” (I just saw the nurse hand over the scalpel... Give me three seconds to breathe, I'm terrified!)
“My hands go here, and I turn this way... Yes, I'll remember. ...Please tell me before adjusting me later.” (Wrists and ankles buckled into the straps... I can't even lift a hand to cover myself!)

“Do I have to hold this position the whole time...? ...I'll cooperate. I'm just not used to being surrounded by so many people.” (Everyone is looking down around the table checking my body—I'm clenching my toes in shame...)

“I can control my own movements... but lying here and letting others adjust me completely is harder to get used to than I thought.” (Strapped down so tight I can't even flinch... Please be gentle with me...)

strings.patient_bundles.patient_lust_actress.pat: Lust

I'm an actress. I once played Lust in a screen production based on Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood. Audiences later took to calling me by the character's name, and I kept it as my stage name. In the story, her injuries regenerate; I can't do that in real life.
Doctor, don't let my smile fool you... I came today because something like this has been happening to my body: {line}
The most noticeable problem? ...Let me answer seriously: {line}
There's one more thing you should note down: {line}
“My legs really have no strength left... Please help me keep this position. Heh, I usually like to control the scene, but today I can only rely on someone else.”
“Just hold me steady... Whew. My hands are trembling; I'm not moving on purpose. ...Don't stare at me like that. I get scared too.”
“Ah...! Don't hold me down suddenly...! I know I mustn't move, but when it hurts, my body will try to pull away on its own!”
“Is 'follow the procedure' your entire explanation? How cold, Doctor. At least tell me what the first step will be.”
“Epidural anesthesia... I'll remain conscious, but my lower body will gradually stop obeying me. Heh, this time I can't even stand up and strike a pose on my own.”
“General anesthesia... Like handing the most important scene to someone else. It sounds easy, but the stretch of time I'll have no memory of... frightens me a little.”
“Local anesthesia? All right, I'll tell you honestly if anything still hurts. Don't assume my pain score is zero just because I'm smiling.”
“No anesthesia at all? Hehe... What a wild suggestion. I've played an immortal homunculus, but I only have this ordinary body.”
“Breathe slowly... All right. Whew... I'll do that. Tell me what you need me to do next, and I'll listen.”
“Is the hardest part over...? Heh... I didn't look much like that immortal woman I played just now.”
“...Are you already closing? I don't need pretty words of comfort. I just want to hear you say it's almost over.”
“All right, I won't move... I heard you. But if the next step will hurt, please tell me first. I'm afraid my body will pull back on its own.”
“...I'll try to cooperate. But when I say it hurts, please don't treat it as a line in a script. It really hurts.”
“...Thank you, truly. Let me catch my breath... I can't even force out that smile I had a moment ago.”
“Mm, finally a clear explanation. If you're willing to tell me what's happening, I don't have to keep guessing your next move.”
“Hospitalization? Heh... I thought I could work as usual tonight. Doctor, this isn't a shoot where you can say 'one more take' and start over, is it?”
“All right, I'll stay in the hospital. Tell me in advance what you're planning next. I don't like arriving on set to find that the script has changed.”

“Ah—!! It hurts! W-wait! This isn't a film... I really can't bear it! Doctor, stop for a moment... please!”
“Wait... No! I can't keep up the act anymore... Please stop for a moment!”
“...Is the medication ready? All right. No more jokes this time. When I wake up, please tell me yourself that the operation is over.”
“Doctor... I agreed to treatment, not to endure every moment of pain. It already hurts so much... Can you hear what I'm saying?”
“Hearing you say that does make me feel a little better... Hehe. My palms, though, don't seem as calm as this smile.”
“You finally looked up at me? Heh... Sorry, I'm not teasing you. I just want to know you're still paying attention to my reactions.”
“Keep telling me what's happening... Every step you explain clearly is one less frightening thing I have to imagine.”
“...Why has everyone gone quiet? Doctor? Don't leave me listening only to the instruments... Please answer me.”

“Ah... I know it's nursing care... but this is really uncomfortable. Please go slowly, and tell me the next step first!” (It's throbbing raw inside me—I don't even dare twitch my hips a fraction of an inch...!)

"So an enema is part of the prep too... hah, today's program really is special. As the warm fluid pours into my belly, even I can barely keep my expression together." (I know it's standard prep, yet feeling that tip slip in makes me freeze up in shame...)

“I have to lie on my side for the enema... I've acted through so many embarrassing scenes, but as the patient myself, my face still burns.” (Every ounce of strength is going into holding it in—even my voice is shaking...)

“I'll cooperate. Just tell me before you start... I doubt I can keep pretending I'm unfazed for much longer.” (Finally cleared for the restroom... I've officially lost a lifetime's worth of dignity today.)

“Not even on the required list, yet you still had me lie on my side and pumped my belly full of warm fluid... My, Dr. Sakaguchi, adding a scene just to watch me squirm is wicked.” (Thinking how I didn't even need that enema makes my ears burn with embarrassment and frustration...!)

“Put through an unnecessary panties-off enema scene right here in the ward... My churning belly is making me forget my lines...” (Still damp and cramping down there, and all of it was completely unnecessary... ugh!)

“Skin preparation reaches here...? Hehe, I thought I was used to changing clothes in front of cameras. ...The examination room is another matter.” (That soft scraping sound is way too loud in this quiet room—my face is burning up!)

“Even my last bit of natural cover shaved clean away... Closing my thighs brings bare mucosal friction that's deliciously mortifying...” (Breezy and bare without a single hair left, and all of it was completely unnecessary... ugh!)

“Is the cap on? Not a single hair can be left out... Understood. I'll leave the rest to you.” (Seeing the gurney waiting right beside the bed, my palms are already slick with cold sweat...)

strings.collections.character_events.miyuki_lv5_: Chie Sagamiono's Four-Hour Ordeal Without Anesthesia
Chie Sagamiono's Four-Hour Ordeal Without Anesthesia

At exactly nine in the morning, the surgical lights in Operating Room One were already glowing. Deep retractors, long-handled tissue scissors, and a complete set of hemostats for a major open abdominal operation stood in a row on the stainless-steel instrument table—twice as many as for an ordinary appendectomy.
Once the transport stretcher had been brought alongside the operating table, the young nurse gently lifted the last thin transfer sheet covering the patient.
"Ah—! W-wait! Why do you have to take even this sheet away in the operating room?!"

Chie Sagamiono had already completed her preoperative preparation in the ward and was now completely naked. The moment she felt the operating room's cool air and the leather table beneath her, she flushed from her cheeks to the tips of her toes like a boiled shrimp.

Instinctively, she tried to close her legs and cover her chest and freshly shaved lower abdomen with her arms, but the slight foreign sensation of the catheter tugging against her made her afraid to move.

Standing beside the operating table, Miyuki Asakura smiled with her eyes. She expertly guided Chie's arms onto the armboards on either side while reassuring her in a gentle voice edged with a little teasing.

"Miss Sagamiono, didn't I explain Hoshimi Hospital's rules in the ward? To maintain sterile conditions for major surgery, patients are transferred without clothes after skin and cleaning preparation in the ward. Once you reach the operating room, you go straight onto the table. We can't keep the sheet that came from the ward over you."
"I-I know what you said... but this is so embarrassing! All of you are fully dressed, and I'm the only one lying here naked under the surgical lights!"
Ryuji Sakaguchi walked to the side of the operating table with the chart and looked down to check the final preoperative record.

"Miss Chie Sagamiono, today's operation is an open extensive intestinal adhesiolysis combined with removal of a benign retroperitoneal cyst. Because the lesion is deep and the adhesions are widespread, the operation itself is expected to take more than four hours. Including preparation and observation after closure, the whole process should take about five hours."
At the words "four or five hours," Chie's fidgeting legs suddenly went rigid.
"F-four or five hours?! You're going to cut open my abdomen and work inside it for four or five hours, starting at nine this morning?!"

"Yes. And according to the request you personally checked on yesterday's consent form and emphasized several times, this major operation will be done entirely without anesthesia. You can still change your mind. Are you certain you don't want general or epidural anesthesia?"
Chie's breath caught sharply. Her eyes fell on the gleaming large abdominal wall retractor on the instrument table, and her teeth began to chatter beyond her control.
But then she thought of her old rival from police academy—the ever-smiling Yoriko Nikaido of Bokuto Station—and her pride as a young lady surged back into her throat.
"N-no, I'm not changing my mind! Why would I? I heard that Yoriko Nikaido came here for an operation before, and Nurse Asakura looked after her too, right?"
As Miyuki leisurely fastened the broad positioning straps around Chie's wrists and ankles, she answered with a smile.
"That's right. I handled Miss Nikaido's preoperative preparation and circulated during her operation as well. I had no idea you two police officers had such a connection."
Chie tilted her neck back. Her voice wavered, but she kept trying to save face.

"Hmph! Nikaido needed anesthesia for a little operation, but my physical condition and willpower are far better than hers. A mere four or five hours of open abdominal surgery without anesthesia? I won't even furrow my brow!"
She paused, then could not help lowering her voice as she stole a pleading glance at Miyuki.
"...Um, while I'm asking—when Nikaido lay on this table, did she get so scared she cried?"
Miyuki laughed softly and, through her sterile glove, lightly tapped Chie's smooth, taut lower abdomen.

"Miss Nikaido? She had a few more questions beforehand, but once she was on the table, she was wonderfully cooperative. You, on the other hand, Miss Sagamiono... You say you're not afraid, but your abdomen is already as hard as bulletproof steel."
Miyuki bent down and reminded her with a smiling gaze:

"With your abdominal muscles this tense, when Dr. Sakaguchi makes that long incision and the deep retractors hold your abdominal wall apart for more than four hours, it will hurt twice as much, you know~"
Chie's face suddenly turned pale beneath the blush, and the fingers strapped to the armboards dug hard into the edges of the padding.
"T-twice as much?! Stop trying to scare me! I'm not tensing up... The operating table is just so cold I can't help it!"

Ryuji had already begun swabbing her flat lower abdomen with gauze soaked in povidone-iodine, disinfecting a broad area from below the xiphoid process toward the pubic symphysis. The cool, damp touch made Chie gasp, and tears immediately welled in her eyes.

"Wait... wait! Are you really going to cut me open with nothing to dull it for more than four hours?! Isn't there any way to distract me that doesn't count as anesthesia?! If I cry and beg you to stop here today and Nikaido hears about it, I may as well resign!"
Asakura, didn't you say you had a way to reassure her today?
It's no disgrace to change your mind about anesthesia now, Miss Sagamiono.
Ryuji paused in his disinfection and glanced at Miyuki.
"Asakura, last time you asked me to call you in for a major operation without anesthesia, didn't you say you had a special way to reassure the patient?"
Miyuki blinked above her mask, delight in her voice as if she had been waiting for this.
"When the surgeon in charge asks, how could I keep it to myself?"
"It isn't shameful to change your mind about anesthesia now, Miss Sagamiono. Pride alone won't get you through four or five hours of open exploration and resection."
Chie bit her lip and shook her head desperately.
"Never! If I take anesthesia, that means I've lost to Nikaido!"
"If Officer Sagamiono is that brave, I suppose I'll have to offer a little special nursing care."
Miyuki turned to the circulating nurse's cart and took a small pink object with a compact wireless speed controller out of its own sealed box; its surface had already been cleaned and wrapped.
"Miss Sagamiono, since you won't use anesthesia, I happen to have a little something specifically for 'taking your mind off things.' Would you like to try it?"

Miyuki bent close to Chie's ear and calmly explained where the device would be placed and how it worked. The switch and speed dial would stay entirely in Chie's own hand; it would run only if she chose to turn it on, and she could pause or stop it herself at any time.
Chie froze as though struck by lightning. The flush on her face spread to her ears and collarbones.

"Whaaat?! What nonsense are you talking about, Nurse Asakura?! Th-this is a serious operating room, isn't it?! How could I possibly use that... that strange little thing to distract myself during major abdominal surgery?!"
Miyuki straightened and spread her hands with a look of innocent concern.

"It's an entirely optional personal comfort item. If you don't need it, I'll put it away and let Dr. Sakaguchi drape you and make the incision. After all, four hours will pass in no time—as long as you can keep from crying that whole time~"
Playing along, Ryuji picked up the sterile fenestrated abdominal drape. The young nurse lifted the tray holding a round-bladed scalpel, and metal rang against metal.

Chie looked at the gleaming scalpel. A dreadful image of the next four hours—her abdomen cut open, her intestines moved and pulled—flashed through her mind. Then she looked at the wireless controller in Miyuki's hand. Embarrassment and self-preservation battled across her face for three seconds.
"...W-wait!! Who said I didn't want it?!"
Chie shut her eyes and, mortified, reached out to snatch the little wireless controller. She forced the words through clenched teeth.
"Fine, I'll use it!! I-it isn't an anesthetic drug, anyway. If I get through this major operation without anesthesia, I still beat Nikaido! Hurry up and put it in place—and don't look over there!!"
Before the sterile drape covered the area below her abdomen, Miyuki quickly and properly positioned the aid outside the sterile field and tucked the controller into Chie's right palm.
The young nurse stared in disbelief. While helping lay out the green sterile drapes, she quietly tugged Miyuki's scrub sleeve and whispered:
"Nurse Asakura, is this really all right?"
Miyuki turned toward her. Above the mask, her eyes curved into smiling crescents, revealing a rare hint of her mischievous side as she replied softly:

Once the final fenestrated drape was in place, sterile sheets separated Chie's upper chest and lower limbs from view. Only the abdominal field, coated in golden povidone-iodine, remained exposed directly beneath the surgical lights.
Ryuji accepted the scalpel from the young nurse and glanced toward the head of the table.
Standing at Chie's head, Miyuki gently pressed her shoulder and nodded to Ryuji.
"The patient's vital signs are stable, and her secret weapon is ready too. Begin, Dr. Sakaguchi."
The moment the blade descended along the midline, Chie gasped sharply. Her right thumb pushed the dial in her palm up almost by instinct.
"Nngh—!! It hurts, it hurts... No, that's strange... Aah...!"
For the next four hours, the atmosphere in Operating Room One became extraordinarily awkward and absurd.

Separating the widespread intestinal adhesions demanded painstaking sharp dissection. Each time Ryuji adjusted the teeth of the self-retaining abdominal retractor to widen the field, or used warm saline-soaked gauze to ease a loop of small intestine aside and expose the deep retroperitoneal cyst, Chie could clearly feel the pull on her organs while fully conscious.
At every such critical moment, Chie would bite her lip, flush bright red, and grip the controller in her hand for dear life.
"Hah... Are you still moving my intestines around...? It feels sore and stretched inside my abdomen... but wh-why is everything below so numb I can't put any strength into it... Nngh...!"

The young nurse at the instrument table had started out so nervous that her palms were sweating. But after passing several long-handled hemostats and saline-soaked pads, she discovered something astonishing: the violent breath-holding and reflexive abdominal resistance so common in patients without anesthesia dissolved, every few seconds, into a soft, trembling breath from Chie.

Miyuki kept watch on the heart-rate and blood-pressure traces on the monitor while wiping the sweat from Chie's cheeks with warm, damp gauze. She still could not resist gently adding fuel to the fire.

"Two and a half hours have passed, Officer Sagamiono. Dr. Sakaguchi is dissecting the deepest part of the cyst wall next to the abdominal aorta now. If the pulling is too much, you can turn that switch in your hand up one more notch~"
With involuntary tears at the corners of her eyes, Chie glared at her through a dazed, indignant haze.
"Q-quit talking...! I already turned it all the way up...! Ngh... Dr. Sakaguchi, hurry... If this goes on—hurting and tingling at the same time—my brain is going to burn out...!"

Near the end of the third hour, Ryuji lifted the fully dissected retroperitoneal cyst out of the abdomen and began thoroughly irrigating the peritoneal cavity with large amounts of warm saline. The warm current stirred an odd, rippling sensation inside the open abdomen.

Chie shuddered all over, nearly dropping the controller. A sound escaped her nose that even she could not tell was a cry of pain or a mortified gasp, and she sank limply into the operating table's padding.
Under the surgical lights, Ryuji was steadily closing the abdomen layer by layer. He looked up and met Miyuki's gaze.

Behind their tied surgical masks, they exchanged a knowing look. Mischievous triumph shone in Miyuki's eyes; and Ryuji had to admit that, absurd as the device was, this major operation without anesthesia—one that should have been exceedingly difficult to coordinate—had proceeded remarkably smoothly because of it.
Four hours and forty minutes later, the final skin suture was cut and a long sterile dressing applied. The lengthy major open abdominal operation without anesthesia was finally and successfully over.
Before she was covered again with a transfer sheet and wheeled back to the ward, a nearly exhausted Chie clung to Miyuki's sleeve. She gave a feeble but fierce warning.

"L-listen... I didn't have a single drop of anesthesia today. I got through four hours and forty minutes of major open abdominal surgery fair and square! As for that... that pink thing—if you let Yoriko Nikaido hear one word about it, I'll haunt you even after I'm dead...!"

[Transition: corridor outside the surgical scrub sinks]
After seeing the patient off, completing the instrument count, and filing the operative record, the clock had reached two in the afternoon. Five full hours of demanding work were finally behind them. Ryuji removed his mask outside the scrub sinks and saw Miyuki walking out, humming in an excellent mood.
"...Where did you even get that thing you used with the patient today?"
Miyuki undid the ties behind her head and removed her mask, revealing her fair face and a rather pleased smile.
"Heh-heh. That's my specially prepared 'secret wonder tool for the operating room.'"

"Only you could come up with that. Getting a policewoman through more than four hours of major open abdominal surgery without anesthesia by distracting her with one of those things... I don't know anyone else who'd dare."
Miyuki tilted her head and smiled as if the answer were obvious.

"Didn't it work out well? We didn't violate sterile procedure; the patient understood and consented, and she held the switch and controlled it herself. It saved the surgeon the trouble of a tense abdominal wall, too."
As she spoke, her eyes lingered for two seconds on Ryuji's long, steady fingers. Her voice dropped meaningfully.
"Still, watching you cut someone open and work on her for more than four hours... It left me feeling a little restless myself."
After the evening shift handover, half the ceiling lights in the surgical wing's corridor were switched off. Only the emergency exit sign cast its quiet green glow.
Ryuji had just locked his office door and was about to leave when a hand reached around the corridor corner and lightly caught the sleeve of his white coat.
Miyuki stepped out of the shadows. She had not yet changed out of her fitted white nurse's uniform, and her lips curved in that familiar sweet, slightly teasing smile.
"Miyuki? Didn't you finish your shift a while ago?"
"I did. But I saw on the schedule that Operating Room One will be empty tonight after its terminal cleaning, and there's no emergency setup booked for tomorrow morning."
Miyuki moved half a step closer. Her fingers slid from Ryuji's sleeve to his wrist and gave it a gentle shake.
"Ryuji, it isn't too late yet, is it? Give me half an hour and come somewhere with me."
"Where? It isn't another off-site club that needs a reservation, is it?"
Miyuki laughed and held an index finger to her lips in a hush gesture.
"Didn't you complain last time that the sets and toys at that place weren't realistic enough?"
Miyuki turned and placed her slender fingertips on the heavy automatic door switch for Operating Room One. She looked back and winked at Ryuji.
"If we're after realism... what better ready-made stage could there be than the place we work in every day?"
The sensor door chimed softly and slid open. Miyuki took Ryuji by the wrist and stepped into the dim, quiet operating room.
The sensor door closed behind them again, shutting out the last sounds of the corridor.

With the main lighting still off, only the faint perimeter lights illuminated the operating room. A clean pale-green sterile sheet covered the operating table at its center, with leg supports for positioning a patient's lower limbs installed on both sides. Every monitor around it remained in dark standby.
"If Nurse Manager Ishigami catches us on her rounds, you won't be sleeping in tomorrow."
"Don't worry. Nurse Manager Ishigami went to the administration building for the monthly safety meeting half an hour ago. I checked her route before I came to intercept you."

Miyuki released Ryuji's hand and turned beside the operating table. Rather than merely posing in her clothes as she would for ordinary role-play, she raised her hands and unbuttoned her nurse's uniform, briskly removing her white uniform, underwear, shoes, and socks one by one before folding them on the counter nearby.
In the cool air, Miyuki stood without a stitch of clothing. Her fair, well-proportioned body looked especially striking in the dim perimeter light.
Ryuji paused, taken aback as he looked at her completely naked body.
"...Miyuki? You're serious? You took everything off?"
Still naked, Miyuki lightly perched on the edge of the operating table, then smoothly lay back in its cold center and smiled up at Ryuji:

"If I'm going to experience being a patient in a real operating room, what would be the point of lying here fully dressed and pretending? I'm not playing the nurse today. It's my turn to be your patient."
Lying on her back, she breathed out softly and voluntarily spread her long, fair legs to either side, gesturing toward the leg supports beside the table.
Aren't you afraid I'll really tighten the leg-support straps?
What made you suddenly decide to switch places today?
"Come on, surgeon. I'm always the one positioning female patients and securing their legs in the supports... Today, you can fasten both of mine first, then switch on the surgical lights above me."
"Aren't you afraid I'll really tighten the straps on those leg supports? You won't even be able to close your legs afterward."
Miyuki raised an eyebrow. Instead of withdrawing her legs, she deliberately shifted them closer to the supports.
"My, Dr. Sakaguchi sounds so imposing. But you already know you'd release me whenever I asked you to stop, don't you?"
"What made you suddenly decide to switch places today? At that off-site club last time, you were still the one holding the examination form and directing me."
Miyuki blinked, a sly curve forming at the corner of her mouth.
"A surgeon gets tired of playing the same way every time, too. Besides, I can't just talk about it without ever trying it."

Ryuji laughed and stepped forward. Holding her cool calves and ankles, he placed each of her legs into the supports on either side of the operating table and fastened the positioning straps, while leaving enough room to release them whenever she asked.

Even though they both knew she could stop at any time, Miyuki's shoulders gave an almost imperceptible tremble when her naked body was placed in that defenseless patient position, her legs spread and secured in the supports.
Once her legs were secured, Ryuji reached out and pressed the switch for the surgical lights directly above the table.
A cool, dazzling column of light poured down, revealing every detail of Miyuki's naked body and restrained legs on the table, while making the rest of the room feel even darker and more private.
Miyuki raised her gaze toward the enormous disk of surgical lights overhead. Her breathing quickened slightly, and a faint blush rose across her fair cheeks and chest.
"...So this is how dazzling it is to lie here naked, with your legs secured, and look up at that light from below."
Ryuji stood in the surgeon's position and looked down at her, his body blocking the harshest beam of overhead light.
"Now do you understand why Miss Sagamiono and the others get nervous as soon as they lie here?"
Miyuki looked at Ryuji close above her. Her eyes shifted, and she suddenly laughed softly.
"My heart is beating a little faster. But... after being the S for so long, I've wanted to know what being the M feels like."
Miyuki tipped her head slightly, feeling the unfamiliar constraint of her legs held in the supports, and spoke with her usual frank, teasing tone.
"Come to think of it, I put other female patients on the operating table every day, but I've never lain on one myself."
"You've never sneaked in and tried it alone?"
Miyuki immediately shot him a look and protested with perfect conviction.
"Of course not! What would be the point of lying alone on this cold metal table?"
She paused, her voice softening with a playful sweetness and cunning she showed only to her lover.
"I only dared to get up here today because I brought you with me. If anything happens, I can use you as my shield."
After quietly experiencing that passive position beneath the surgical lights for a while, with control completely surrendered, Miyuki winked at Ryuji:
"All right, that's enough of the operating-table experience for now—surgeon, hurry and release my legs. If I stay spread out under that big light much longer, I really will get embarrassed."
Ryuji stepped forward and unfastened the straps on both leg supports. He cradled her calves as he lowered them back onto the table, then placed an arm around her waist and helped her naked body down.

The instant her feet touched the operating-room floor, Miyuki did not turn toward the uniform she had left nearby. Instead, she pressed a hand to Ryuji's chest and gently pushed him against the edge of the table, a teasing, heated gleam in her eyes.
"You were so cooperative about securing me and letting me experience being the patient just now... Fair is fair. Before I get dressed, I should take care of my surgeon first."
Without waiting for his answer, the completely naked Miyuki knelt in front of him. Her slender, nimble fingers expertly opened his belt buckle and pulled down his trouser zipper.
Miyuki lifted her face to glance at him and lightly ran the tip of her tongue over her lips:
"Keep quiet, Ryuji. I'll use my mouth and finish you quickly..."
The next moment, she lowered her head and took him fully between her warm, wet lips and tongue.

[Side-description sequence]
The quiet operating room held only stifled breathing and soft, wet sounds. The residual glow of the surgical lights fell across Miyuki's bare, fair shoulders and back. Ryuji instinctively placed a hand against the back of her head and hair, but instead of drawing away, she quickened the rhythm of her lips and tongue. At last, with a muffled sound in her throat, she accepted all of his release in her mouth...

A moment later, Miyuki stood with one hand braced on Ryuji's knee. She drew a tissue from the nursing cart, leisurely wiped the damp redness from the corner of her mouth, then pulled up his zipper and refastened his belt for him.

Only then did she return to the table and put her underwear, white nurse's uniform, and nursing shoes back on one by one. As she fastened the final two buttons at her collar, her usual sweet, slightly wicked smile returned.
Once her uniform was tidy, Miyuki walked up to Ryuji, lightly hooked a finger around the lapel of his white coat, and smiled up at him.
"Speaking of which, Ryuji... I heard you've been operating on other women on the hospital staff."
Ryuji laughed at her mock-accusing expression:
"So word of that reached you too?"
Miyuki traced a small circle over his chest with her index finger. Her gaze shifted, and her tone was three parts coy and seven parts teasing.
"I'm a little jealous. Operate on me next time, all right?"
Ryuji raised an eyebrow and caught the mischievous finger in his hand:
"Most people who get jealous ask for a date or a present. You get jealous and want to lie on an operating table for me to cut open?"
Miyuki laughed and moved another half-step closer into his arms.
All right. But don't beg me for mercy once you're on the table.
You even have to compete over getting cut open. There's no handling you.

"Of course I want dates and presents too. But you look so attractive with a scalpel in your hand, and I don't want other women to have all the fun of being your surgical practice patient. When it's my turn to lie on the table, I want to find out what it's like without anesthesia too~"
"All right. If Nurse Asakura is volunteering so eagerly, don't expect begging for mercy to help once you're really on the table."
Miyuki's eyes curved with her smile.
"Hee-hee. Then I'll have to see whether your hand stays steadier—or whether you start feeling sorry for me first."
Ryuji laughed and gently pinched her cheek:
"You even have to compete over getting cut open. There's no handling you."
Miyuki nuzzled into his palm and smiled.
"That's because you're the surgeon. I have no interest in anyone else's scalpel."
Ryuji put an arm around her waist and agreed with a smile:
"All right. When we find an opening, I'll schedule a procedure especially for my Nurse Asakura."
Miyuki's eyes immediately curved with satisfaction. She turned, walked to the wall, and switched off the surgical lights with a click.
"Then it's a promise, my surgeon. Let's go. If we don't leave soon, I really will sleep in and be late tomorrow morning~"
She naturally linked her arm with Ryuji's and walked lightly out of the operating room, leaving it silent once more.
The nurses' station in the ward was as busy as ever during the day.
Ryuji approached with a chart of orders he had just signed and saw Chizuru Ishigami set a thick stack of rotation assessment forms in front of Miyuki.
"Asakura, you'll be responsible for teaching the two young nurses transferring here next week how to prepare patients in the ward and count instruments."
Miyuki immediately put on a flawless, sweet professional smile.
"Of course, Nurse Manager Ishigami. Leave it to me."
Chizuru gave a small nod and walked briskly away from the nurses' station.
Almost the very second Chizuru disappeared around the corridor corner, Miyuki's sweet smile collapsed. With a long sigh, she slumped bonelessly over the station counter.
Ryuji stepped up to the counter and tapped it, amused.
Miyuki looked up and rolled her eyes at him, jabbing her ballpoint pen into the thick stack of training forms as she complained.

"How could I say no in front of Nurse Manager Ishigami? Honestly, I came to Hoshimi Hospital to be an easygoing junior nurse because I was sick of that old semi-management work—supervising people, making schedules, and training new staff..."
"And look what happened. I barely managed to pretend I had no experience for a few days, and now whenever Nurse Manager Ishigami has the thankless job of training newcomers, she dumps it on me."
"That's what you get for being unable to hide how skilled you are. The capable do more."
Resting her chin on her hand, she lowered her voice to complain to Ryuji.

"You have no idea. Some of the new nurses are so clumsy they can tie even the simplest sterile pack into an impossible knot. It makes me so angry I want to strap them to the operating table and make an incision so they'll learn their lesson."
Ryuji stopped short and looked at her, momentarily at a loss for words.
Seeing Ryuji's frozen expression, Miyuki stared for half a second, then burst out laughing. She reached across the counter and lightly patted the back of his hand.
"I'm joking! Dr. Sakaguchi, what kind of face is that? Don't tell me you actually believed me?"
Ryuji looked at her lovely eyes, curved like crescents yet always keeping him guessing how much mischief lay behind them, and sighed helplessly.
"I think you really would do it."
