"Thank you, Dr. Mizuki. But put your main project away for now."
Narumi Jinguji took another neatly bound research draft from her folder. Its paper edges were worn from repeated handling, and the pages were densely covered in revision notes of several colors.

"What really makes Hirasaka bite is not a simple theoretical model, but the one in my hand - "Layered Surgical Strategy for Treatment of Complex Pelvic Endometriosis Lesions and Preservation of Ovarian Function."
Ren Nanase took a gentle breath:
"Doctor Narumi... Isn't this the article you have always wanted to finish? You were organizing it when you were in the old hospital. After coming to Hoshimi, you often changed your rest time..."
Aqua read several pages closely and, unusually for her, did not interrupt at once. After a moment, she spoke with complete seriousness.
"This clinical surgical stratification strategy... is far more grounded than my theoretical model. It was built piece by piece through years of work at the operating table."
"Wait. I was the one who suggested offering him a research benefit, but I never expected you to bring out this project. You spent years building it."
Narumi Jinguji looked up at him, her gaze clear and composed:
"I have thought it through. Then and now, I have always calculated the price I am willing to pay with clear eyes."
She placed the research paper in the center of the table.

"First, if we hand over Aqua's principal project, Hirasaka will immediately realize that Hoshimi has someone capable of producing new bargaining chips at any time. That would not be a truce; it would be inviting a predator through the door. Second, Hirasaka is a pelvic surgeon himself. He spent years trying—and failing—to establish a tissue-preserving layered approach for deep lesions. Only this unique clinical protocol, which cost me years of work, will convince him that he has gained the better end of the bargain. And only my willingness to surrender priority leadership over the project I kept in reserve will make him understand that I am determined to buy a permanent end to his interference."
"If you give up the initiative of first verification and priority publication, your loss is really too great."
Narumi Jinguji showed a little bitter smile:

"I read all the modification records again last night. To be honest, I couldn't bear to part with it. I still feel pain when I think about it. But you have to pay real money to make a deal - if you give up its first verification and priority publishing opportunities, I can get him to shut up completely and let us continue to work here with peace of mind. I accept this price."

"Even at that price, the intellectual-property boundaries must be explicit. You may yield only priority leadership for the first validation and publication of the unpublished method framework and aggregate analysis. Your genuine original contribution must remain fully credited under ordinary research-collaboration standards, and neither the original research drafts nor the patients' source data can ever become bargaining goods."
Aqua Mizuki suddenly raised her hand:

"How about this? Narumi's irreplaceable surgical strategy must remain the main course, but I can extract a limited postoperative-recovery assessment parameter table from my drafts and append it, saving him some statistical work during validation."

She looked at Narumi and added with bright eyes: "Also, when this matter is over, can we work on the next article together? There are two places in the layering method you just mentioned that I think I can continue to study - I am not trying to compensate you for anything, I really want to try it!"
"Doctor Aqua, does this count as inviting someone to work overtime together?"
Narumi Jinguji looked down at her research manuscript, and after a while, she also smiled:
"...Okay. Let's wait until this matter is over."
After Aqua left, the four of them completely finalized the bottom line and advancement method of the negotiations.

"For this kind of gray private truce, there is no need to enter into a complicated formal settlement contract. It is enough to clearly explain the rules on the upper and lower levels of the table through an intermediary."

"Exactly. The first layer is the private understanding: he immediately ends every investigation into Hoshimi Hospital, sends no one else to approach Narumi or Ren directly or indirectly, and does not harass Ms. Kunizuka or any of our current patients and colleagues."

"In exchange, the former-hospital records bearing my signature will be entrusted to Professor Takamine and the other two senior colleagues for independent safekeeping. As long as he follows the rules, the material will never be made public. If he reaches out again, the three of them can initiate a formal professional review at any time."

"The second layer is the formal research collaboration: subject to compliance review by neutral senior colleagues, Narumi will grant him leadership of the first validation and priority publication for the unpublished methodological framework and aggregate analysis of her stratified surgical strategy, together with Aqua's supporting parameter table. Narumi's genuine original contribution will be credited through the normal research-collaboration process, the original drafts will remain at Hoshimi, and no patient-identifying information will be involved."
Asuka Jogu puts down the pen:

"It not only gives him a high-value academic achievement that he can handle with dignity, but also puts the knife of verification above his head. Let the intermediary arrange a phone call with him based on this framework."
Ren Nanase looked at the outline on the desktop:
Narumi Jinguji reached out and rested her hand gently over the back of Ren's hand:
"We cannot appeal to his conscience, but we can make him calculate the costs and benefits. This time, we hold the leverage."
A few days later, through a professional intermediary introduced by Asuka's mother's old friend, the two parties arranged an undisclosed remote call.
Ryuji Hirasaka did not come to Hoshimi in person. The screen displayed only a single line with the participant's name, while his voice came through the speaker.
"It has been a long time, Dr. Jinguji. Nurse Nanase as well. I did not expect to find both of you doing so well."
"Today is not for you to care about their personal lives."
"I heard that Ms. Kunizuka underwent a highly successful operation at your hospital. Should I offer Hoshimi my thanks?"
"Doctors take care of their patients, no strings attached."
Asuka sent the research-collaboration summary to the other party through the conference sharing window.

"You have confirmed that Narumi and Ren are here, and we know that you sent people to investigate them. These are the research-collaboration terms we can offer. Meanwhile, Professor Takamine, Professor Kanbara, and Director Shirakawa have been entrusted to hold the relevant former-hospital records independently."
There was silence over the speaker. After a while, Hirasaka spoke again.

"Preserved stratified treatment of deep pelvic lesions...it turns out that you have achieved this level. The clinical value of this study is probably higher than what you wrote in the abstract. Are you really willing to give up the leading opportunity for first verification and priority publication?"
"Within the scope stated in the summary, I am willing."
"Because I don't want to spend the rest of my time on you. You will get a unique result worthy of careful study, and we will get space to continue working and living."
A faint sneer came from the speaker.

"The terms sound very tempting. However, Narumi, since we have to negotiate clearly, it would be too stingy to only give me the methodological framework and follow-up verification rights. Why not hand over the original case manuscript you have to me, and then withdraw the old data sent to the three seniors - wouldn't that be more sincere?"
Narumi Jinguji didn't even blink her eyelids, her voice was cold and determined:

"If I hand over the original drafts and withdraw the old records held by those three senior colleagues, you will send a third person to Hoshimi tomorrow, won't you? Dr. Hirasaka, we know one another too well. Only if the old hospital records bearing even my own signature remain in Professor Takamine's hands, while priority publication leadership is transferred to you in stages through a normal collaboration process, will the tension remain balanced fairly."
"Those old records you handed in, if they really come to the stage of verification, you yourself can't get away with it, right?"
"Verify whatever needs to be verified, including my part back then. I can afford to pay my price, but you can't afford it with your current status."
The other end of the speaker was silent for a long time, and then Hirasaka whispered with some scrutiny:
"...I thought hiding in that kind of gentle little hospital would blunt your claws. It seems you haven't changed at all, Narumi Jinguji. After all, you are still as ruthless as before."
Narumi Jinguji did not deny it, but answered calmly:
"I just put my thoughts on things more worthy of calculation."
There was silence for a moment, and the voice of Hirasaka came again:
"...Ren. You have not said a word this whole time."
"Don't you have anything to say to me?"
"Yes. Please don't come to me again in the future. This is not a decision made by Dr. Narumi for me, it is my own decision."
There was a moment of silence on the other end of the speaker.
After a few seconds, his voice returned to its usual restraint:

"Very well. I have no interest in a bargain that harms us both. I accept your terms. From this moment on, I will stop investigating Hoshimi and send no one else after either of you. Kunizuka's errands for me end here as well. The research authorization and authorship will proceed through the normal academic-collaboration process."
"The intermediary has been recorded. As long as both parties abide by the tacit understanding, the materials kept by the three seniors will never be opened."
It was quiet for a moment.
Asuka Jogu looked at the darkened call window and let out a breath:
"This is not a sudden realization of conscience on his part. He has figured out that it is not worthwhile to continue pursuing the case."
"It is much more reliable to let him calculate the pros and cons than to expect his conscience to find out."
Yayoi Kunizuka has recovered well and has completed the formal discharge procedures.
Before leaving the hospital, she pushed her small suitcase to say goodbye to the three of them.

"I have truthfully reported the situation here to Dr. Hirasaka during the past few days in the hospital. However, he suddenly informed me two days ago that I will no longer be required to be responsible for any contact with you in the future."
"Yes. This is just the right time to rest peacefully."
Narumi Jinguji handed her the discharge follow-up form:
"Come back next month for your postoperative follow-up on the date shown here. If you feel any discomfort while recovering, contact the outpatient clinic at once."
Yayoi accepted the follow-up form and looked at the three of them, who were acting as though nothing unusual had happened. She blinked in surprise.
"Be careful on the road, Ms. Kunizuka."
Yayoi Kunizuka was silent for a moment and solemnly nodded to the three of them:
She pushed the small suitcase and turned towards the elevator.
When Ryuji Sakaguchi pushed the door in, he saw Narumi Jinguji organizing the bookshelf.

Narumi was putting the old dark-colored binder that had given up the control of first verification and priority publication into the upper shelf of the bookshelf for filing. her fingers paused on the spine for a moment, and then she placed a brand new blank notebook at hand.
"The directions we made with Dr. Aqua have just been outlined."
The price of giving up the initial launch and research leadership that has been saved for several years is indeed too heavy.
Any surgeon would be furious at having to hand over a core project she spent years developing to someone like that.
"The initial release and research leadership that I have saved up for several years are just given away. The price is indeed too heavy."
Narumi Jinguji did not try to be brave and smiled calmly:
"It is. The loss is heavy enough that I nearly stopped several times while preparing the handover summary last night."
"Any surgeon would be upset if I handed over the core topic that I have been working on for several years to that kind of person."
Narumi Jinguji breathed out gently, and a trace of real regret flashed in her eyes:
"It's not just a fire, it hurts like hell. It's been years of clinical effort, and it's not something you can just put down and laugh off."
Narumi Jinguji stopped looking at the old binder and turned to look at Ryuji Sakaguchi, her expression returning to her usual calmness and vigor.

"Still, I made the calculation and signed this agreement myself, so I will honor it. I may have surrendered priority publication leadership, but I still have my clinical experience and the scalpel in my hand. What I have lost, I will earn back piece by piece at Hoshimi's operating tables."
"If you need case accumulation and collaboration with colleagues, please come to me at any time."
Narumi Jinguji raised her eyebrows slightly:
"Let me be clear in advance, Dr. Sakaguchi: the next time we are in the operating room, I will still point out every problem that needs to be addressed."
Narumi Jinguji looked at him, her voice softening:
"And thank you for not lecturing me or treating us as people who can do nothing but accept protection."
A faint smile touched the corner of Narumi's lips.
The office door opened and Ren Nanase poked her head inside.
"You two! If there is no urgent surgery right now, could you come to the lounge and help me with a very serious problem?"

"I bought three sandwiches for us. Then Dr. Mizuki heard there was food and followed me. She is standing outside the lounge with her laptop, saying she can show us three papers she just finished while we eat—and that this time she even remembered to submit them!"
Narumi laughed so hard that she had to steady herself against the bookshelf.
"Let's go. We cannot let her put the sandwiches on top of her papers."
The three of them left the surgical office together and headed toward the lively staff lounge.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_yoshizumi_aki.pa: Aki Yoshizumi

"Hospitalization...? Come on, Doctor, I haven't even had a chance to change out of this yellow team uniform! Doubling over on the track today was embarrassing enough, but is it really serious enough that I have to be admitted?"

"All right, all right—if I pass out from pain in the pit lane again, the girls on the team waiting to see me fail will have a field day. I'll check in, but you have to tell me the test results straight."

"Hold on, Doctor! The surgical site you mentioned on the ward doesn't match what you're saying now, does it? I may not be a med student, but I can still tell where on my own body you're planning to cut!"
"...Okay, putting it like that makes things much clearer. Thanks, Doctor—I was worried you'd brush me off with canned medical talk."
"Just 'standard procedure'? Doctor, I'm putting my body in your hands here—don't brush me off like a boring sponsor meeting."
"I've never had stage fright in front of a hundred telephoto lenses, but lying on an operating table is a whole different story... Doctor, you'll be keeping your eyes on me the whole time, right?"
"General anesthesia, huh... Fair enough. Sleeping right through it beats lying awake listening to the scalpel slice my belly open. Just make sure you're the first one to talk to me when I wake up."
"Epidural anesthesia? Numb and unable to move from the waist down while my mind stays wide awake... Sounds like being tied to a chair trackside watching myself get cut open."
"Local anesthesia... meaning I can chat with you the whole way through, right? If it starts pulling and hurting deep inside, don't expect me to play the quiet lady and hold it in."
"No anesthesia at all?! Doctor, you don't seriously think just because a race queen can stand in high heels under the summer sun all day, I can handle being cut open live with a scalpel, do you?!"
"Okay... deep breaths, right? Hah, having the mask pressed over my face really does get my heart racing... Doctor, I'm trusting you with this figure I've worked so hard to keep..."
"It hurts... it really hurts! Doctor, I'm not joking around—if you keep cutting like this I'm really going to scream!"
"D-don't pin me down like that! I don't have any anesthesia—who wouldn't flinch watching a blade come down on their own skin?!"
"I wasn't moving on purpose! The retractor just yanked deep inside and sent a sharp ache through me, so my body jerked on its own... be gentler!"
"My legs won't budge an inch, yet I can still tell someone is moving my lower body around... feeling like my body doesn't belong to me is terrifying."
"W-wait a second! I was joking earlier when I said I wasn't scared, but seeing the scalpel hovering right over my skin... my palms are soaked in sweat—please warn me before you cut!"
"...You already cut? There wasn't a sharp stab, but I could clearly feel something slice across my skin and pull it apart... ugh, my heart is pounding like crazy..."
"Hss—! The surface is numb, but cutting deeper still feels tight and wrenching! Doctor, are you sure this local anesthetic is enough?!"
"Aaah—!! It hurts! The blade really just sliced straight into my flesh! Wait, stop for a second, I can't take this...!"
"Hah, hah... th-thank you for stopping... let me catch my breath, the pain nearly made my vision go white..."
"I know I'm not supposed to move...! But barking orders at me doesn't help—at least tell me how much longer this part is going to hurt!"
"You still have to keep going deeper...? Fine, I'll grit my teeth and cooperate, just don't laugh at me if I cry out!"
"Which step are we on now? ...Okay, hearing your voice makes me feel like I'm not just a slab of meat on the table."
"Doctor... look me in the eye and say something to me again, will you? Lying flat here unable to see what your hands are doing—staring up at that glaring lamp overhead—is making me panic inside."
"Hey... why did everyone suddenly go quiet? Don't tell me you found something awful inside?! Doctor, say something!"
"We're finally closing up...? Phew... thank goodness. If I said anything bratty just now, pretend you didn't hear it, okay? Thanks."
"Inhale... exhale... okay, I'm following your rhythm. Even my toughest posture training was never this exhausting..."
"...I finally made it through. Just let me lie quietly for a bit—I don't even have the energy left to put on my commercial smile."

"An e-enema...?! Hey, Doctor, just because I work as a race queen doesn't mean I can bare my bottom on a hospital bed and have a tube pushed up behind me without batting an eye!" (As warm water rushes into my belly, my whole face feels hot enough to catch fire...!)

"Ugh... my stomach is getting fuller and fuller... I watch my diet and figure every single day to fit into cropped uniforms, and now I'm being pumped full of water and told to clench and hold it in...!" (My insides are churning like crazy and I have to clench hard in front of everyone... This is torture!)

"Wait, I have to hold it in for several more minutes before I can use the restroom?! I-I'm already at my limit—don't just stand by the bed staring at me!" (Finally cleared for the restroom... I've officially lost a lifetime's worth of dignity today.)

"Hold on, an enema wasn't even required for this operation, was it?! Yet you already had me drop my pants and take a bellyful of warm water... Doctor, were you just using pre-op prep as an excuse to watch me embarrass myself?!" (Made to bare my backside for nothing, and my lower belly is still aching and full...!)

"Phew... you call it an extra precaution, but I'm the one who had to suffer the embarrassment. Even dealing with handsy sponsors at the circuit was never this undignified..." (My stomach is churning so hard I can barely hold it in—all that humiliation for nothing...!)

"Skin prep... you have to shave all the hair off down below my belly too?! Doctor, even when I wear high-cut race queen outfits I only trim the bikini line—I've never spread my legs in front of a man to be shaved completely bare!" (Feeling the blade glide across such tender skin has me too scared even to breathe...!)

"Ugh... the sound of the blade scraping across the skin there is way too clear... d-don't part it with your fingers just to check for stray hairs!" (Shaved completely bare down there—even shifting an inch feels chilly and strange...)

"It feels so breezy... now that it's completely shaved, the slightest movement of my thighs lets the air brush straight against my most sensitive spot..." (With everything shaved bare, the cool air hits right against me—I don't even know where to put my legs...)

"Hey, Doctor! This private area isn't even near the surgical incision, is it?! Telling me it wasn't strictly necessary only after shaving me completely bare down there—are you bullying me on purpose?!" (Shaved completely smooth where the scalpel won't even touch—the draft down there is mortifying...!)

"Great, now I won't be able to wear a high-cut race uniform for weeks after I'm discharged... Doctor, you'd better take responsibility for leaving me completely bare down there." (Bare skin touches directly whenever I close my legs—it feels so weird I can barely sit still...!)

"Even the violet-blue hair I spend an hour conditioning every single day has to be stuffed inside this flat sterile cap, huh..." (Even the last lock of hair hiding my face is tucked away—I'm really about to go under the knife...)

"Having my forehead and ears completely exposed like this is actually pretty embarrassing. Oh well, it's not like I'm standing on the podium in front of cameras today." (Seeing the gurney waiting right beside the bed, my palms are already slick with cold sweat...)

"My wrists and ankles have to be buckled into restraint straps? Hah... when photographers surround me at the circuit, at least I'm the one choosing the pose; strapped to this operating table, I'm completely at your mercy." (Wrists and ankles buckled into the straps... I can't even lift a hand to cover myself!)

"The shadowless lamp is glaring right down on my bare skin... Doctor, now that you've got me pinned in such a defenseless posture, are you satisfied?" (Everyone is looking down around the table checking my body—I'm clenching my toes in shame...)

"You're strapping my hands and feet down tight to the operating table without a single drop of anesthesia...?! Doctor, you can't be serious—when the blade cuts into me later, I won't even be able to flinch?!" (Strapping all four limbs down without a drop of anesthesia... I can't even writhe when the blade cuts?!)

"D-don't buckle the straps that tight! You haven't even made the incision yet and my wrists and knees are already shaking uncontrollably..." (No anesthesia and strapped wide open like this... Can I really survive what's coming...?!)

"Inserting a urinary catheter through my urethra while I'm wide awake...?! W-wait a second, do my legs have to be spread this wide under the shadowless lamp while you push a tube straight in there?!" (Before the scalpel even starts, I have to spread my legs under the lamp for a catheter...!)

"Yaaah...! The tube is pushing in... it feels so sour and swollen inside, like a thin rod burrowing through my most delicate spot... don't tell me to relax right now, there's no way I can!" (Warm urine is flowing out through clear tubing while I'm wide awake to feel every second...!)

"Hah... is it taped in place now? Having a tube left between my legs draining urine while my mind is wide awake is just cruel..." (Hearing that faint sound in the tubing, I can only bite my lip and turn my burning face away!)

"Pushing a catheter straight in with zero anesthesia?! Ugh, aaah—! It stings, it hurts! My urethra feels like it's being stretched open—slower, please go slower!" (Shoving a catheter straight in without anesthesia... That searing sting nearly made me scream!)

"Ugh... that literally brought tears to my eyes... every millimeter the tube shifts inside feels like a needle, and I don't even dare twitch my hips!" (It's throbbing raw inside me—I don't even dare twitch my hips a fraction of an inch...!)

"Hss—that's freezing! Warn a girl before pressing an icy antiseptic swab against her skin... spiraling outward from the incision center until even my chest and inner thighs are wet." (That antiseptic is freezing! Swabbed across bare skin, it means the blade is moments away...)

"Seeing my stomach and lower body painted soaking wet like this really makes me feel like a specimen prepped for dissection on the table..." (As the liquid evaporates and steals my warmth, I can't stop a faint shiver...)

"That chill made me shiver... Doctor, if even the antiseptic swab feels this sharp, how on earth am I supposed to survive when you slice me open with a scalpel without anesthesia?!" (If a cold sponge feels this sharp, how much will it hurt when the raw scalpel cuts me open?!)

"D-don't just finish wiping the antiseptic and reach for the scalpel in silence! I'm wide awake here—please say something to me before you cut!" (Watching the doctor's hand move toward the instrument tray makes me want to bolt right off the table!)

"The marker tip tickles as it glides across my belly... though knowing this purple line is where I'm about to be cut open gives a race queen who makes her living by her figure serious chills." (That marker tip feels so vivid—knowing the scalpel will slice right along this line makes me panic...)

"Doctor, does the incision line really have to be that long...? Make sure you cut neatly later—don't leave an ugly scar on me." (The line is longer than I pictured... Please be gentle when the blade comes down...)

"Drawing an incision line on skin with zero anesthesia... meaning any second now, a real scalpel is going to slice my flesh open live right along this track?!" (Drawing an incision line on unanesthetized flesh... Is a raw scalpel really slicing here next?!)

"W-wait! I saw the nurse hand you the scalpel... give me three seconds to take a deep breath, I'm really not ready to take this cut wide awake!" (I just saw the nurse hand over the scalpel... Give me three seconds to breathe, I'm terrified!)
Doctor, sorry for being brought straight in still wearing this yellow race queen uniform... What hit me out on the circuit today is: {line}

Honestly, this problem has been nagging at me for a while, and the main symptom is: {line}. Today it hurt so badly on the starting grid that I doubled over and couldn't stand up—one of our team's drivers had to rush me straight to the hospital.

There's also something pretty embarrassing to admit: {line}. I had it checked before and the doctor told me it wasn't hemorrhoids; plus I had a gastric ulcer in the past, and when I was little my family had my intestines examined because they suspected a hereditary bowel condition.

My name is Aki Yoshizumi, and I work as a race queen. People see us smiling in skimpy outfits for the cameras and think it's easy, but during racing season we're constantly on the road with wrecked sleep schedules and fierce rivalry among the girls on the team. I thought it was just my old stomach trouble acting up from workplace stress, but doubling over like this means I can't just tough it out with supplements anymore.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_yoshizumi_aki.en: "Hold on, Doctor! A basic physical exam requires stripping off my entire race queen uniform, including my bra and panties?! You don't think just because I wear a cropped top at the track, I'm fine with stripping stark naked in an exam room, do you?" (Wearing a crop-top race outfit and stripping stark naked for a stranger are two totally different things!)

"Oh, I don't have to strip completely after all? Glad you know how to respect a girl's pride. Still, Doctor, make sure you get to the bottom of my abdominal pain and blood in the stool some other way, okay?" (Phew... at least I kept my last bit of dignity and didn't have to strip off my bra and panties on the spot to be looked over from head to toe.)

"All right, all right, I get that you're following medical protocol—no need to put on such a stern face! I'll strip... though you'd better keep your eyes strictly on what's medically relevant, Doctor." (I can still crack a joke to save face, yet when I reach back to unhook my bra and slide my low-rise panties down my thighs, my fingertips tremble with embarrassment...) Taking a deep breath, Aki removes her yellow cropped race queen top and shorts along with her bra and panties, placing them in the tray; her carefully toned, stark-naked figure is laid bare under the exam lamp as she stands before you with reddened ears to complete the full physical examination.

"Thanks—having you explain the reasons so patiently makes it much easier to accept. If it's to find the root of my illness, I'll play along and cooperate with you." (Even saying that, when the last scrap of underwear leaves my body and I stand stark naked under the bright white light in front of the doctor and nurse, my cheeks burn fiercely.) Following your gentle guidance, Aki removes her yellow race queen uniform and underwear piece by piece, briefly covering her breasts and groin with her hands before lowering her arms with a deep blush as you complete the naked physical exam.

"Hey, using my chart and refusing treatment to pressure me? Doctor, is that how you usually talk to women...? Fine, I'll strip! I can't afford to go back to the circuit like this and become a laughingstock!" (I'm furious and humiliated, yet knowing that getting turned away would cost me my spot on the team leaves me no choice but to grit my teeth and strip completely bare in front of them...) Her smile vanishing, Aki bites her lower lip as she strips off her yellow uniform, bra, and panties without leaving a single thread on, standing stark naked under the examination light in tense mortification through the full exam.
strings.patient_bundles.patient_yoshizumi_aki.pr: Aki Yoshizumi's Preoperative Preparation
"Yo, Dr. Sakaguchi, you're here. I already asked the driver who brought me in to arrange my leave with the team... go ahead and tell me straight how you're planning to fix me up in surgery today."

"Still, Doctor, I hate being kept in the dark. Once I change out of my clothes on the ward and get wheeled into the OR—from shaving, tubes, and getting strapped to the table for disinfection all the way to the scalpel cutting in—can you walk me through every single step?"

At first Aki rests her chin in her hand, listening with her usual poised smile. Yet as she hears that she will soon be stripped bare on the ward for an enema and intimate shaving, laid naked on the operating table with her limbs strapped down, parted under the shadowless lamp for a urinary catheter, and sliced open by a sharp scalpel, the smile slowly freezes on her lips. The body she takes such pride in pampering with daily lotion and workouts is about to be laid open without a shred of dignity beneath the knife; she unconsciously presses her thighs together, her knuckles whitening on the hem of her gown.
Dr. Sakaguchi will serve as lead surgeon for Aki Yoshizumi's operation. Select the assistant doctor, scrub nurse, and circulating nurse for the surgical team.

Aki Yoshizumi sits on the edge of her hospital bed taking deep breaths, trying to keep up her cheerful front. Assign a ward preparation nurse (or perform the steps yourself as Dr. Sakaguchi) to complete the required preoperative body preparation and up to two comfort actions.
"Hah... preoperative prep really is brutal on a girl's pride, isn't it... My whole body feels strange inside and out, and you've just about drained the last of my energy for cracking jokes."
Ward preparations are complete. You and the surgical team head to the locker room to change into sterile scrubs, complete your surgical scrub at the sink, and step into the operating room.

"Wow... that shadowless lamp is ten times more blinding than the spotlights at a circuit press conference. Except under press spotlights I'm posing for trophies—lying on this cold metal table today, there's nowhere to run."

Before surgery begins, the team gathers around the operating table to verify Aki Yoshizumi's name, surgical site, planned procedure, and roles. Lying on the table, Aki tries to answer in a breezy tone, though a tense tremor betrays her at the end of her voice.
Review Aki Yoshizumi's medical chart and preoperative examination findings to finalize the surgical procedure and approach.
"Hold on, Doctor! That's not the surgical site you explained to me earlier, is it? I'm wide awake here—don't mix up where you're cutting!"
Aki Yoshizumi has completed ward preparation and is waiting on the operating table. Confirm the anesthesia method and conditions to begin the operation.
"Okay, I'll count along with you... one, two... Doctor, don't cut me up too badly, okay? I still want to get back to the circuit looking good..."

Aki Yoshizumi is fast asleep under general anesthesia, her violet-blue bangs resting quietly against the edge of her surgical cap and her chest rising and falling steadily with the ventilator beneath the shadowless lamp.
"My lower body really is completely numb and immobile... Being able to hear you handling the instruments while my legs feel disconnected is seriously unnerving."
"The local anesthetic is in, right? Okay, I'll try my best not to move... though if it pulls and hurts deep inside, I'm going to say so loud and clear."
"We're really starting without a drop of anesthesia...?! Doctor, no matter how tough I act, watching that scalpel get handed over while I'm strapped to the table is making my legs go weak...!"
Dr. Sakaguchi extends a hand with a brief command, and the scrub nurse firmly places the first gleaming scalpel into the surgeon's palm.
The assistant doctor takes position on both sides of the planned incision with sterile gauze to maintain skin tension, awaiting Dr. Sakaguchi's first cut.
The shadowless lamp focuses on the center of the bare operative field. The sharp tip of the scalpel hovers just above the purple marker line on Aki Yoshizumi's skin.

strings.patient_bundles.patient_tifa.patient.rea: “Mm...! The incision isn't on my lower belly or down there, so why did you shave my private hair completely clean anyway?!” (Exposing my most private spot to be shaved for nothing—just thinking about it makes my ears burn...!)

“Shaved spotless where no prep was needed... Every slight movement brushes bare skin and sets my heart racing in shame...!” (Breezy and bare without a single hair left, and all of it was completely unnecessary... ugh!)

strings.collections.character_events.aqua_lv2_wa: After your tenth gynecological surgery, Aqua Mizuki intercepts you outside the gynecology exam room with sparkling eyes, eager to mentor you in an Open Total Abdominal Hysterectomy with pre-incision uterine manipulator assistance.

At 3:30 in the afternoon, Ryuji Sakaguchi had just finished signing the postoperative orders for today's ovarian cyst surgery when an urgent internal phone call summoned him to the Chief of Gynecology's office.
Before he even reached the doorway, the clinking rattle of metal surgical instruments being rummaged through echoed from behind the half-open door.
"Ah! Sakaguchi, perfect timing! Come in, come in—pull that chair by the desk over and have a seat!"

Behind the desk, twenty-eight-year-old Chief of Gynecology Aqua Mizuki was beaming with excitement, her long azure hair swaying as she turned to grab a wall chart, practically bouncing out of her swivel chair.
Ryuji Sakaguchi stepped into the office and glanced at the pelvic anatomy charts and stainless-steel instruments spread across the desk:
"Chief Mizuki, calling me over in such a rush—is there a difficult case consultation?"

"Way more important than a routine consultation! I just checked this month's specialty surgical log at the Medical Affairs Office—counting the case from this morning, you've officially participated in and completed ten gynecological surgeries at Hoshimi Hospital!"
Planting both hands on the desk, she leaned forward and declared word by word as if announcing a grand commendation:

"Routine minor benign adnexal procedures aren't any challenge for you anymore. As Hoshimi Hospital's Chief of Gynecology, I've decided to personally guide you to the next level—Sakaguchi, do you want to learn how to perform an Open Total Abdominal Hysterectomy from me?"
"That's exactly what I was hoping for. I'd be grateful for your guidance, Chief Mizuki."
"Let me check my schedule for this week first..."
"That's exactly what I was hoping for. Handling the deep pelvic vasculature and anatomical planes definitely calls for your guidance, Chief Mizuki."
Aqua Mizuki puffed out her chest proudly:
"Hehe, you've got a good eye! Learning gynecology from this Chief means you've come to the absolute right person!"
Ryuji Sakaguchi started to check his calendar:
"Let me check my schedule for this week first..."
Aqua Mizuki waved a hand grandly and settled it for him on the spot:
"Oh my, already working out the schedule—I knew you couldn't wait to learn! Don't worry, leave the shift coordination entirely to this Chief!"
"...I don't think I said we were operating right away."

Ignoring his dry remark completely, Aqua snapped open a large full-color sagittal cross-sectional chart of the female pelvis and picked up a long all-stainless-steel instrument fitted with a metal colpotomy cup and a gently curved tip.

"Listen closely, Sakaguchi! A lot of surgeons trained in general surgery think an open total hysterectomy is just a matter of slicing open the belly and cranking the abdominal retractors wide—dead wrong! The true soul of complex gynecological pelvic surgery begins before the skin incision, with patient positioning and lower-tract control!"

Gripping the metal handle, she mimed an upward levering arc in midair. The instant she entered her clinical element, her speech grew rapid and remarkably structured—though her volume climbed right along with it:

"Especially in cases where uterine fibroids have enlarged and distorted the uterus, or where the posterior wall is adherent to the rectouterine pouch! Before making the abdominal incision, if you place the patient in a modified lithotomy position with her legs spread wide and elevated, dilate the anterior and posterior vaginal walls thoroughly with a metal speculum, and clamp the anterior lip of the cervix with a toothed tenaculum to pull it straight—"
The office door was still more than halfway open. Out in the corridor, two young nurses passing by with treatment trays froze in their tracks.
Completely oblivious, Aqua Mizuki kept waving the instrument and lecturing at the top of her lungs:

"Then you slide this metal uterine manipulator all the way up the cervical canal to the uterine fundus and tighten the wing nut to lock it dead! That way, just by standing between the patient's legs, gripping the external handle, pushing firmly cephalad, and swinging it wide left and right, the entire uterus and both cardinal ligaments stretch taut and crystal-clear deep in the pelvis—pushing the circumcision line of the vaginal fornix right up beneath your scalpel tip!"
Outside the door, one of the young nurses blushed crimson to the tips of her ears, ducked her head, and hurried away.
With a slight twitch at his temple, Ryuji Sakaguchi reached out and pulled the door half-shut:
"Chief Mizuki, I follow the anatomy and exposure principles, but could you watch your volume with the office door open...?"

Aqua Mizuki looked at the unflappable Sakaguchi, then glanced down at the speculum, cervical tenaculum, and metal uterine manipulator in her hands, furrowing her brows as if dissatisfied that a verbal explanation wasn't intuitive enough.

"Hmm... Just waving the handle in thin air over a wall chart won't let you feel the real resistance when the metal colpotomy cup seats against the external os, or get a sense of bimanual palpation through the abdominal wall."
The next second, her eyes lit up. Slapping the desk, she sprang to her feet, picked up the instrument tray, and pulled the office door wide open:

"I've got it! Theory on paper is no match for hands-on practice—let's just grab a nurse right now to lie down in the exam room next door or on an empty operating table and give us a live demonstration!"
Out in the corridor, three gynecology nurses pushing a utility cart during shift handover froze simultaneously.
Without an ounce of self-awareness, Aqua Mizuki waved warmly at them while the metal speculum and manipulator rod glinted coldly under the fluorescent lights:

"Hey—which one of you is free right now? Come be a live teaching aid for Dr. Sakaguchi and me for ten minutes! It'll be super quick—just take off your panties and put your legs up in the stirrups so I can show Sakaguchi how to clamp the cervix with the tenaculum and slide the manipulator all the way in to test pelvic floor tension—"
"Aah!! Ch-Chief Mizuki, I think Bed 5's IV bottle is almost empty—I'm going to change it right now!!"
"I just remembered the pharmacy urged me to verify tomorrow's anesthesia requisition forms! Excuse me, Chief!!"

The youngest nurse on the end turned pale, spun her stainless-steel nursing cart around, and bolted—nearly slamming a wheel into the doorframe with a loud clang before vanishing around the corner without looking back.
In less than five seconds, the entire gynecology corridor was completely deserted.
Aqua Mizuki stood frozen in place holding the tray:
"...Huh? Is everyone really that busy this afternoon?"
Ryuji Sakaguchi stepped forward, took the instrument tray from her hands with a sigh, and set it back on the desk:
"Don't use healthy colleagues as teaching aids. If you want to demonstrate, teach me when we have a scheduled surgical patient."
Aqua Mizuki puffed her cheeks and grumbled:
"What's the big deal, my technique is super gentle and textbook-perfect, I really don't know what they're scared of... Fine, fine, then let's use an actual surgical patient for the demonstration!"
Walking back behind her desk, she flipped open the gynecology inpatient surgical schedule folder. Her slightly deflated expression suddenly lit up as her eyes scanned the second page:
"Ah! How could I forget about her—Serena, who was just admitted to Bed 7!"
Ryuji Sakaguchi leaned over to glance at the chart summary:
"Twenty-seven years old, severe symptomatic adenomyosis complicated by multiple uterine fibroids and posterior pelvic adhesions... Doesn't the schedule list her for next Friday?"
Aqua Mizuki tapped her finger on the freshly printed hospital-wide lab summary sheet, her voice brisk and certain:

"That's only because OR 2 was fully booked when she was admitted, so she got pushed to next Friday! But at noon today, General Surgery canceled an 8:30 AM elective case for tomorrow, leaving OR 2's first slot wide open! Plus, look—her coagulation panel, ECG, pelvic ultrasound, and blood crossmatch all came back clear at two o'clock this afternoon, and her surgical consent form is already signed and filed!"
Snapping the folder shut, she looked up at Sakaguchi with shining eyes:

"Rather than letting her suffer in the ward for another whole week with chronic blood loss, let's move her straight to tomorrow morning's first slot—I'll be primary surgeon, you'll be first assistant, and before the skin incision I'll use her complex adherent pelvis to give you a complete uterine manipulator exposure demonstration!"
"Moving a surgery scheduled for next Friday all the way up to first thing tomorrow morning... Will she be ready for that mentally?"
Aqua Mizuki tucked the chart clipboard under her arm as if it were the most natural thing in the world:

"The sooner we resect the lesion, the sooner she's free of pain—she'll be thrilled! Come on, let's go to Bed 7 right now to notify her officially, and have the nurses start her fasting and enema prep tonight!"
When they pushed open the door to the private room for Bed 7, the delicate aroma of Darjeeling black tea drifted through the air.

Half-reclining against the headboard, Serena had already changed into the hospital's standard light-colored patient gown, yet still maintained an effortlessly charming, poised elegance—though beneath her carefully applied lip color lingered the pallor of chronic anemia from years of adenomyotic dysmenorrhea and heavy bleeding. Believing she still had well over a week before her scheduled surgery next Friday, she was leisurely holding a bone-china teacup she had brought from home.
Seeing Aqua Mizuki walk in accompanied by a tall young male doctor, Serena closed her fashion magazine and immediately offered a soft, impeccably graceful smile.

"Why, good afternoon, Chief Mizuki. And this unfamiliar young doctor... must be Dr. Ryuji Sakaguchi, whom the nurses praise as both brilliantly skilled and wonderfully considerate, yes? Seeing you in person truly lives up to the reputation—just having you stand by my bed feels so much more reassuring than a certain whirlwind of a department chief."
From her very first sentence, it was a practiced backhanded compliment aimed at quietly drawing Sakaguchi over to her side.
Ryuji Sakaguchi gave a polite, measured nod:
"Good afternoon, Ms. Serena. I'm Ryuji Sakaguchi from Surgery, assisting Chief Mizuki with your perioperative care."
Completely immune to the velvet barbs in Serena's words, Aqua Mizuki walked to the foot of the bed, flipped open her chart clipboard, and cheerfully dropped her bombshell:

"Ms. Serena, I have wonderful news for you! Your entire preoperative workup cleared this afternoon, and a prime 8:30 AM slot in Operating Room 2 just opened up for tomorrow—so I've officially moved your Open Total Abdominal Hysterectomy from next Friday up to the very first case tomorrow morning! Dr. Sakaguchi will be the first assistant for tomorrow's teaching surgery!"
The silver teaspoon between Serena's fingers dropped straight into her porcelain saucer.

Her gentle smile froze for a full two seconds as a flash of genuine panic crossed her eyes—she had been counting on having over a week to steel herself mentally and bargain with the doctors to see if she could avoid going under the knife, and now in the blink of an eye she was going to be wheeled onto the table to have her uterus removed in less than eighteen hours?!
Pressing a hand to the collar of her patient gown, Serena put on a pitiful yet pointedly probing expression as she looked between Sakaguchi and Aqua:

"W-Wait a moment, Chief Mizuki... isn't this far too sudden? Yes, I signed the consent form upon admission, but that was because the surgery was set for next Friday and I thought I had plenty of days to prepare! Dr. Sakaguchi, you're a surgical specialist too—please be the judge. All I have right now is slightly worse period cramps and a touch of anemia. For Chief Mizuki to rush a terrifying major operation like an open total hysterectomy into tomorrow morning... could she be making a mountain out of a molehill with my body just to show off for a trainee?"

Faced with a sharp accusation that would have put an ordinary physician on the defensive, Aqua Mizuki didn't even blink. Taking the rhetorical jab as a sincere medical question, she flipped open the ultrasound folder and answered point by point in earnest:

"It's not making a mountain out of a molehill at all! First, your menstrual blood loss over the past six months has been more than triple normal volume, your hemoglobin has dropped to 8.5, and two consecutive cycles of hemostatic and hormonal therapy have failed. Second, diffuse adenomyosis has infiltrated your entire posterior myometrium alongside four multiple fibroids, the largest of which is wedged behind the uterine isthmus and has fused your posterior uterine wall to the anterior rectum."
The corner of Serena's mouth twitched as she tried again to slow the tempo:

"E-Even if I need surgery, don't other hospitals offer minimally invasive laparoscopy through tiny keyhole incisions, or uterus-sparing surgery that only shells out the fibroids? Give me a little more time to discuss this with both of you—"
Aqua Mizuki shook her head briskly, her gaze clear and thoroughly professional:

"Laparoscopy? Hoshimi Hospital doesn't do keyhole procedures where we poke little holes in the belly—when we resect, opening the abdomen properly to see with our own eyes and palpate with our own hands is the safest way! Besides, even at another hospital, adenomyosis has no capsule boundary, so shelling out only the fibroids would guarantee recurrent severe pain and bleeding. And with your uterus enlarged to twelve weeks' gestational size and such dense posterior adhesions, only a standard Open Total Abdominal Hysterectomy lets us lyse those adhesions under direct vision while protecting the ureters and bladder right next to them. At the same time, I'll preserve both of your healthy ovaries intact, so your endocrine function and daily life won't be affected—though as explained in the clinic, you'll no longer menstruate or be able to bear children after a total hysterectomy."

Under that barrage of airtight clinical reasoning, Serena realized her prized verbal maneuvering had zero purchase against this seemingly airheaded gynecology chief, forced to admit inwardly that the woman's medical expertise was formidable.
Closing the film jacket, Aqua added brightly:

"Oh, right! Because your posterior adhesions sit so deep, before we make the abdominal incision tomorrow, I'll also be giving Sakaguchi a dedicated demonstration under awake regional anesthesia on how to insert the uterine manipulator and perform multi-directional pelvic elevation! You don't mind having the first assistant participate in the teaching coordination, right?"

"Put—putting instruments down there for a demonstration before the incision while I'm wide awake?!" Though Serena forced a stiff nod to preserve her composure about teaching observation, her face drained of color and her voice took on an unmistakable edge. "I don't object to teaching, but operating tomorrow morning is simply too rushed! I'm not mentally prepared yet—please move my surgery back to next Friday!"
Aqua Mizuki blinked her wide eyes and closed the chart folder as if stating the obvious:

"Huh? But you already signed the surgical consent form when you were admitted! At Hoshimi, once the consent form is signed, the hospital decides which day the surgery takes place—OR 2 happens to be free tomorrow morning and all your lab results are ready, so why drag it out until next Friday for nothing?"
"Wh... What kind of rule leaves everything entirely up to the hospital?!"

Before the words had even faded, a gynecology ward nurse wheeled a nursing cart into the room right on cue, briskly clearing away the bone-china teapot and pastry plate from the nightstand while slotting a bright red [NPO — Nothing by Mouth Before Surgery] sign onto the head of the bed.

"Ms. Serena, per the preoperative orders Chief Mizuki just issued for tomorrow morning's first case, please refrain from all food and water starting now. I'll return at 8:00 PM for your first preoperative cleansing enema, and at 6:30 AM tomorrow we'll complete final bowel prep, skin shaving, and urinary catheterization. Please rest comfortably in your room."
Aqua Mizuki waved cheerfully at Serena, who sat frozen on the bed:
"That's settled then! Bear with an empty stomach tonight, and we'll see you in Operating Room 2 at 8:30 tomorrow morning, Ms. Serena!"
Ryuji Sakaguchi also inclined his head slightly:
"Please get a good night's rest. We'll do everything in our power to ensure a safe procedure tomorrow."

As the door clicked softly shut, Serena sat in her loose patient gown staring at the bare nightstand and the glaring red fasting sign, a crack finally splitting through the elegant composure she had worked all afternoon to maintain.

Having endured a night of empty-stomach hunger and her first warm soapy-water enema, Serena barely slept a wink. At 6:45 the next morning, still wearing her patient gown, she was escorted right on schedule into the gynecology ward's preoperative treatment room.
A senior gynecology nurse tested the temperature of the warm soapy solution in the hanging enema irrigator and pushed an empty clothing basket beside the treatment table, her tone calm and efficient:

"Ms. Serena, we're starting your morning bowel prep and skin shaving now. Please take off your patient gown and all underwear and place them in the basket—you won't be wearing clothes when you're wheeled to the operating room afterward."
Used to being in control of every situation, Serena clutched her collar tightly, still trying to negotiate a little leeway in a polite, measured voice:
"Nurse, didn't I already have an enema last night? Couldn't we skip the morning one... and when you wheel me down the corridor later, let me at least keep this patient gown draped over me?"
Rather than arguing, the gynecology nurse simply smiled, shook her head, and lifted the basket to motion for her to raise her arms:

"A total hysterectomy sits right against the rectum and bladder, and instruments have to be placed from below for disinfection before the incision, so the morning enema, lower abdominal and perineal shaving, and catheterization are all mandatory. And staying completely undressed without a gown after morning prep is hospital protocol. Come now, lift your arms so we don't delay the 8:30 start."
Not a trace of irritation, yet as unyielding as a padded wall. Finding her prized social graces utterly useless, Serena could only bite her lower lip and submit.

Half an hour later—stripped of every stitch of clothing, emptied by a second enema, shaved completely bare from her lower abdomen to her vulva and perineum with a traditional razor, and fitted with a soft indwelling urinary catheter—Serena wore nothing but a blue elastic surgical cap gathering her long hair, covered only by a single thin white transfer sheet as her gurney was wheeled into Operating Room 2 right on time.
Inside Operating Room 2, the main surgical lights were not yet at full brightness, and the patient monitor emitted a steady standby beep.

Standing beside the operating table, Ryuji Sakaguchi watched Aqua Mizuki methodically verify the deep pelvic retractors and the complete stainless-steel uterine manipulator assembly with the scrub nurse, while young circulating nurse Moe Honjo clutched her clipboard at the side of the table and answered each checklist item in earnest:
"Yes, Chief Mizuki! Suction negative pressure in OR 2 is normal, and both the epidural tray and the lithotomy leg holders are ready!"
A world apart from her boisterous demeanor in the corridor yesterday, the entire gynecological OR team ran like clockwork under Aqua's crisp, clear commands.
At 8:15 AM, the transfer gurney rolled to a steady halt beside the black operating table.

After Moe Honjo stepped forward with her clipboard to verify the patient's name, bed number, and scheduled procedure, Serena fought back the chill between her bare legs beneath the thin sheet and turned her head toward Sakaguchi with a strained attempt at an elegant smile:
"Good morning, Dr. Sakaguchi... I'll be in your hands today..."

Before she even finished speaking, Moe Honjo took both corners of the thin white transfer sheet from the opposite side of the gurney according to standard protocol and—with a crisp whoosh—whisked the entire sheet off and dropped it into the linen hamper!

With no modesty towel or garment to buffer her, the cool twenty-two-degree air of Operating Room 2 instantly met Serena's completely naked skin. Her fair, full breasts, flat slender abdomen, and freshly shaved, hairless pubis and vulva—with the clear urinary catheter tubing trailing out—were laid bare under the overhead lights beside the operating table.
Turning pale, Serena instinctively covered her chest with one hand and between her legs with the other, crying out in protest:
"Wait! At least give me a towel to cover myself before I move to the table?! Dr. Sakaguchi is standing right there!"

Startled by the patient's sudden outburst, eighteen-year-old Moe Honjo blushed to the tips of her ears above her mask, her fingers tightening slightly on the linen bag, yet she answered strictly by the OR rulebook:

"I-I'm sorry, Ms. Serena... transfer sheets from the ward aren't sterile, so regulations forbid them from touching the operating table... P-Please move your hands out of the way, watch the catheter, and shift onto the operating table slowly."
Aqua Mizuki blinked above her mask and urged her on matter-of-factly:

"What's there to be shy about, Serena! Once you're on the operating table, everyone only sees anatomical planes and prep boundaries—nobody's staring at your figure! Hurry and climb on so you can lie on your side; I need to place your epidural first, and then we still have to scrub in and come back for your pre-incision uterine manipulator demonstration!"
Ryuji Sakaguchi calmly averted his gaze from unnecessary direct staring and steadied the armboard beside Moe Honjo:
"The table pad is a little cool—just shift over slowly."

With even the timid-looking young nurse refusing to yield an inch, Serena bit her lower lip as her ears burned crimson, forced to unclasp her hands and shift her naked body across onto the cool leather operating table in full view of everyone.

Aqua Mizuki promptly positioned Serena in a lateral knee-chest posture, completing skin prep, local infiltration, epidural catheter placement, and test dosing in one seamless, practiced sequence. After instructing Moe Honjo to monitor blood pressure and block level at the bedside, Aqua led Ryuji Sakaguchi into the scrub room to complete a thorough surgical scrub and don sterile gowns and gloves.
Ten minutes later, when Aqua Mizuki and Ryuji Sakaguchi returned to the operating table in sterile gowns and gloves, Moe Honjo had just finished testing the sensory block level with an alcohol swab:
"Chief Mizuki, Dr. Sakaguchi—the patient's blood pressure and heart rate are stable, and the epidural block level is firmly established!"

Lying supine on the operating table, Serena felt her waist and lower abdomen wrapped in a warm, heavy numbness—sharp cutting pain was completely blocked, yet her mind was wide awake, every clink of metal instruments ringing in her ears and the dull deep pressure of tissue traction remaining vividly intact.

Just as she breathed a quiet sigh of relief thinking they were finally going to cover her with sterile green drapes, Moe Honjo and another nurse stepped to the foot of the table, folded down the lower leg section with a click, and raised both curved lithotomy stirrups high and wide.
"Ms. Serena, we need to place you in the modified lithotomy position before the incision—please scoot your hips down to the edge of the table."
Before Serena could come up with an excuse, the two nurses deftly lifted her bare lower legs, spread them wide to either side, and strapped her calves and ankles securely into the stirrups.

With her buttocks flush against the bottom edge of the table, her freshly shaved perineum and closed labia were spread completely open under the auxiliary surgical light rolled up to the foot of the bed.
Serena's breath caught. She tried instinctively to press her thighs together, only to find her knees and ankles locked in midair by the stirrups, unable to close by even a centimeter:
"W-Wait a second...! Why are you strapping my legs like this for an abdominal surgery?! And... Chief Mizuki, where are you telling Dr. Sakaguchi to stand?!"
Standing squarely between Serena's wide-spread legs in high spirits, Aqua Mizuki beckoned energetically to Ryuji Sakaguchi at the side of the abdomen:

"Sakaguchi! Don't just stand up there watching—come stand right next to me! For this pre-incision lower instrument placement and pelvic exposure assessment, you have to see it with your own eyes from this direct angle at the foot of the table!"
Serena's cheeks flared crimson as she craned her neck and protested:

"Dr. Sakaguchi, stay back! Isn't the first assistant supposed to stay by the abdomen?! Chief Mizuki, having a young male doctor stand right in front of a female patient's private parts to watch is completely unethical—"
Aqua Mizuki blinked above her mask and answered with utter candor:

"What do you mean 'watch'? This is a teaching surgery with the first assistant coordinating from start to finish—verifying the lower anatomical axis before skin incision is a legitimate clinical step! And Sakaguchi, let me explain the clinical principle first—"
Taking the stainless-steel bivalve Cusco vaginal speculum and large povidone-iodine swabs from the scrub nurse, Aqua instantly entered a teaching focus so earnest her eyes practically shone:

"Outside hospitals mostly use uterine manipulators for laparoscopy; in routine open total abdominal hysterectomies, we don't actually need one in every single case. However! When you're dealing with a complex case like today's—where multiple fibroids have enlarged and distorted the uterus and dense adhesions tether the posterior wall to the rectouterine pouch—pre-installing a metal uterine manipulator with a colpotomy cup before skin incision makes a night-and-day difference in deep pelvic exposure!"

As she finished speaking, Aqua parted Serena's smooth, shaved labia majora and minora with her sterile-gloved left hand and guided the lubricated povidone-iodine-coated metal speculum steadily along the posterior vaginal wall.
The instant the cool, wide metal blades slid inside her, the intense distending pressure made Serena's shoulders jerk taut, her fingers clamping around the side armboards.

Tightening the lateral thumbscrew to lock the anterior and posterior vaginal walls open, Aqua swabbed the vaginal fornices and cervix thoroughly with brown povidone-iodine balls while naturally stepping half a pace aside to share the view, letting out an admiring professional exclamation:

"Wow, come look, Sakaguchi! This modified lithotomy abduction angle paired with the Cusco speculum gives such a gorgeous exposure! Look at the position of the external cervical os deep inside—see how it's displaced noticeably upward and anteriorly behind the pubic symphysis compared to normal anatomy?"
Ryuji Sakaguchi stepped beside Aqua and leaned in slightly, his gaze focused strictly on the anatomical landmarks as he answered calmly:

"Indeed. The anterior cervical lip is elevated ventrally as a whole and the posterior fornix is stretched deep—likely axial displacement caused by that large posterior isthmic fibroid pushing forward."
Aqua Mizuki's eyes curved with approval:

"Spot on! If we didn't confirm that displacement from below ahead of time, pushing the bladder down and blindly incising the vaginal fornix from the abdomen later could easily injure the trigone or shorten the vaginal cuff!"

Listening to a male and a female doctor standing right between her wide-open legs, calmly dissecting her most intimate internal anatomy line by line and even praising how 'gorgeous' the exposure was, Serena trembled with mortification and bit her lip with a brittle sneer:
"Hmph... Chief Mizuki certainly seems to be enjoying the view... Now that you've seen the position, could the two great doctors kindly take that iron frame propping me open out of me?!"
Unbothered in the slightest, Aqua Mizuki replied briskly as if soothing an impatient student:
"Don't rush—the speculum is just paving the way; today's real MVP is about to go in right now! Scrub nurse—cervical tenaculum, uterine sound, and prepare the metal uterine manipulator!"

Taking the slender metal Museux cervical tenaculum with its hooked teeth, Aqua guided it through the center of the open speculum, aligned it with the smooth anterior lip of the cervix, and clicked the ratchet shut—drawing it steadily outward to straighten the canal!

The moment the metal teeth bit and pulled her deep cervix straight, a sharp dragging ache shot through her lower abdomen, shattering Serena's forced sneer into a muffled groan; at the side of the table, Moe Honjo gripped her pen tightly, her eyes widening above her mask as she instinctively shrank her neck.

Yet Aqua's hands remained impeccably gentle and precise: she first glided a graduated metal uterine sound through the external os to verify the cervical canal curvature and uterine cavity depth with zero risk of false passage or perforation, then withdrew the sound and took the heavy, reusable all-stainless-steel uterine manipulator.

"Watch this step closely, Sakaguchi. Never force it blindly—follow the cavity curvature measured by the sound so the gently curved metal guide rod glides smoothly past the internal os all the way to the uterine fundus—good, seated at the fundus! Next, slide this metal colpotomy cup all the way up the shaft until it cups the entire cervix snugly and tents the anterior and posterior vaginal fornices, then tighten the mid-shaft wing nut to lock it solid!"

Once Aqua locked the cervical traction clamp and manipulator shaft into a single rigid unit with the metal wing nut, she loosened the speculum screw and withdrew the bivalve speculum smoothly from the vagina.

As the speculum slid out, Serena felt a sudden emptiness below—yet deepest inside her remained an unprecedented, cold metallic immobilization. A stainless-steel operating handle over twenty centimeters long protruded straight out from her bare vaginal introitus, its rigid metal rod spanning her cervix to the fundus and pinning her enlarged uterus along a locked metal axis.
Her face flushed crimson, Serena panted with heaving chest:
"I-It feels like an iron rod is jammed all the way inside me... Chief Mizuki, if it's installed, hurry up and let my legs down...!"
Aqua Mizuki shook her head, her sterile-gloved hands wrapping around the metal handle suspended between Serena's legs as her eyes sparkled:

"Installing it without testing it won't do at all! Before skin incision, we have to perform a full multi-directional mobility and bimanual exposure test within safe anatomical limits to confirm the metal colpotomy cup is seated tightly and map the tension boundaries of the pelvic adhesions—Sakaguchi, place your right hand on her lower abdomen just above the pubic symphysis and palpate bimanually with me!"
Stepping forward as instructed, Ryuji Sakaguchi laid his warm, steady sterile-gloved palm gently against the flat, bare skin of Serena's lower abdomen.
The next second, Aqua Mizuki gripped the exposed manipulator handle between Serena's legs and pushed steadily upward along the pelvic axis toward her head—

As Aqua applied steady cephalad elevation with her wrist, Serena felt in shock as her entire uterus deep within the pelvis was levered sharply upward toward her navel by the metal rod inserted through her vagina! Beneath the flat, taut skin of her lower belly, a distinct firm contour bulged visibly upward—pressing straight into Ryuji Sakaguchi's palm!
Aqua Mizuki's voice practically danced as if showing off a masterpiece:

"Do you feel that, Sakaguchi?! Look how directly this all-metal instrument transmits force! With one cephalad push from below, the uterine isthmus and both cardinal ligaments sitting at the bottom of the pelvic funnel are lifted right up as a unit! Press gently into her lower abdomen with your fingertips—can you feel the hard rim of the metal colpotomy cup?"
Palpating carefully through the abdominal wall with his fingertips, Ryuji Sakaguchi nodded:

"Very clearly. The metal cup pushes the anterior vaginal fornix up into a distinct rigid circular ridge—when we open the abdomen and reflect the vesicouterine peritoneum downward, we can use that metal ring directly as a safe landmark."

"Exactly, that's the exact feel!" Growing even more enthusiastic, Aqua kept her movements strictly within safe anatomical limits as she first depressed the external stainless-steel handle to antevert the uterus, raised the handle to retrovert it, and then swung it toward the left and right for lateral traction!
"Nngh...! D-Don't lever that iron handle back and forth inside me...! Haa... my lower belly feels so sore and full...!"

Not a single incision had been made on her abdomen yet, and already the uterus deepest inside her body was being used as a pivot on a cold metal rod—lifted up and down, pried forward and back, and swung side to side inside her pelvis.
Standing toward the back of the table with her chart, Moe Honjo was completely transfixed.

Watching that gleaming stainless-steel shaft jutting straight out of a fellow woman's most intimate depths and lifting a visible bulge across her flat white abdomen with every flick of Chief Mizuki's wrist—even knowing an OR nurse ought to stay unfazed, eighteen-year-old Moe turned pale before such an instinctively daunting gynecological maneuver, clutching her clipboard tightly against her own lower belly and pressing her knees together beneath her scrub pants as she whispered in a trembling voice:
"Uu... first biting down there with hooked teeth forceps, and then shoving such a long iron rod all the way in to lift and rock it around... th-that's terrifying, it hurts just watching..."
Sharp-eared Aqua Mizuki didn't even turn around, tossing out a casual clinical explanation while still holding the manipulator handle:

"Why scare yourself like that, Moe! The epidural kicked in ages ago—all sharp cutting pain is completely blocked, so at most it's just a dull stretching fullness in the pelvic ligaments—right, Serena?"

Hearing the young nurse's heartfelt 'it hurts just watching' followed immediately by Aqua's blithe 'right, Serena?', Serena—whose deep pelvis was aching and distended around the metal rod—nearly choked on her breath, tears of mortification stinging the corners of her eyes as she snapped in a trembling, biting voice:
"Chief Mizuki... gripping that freezing iron rod and rocking it endlessly inside my body... are you treating a patient's uterus like a toy to show off your technique...?!"
To her surprise, Aqua Mizuki's expression turned utterly earnest and straightforward, pointing at the angle of her wrist as she explained to both Serena and Sakaguchi:

"How could it possibly be a toy! Every millimeter of movement is screening out surgical risks for you! You must have felt it yourself just now, Serena—when I swung the handle to the right, it moved easily, but the moment I angled it to the left to put the right pelvic sidewall on stretch, didn't you feel a tight pulling sensation deep in your right lower back?"
Serena blinked, biting her lip in silence—because when the handle had swung left just now, she really had felt a distinctly sharper dragging ache deep on her right posterior side.

"Look, Sakaguchi—angling the handle about twenty-five degrees to the left hits unmistakable elastic fibrous resistance! That confirms the preoperative ultrasound finding: the densest adhesion between her posterior uterine wall and anterior rectum sits on the right! If we didn't map out this safe mobility boundary before skin incision, the assistant could easily tear the rectal serosa by blindly cranking the manipulator left under the drapes during surgery!"
With that, Aqua briskly stepped half a pace aside, ceding the stainless-steel handle suspended between Serena's legs to Ryuji Sakaguchi:

"Come on, Sakaguchi! Once we open the abdomen, at every critical step—lysing adhesions, clamping the uterine vessels, and circumscribing the vaginal fornix—you'll be reaching under the sterile drapes to grip this manipulator and position the uterus for me. Take the handle yourself now and test cephalad elevation, anteversion-retroversion, and the right-sided adhesion boundary in that exact order!"
Flushing bright red, Serena's eyes flew wide as she stared at Ryuji Sakaguchi:
"Wh—?! Dr. Sakaguchi is going to grab that thing and move me around too?! Y-You don't need to test it again, do you?!"
Remind Aqua to be mindful of the patient's feelings, gently explain the necessity to Serena, then perform the test
Briefly reassure Serena to slow her breathing, then briskly confirm multi-directional resistance with minimal excursion
Ryuji Sakaguchi glanced first at the heart-rate trace on the monitor and spoke in a quiet reminder:
"Chief Mizuki, don't get so caught up in anatomical tension that you forget our awake patient's feelings—she's very tense right now."
Aqua Mizuki blinked, realizing her oversight, and called toward the head of the table:
"Ah... sorry, sorry! Don't be nervous, Serena—letting the first assistant get familiar with the resistance ahead of time is so we can cut cleanly and spare you extra discomfort later!"
Ryuji Sakaguchi then turned to Serena, his voice steady and gentle:
"Ms. Serena, take a deep breath and relax your abdominal wall. I'll only perform one standard excursion check without pulling hard against the adhesion site—it'll be over in a moment."
Noticing Serena's knuckles turning white on the armboards, Ryuji Sakaguchi spoke clearly and gently:

"Ms. Serena, Chief Mizuki and I need to coordinate from above and below during the operation to safely protect your rectum and ureters. Please bear with this for ten seconds and slow your breathing—I'll keep the force controlled."
Beside him, Aqua Mizuki nodded eagerly:
"That's right, Sakaguchi's hands are super steady—you can relax!"

Under Serena's mortified, inescapable gaze, Ryuji Sakaguchi took his place at the foot of the operating table, his sterile-gloved right hand closing steadily around the stainless-steel uterine manipulator handle protruding from between her legs while his left hand rested lightly on her lower abdomen.

A smooth two-centimeter cephalad elevation confirmed the rigid circular landmark of the metal colpotomy cup; a gentle depression and lift gauged the gliding space of the vesicouterine fold and posterior fornix; and finally, a controlled leftward deflection halted cleanly the instant it met the taut resistance of the right posterior adhesion.

The pressure transmitted from the young male surgeon's hand was neither rough nor hesitant, carrying a purely clinical calm and restraint. Yet the more dispassionate and methodical his control was, the more Serena—who prided herself on wrapping men around her little finger—felt an overwhelming sense of defeat as the cold metal instrument held her deepest anatomy completely captive beneath two pairs of clinical eyes.
Turning her burning cheek aside and squeezing her eyes shut, Serena couldn't muster another word of dignified protest.
Returning the manipulator handle to its neutral elevated position, Ryuji Sakaguchi looked up and reported to Aqua:

"Axis and mobility boundaries confirmed, Chief Mizuki. The metal colpotomy cup is seated securely, and leftward deflection reaches the safe tension limit of the right posterior adhesion at twenty-five degrees. I'll keep excursion strictly within that limit intraoperatively until the posterior adhesions are lysed under direct vision."
Beaming behind her mask, Aqua Mizuki nodded in approval:
"Identical to my reading! Nailing the safety boundary on your very first try—that's the first assistant I handpicked!"
Checking the wing nut on the indwelling manipulator one last time, she straightened up and issued her orders briskly:

"Leave the uterine manipulator in place on standby! Moe, lower both stirrups to the low dorsal lithotomy position and leave a working channel beneath the sterile drapes for the handle; scrub nurse, change outer sterile gloves, re-prep the lower abdomen with povidone-iodine, and apply the laparotomy sterile drapes!"
Still clutching her clipboard in lingering shock, Moe Honjo snapped back to attention:
"Ah—y-yes, ma'am! Lowering the stirrups right away!"

Moments later, Serena's elevated legs were lowered to a modified split-leg angle suited for both abdominal surgery and sub-drape handle control, and heavy green sterile laparotomy drapes were layered across her—sealing off her flushed face and lower body while leaving only the povidone-iodine-prepped lower abdominal field under the dazzling beam of the main surgical lamp.

Standing at the primary surgeon's position, Aqua Mizuki's playful energy settled instantly as she looked down at the incision line, replaced by the quiet, commanding authority of the head of gynecology.
Bracing the taut lower abdominal skin with her left hand, she extended her right hand toward Ryuji Sakaguchi and the scrub nurse:

"Watch closely, Sakaguchi. From abdominal incision, bladder reflection, and division of the cardinal ligaments and uterine vessels to circumscribing the vaginal fornix over the metal manipulator cup below—we now begin the Open Total Abdominal Hysterectomy. Scalpel!"

Receiving the belly-bladed scalpel from the scrub nurse, Aqua Mizuki's gaze was as still as water as she drew the blade steadily along the midline landmark from below the umbilicus to just above the pubic symphysis.
Not a single superfluous joke, nor a trace of hesitation.

Skin, subcutaneous fat, and the anterior rectus sheath parted cleanly layer by layer beneath her precise blade. Across the table in the first assistant's position, Ryuji Sakaguchi dabbed with sterile gauze in his left hand and matched her cadence with curved hemostats in his right—clamping tiny bleeders the instant her scalpel tip glided past.

Opening the peritoneum, Aqua Mizuki placed a stainless-steel three-blade self-retaining abdominal retractor to spread the incision wide, then gently packed the small bowel and sigmoid colon cephalad with warm saline-soaked laparotomy pads.
The deep pelvic operative field opened clearly beneath the brilliant beam of the main shadowless lamp.

Looking down, Ryuji Sakaguchi saw the exact pathology described on the ultrasound report laid out before his eyes—the entire uterus was asymmetrically enlarged to a dark-red, twelve-week globular mass with a diffusely thickened, rigid posterior wall; a hen's-egg-sized leiomyoma bulged from the posterior isthmus toward the right parametrium, tethering the posterior uterine wall tightly to the anterior rectum; yet both ovaries were rosy, plump, and completely healthy.
Standing near the head of the table with her chart, Moe Honjo rose onto her tiptoes to glance at the suction canister and sponge rack, letting out a quiet breath behind her mask.

From skin incision to full exposure of the deep pelvis had taken barely a few minutes, and the field was so clean that not even a single dry sponge was soaked—this Chief Mizuki, who was usually so scatterbrained in the hallway, wielded a scalpel with awe-inspiring precision.
Touching the uterine cornu lightly with long forceps, Aqua Mizuki spoke in the clear, steady cadence of a master surgical mentor:

"Take note of the anatomy, Sakaguchi. The patient is only twenty-seven, and our preoperative plan explicitly preserves both healthy ovaries—so we must never clamp the lateral infundibulopelvic ligaments containing the ovarian vessels. Instead, stay flush against both uterine cornua and divide the round ligaments, fallopian tube isthmus, and utero-ovarian ligaments in sequence. Long curved Heaney clamps!"
